Nike brought its most dominant track spike to the starting line with the ZoomX Dragonfly 2 Elite to help you reach new levels of speed. These race-day shoes are worn by some of the fastest 5k and 10k runners in the world—and are built for anyone wanting to crush their distance PRs.

With a sleek style, the Dragonfly 2 Elite perfectly blends performance and comfort. The perforated upper brings unmatched breathability. The combination of the resilient foam and snappy carbon plate creates an ideal midsole for longer track races. Four spikes on the outsole provide the strong connection you need on the track.

This performance track spike is supportive enough to help you endure races without your feet feeling too exhausted. Look no further if you’re wanting to take the next strides towards top-tier performance.

Details

  • Upper: New soft and stretchy yarns make up the upper, resulting in a conforming, barely-there fit to help you go the distance. The Matumbo hole at the heel reduces weight and enhances stability. Overall, the upper brings impeccable comfort and breathability to the shoe.

Spike length is approximately ¼ inch; be sure to check spike length regulations for your specific track meet to ensure these shoes comply. The underside of this spike also features a sharkskin heel for added traction and outsole foam for more durability.

product.description:
Get ready for race day success in the Nike Vaporfly 3 FK.

These carbon-plated speedsters are the pinnacle of race day shoes, giving you that edge to chase your personal best when you toe the start line. From 10K to a marathon, you’ll get to the finish line in a flash thanks to the full-length carbon plate and ZoomX foam that gives you ridiculous energy return and propulsion. Meanwhile, the Flyknit upper has plenty of breathability and support to keep you focused on your run.

Details

  • Upper: Everything about the Vaporfly 3 is fine-tuned for success, including the upper. This lightweight upper has specifically selected Flyknit yarns with engineered zones to give you breathability and a soft, supportive design that conforms to your foot. A wider forefoot gives you a more accommodating fit, while light padding on the tongue reduces pressure from laces on the top of your foot.
  • Midsole: A full-length carbon fiber plate gives you a propulsion system that will send you flying. The ZoomX midsole foam is super responsive with plenty of energy return for a springy, energetic ride. The geometry of the shoe reduces the weight on the inside of your foot to give you a stable ride when you are running as fast as you can.
  • Outsole: A thin outsole rubber keeps the shoe lightweight and allows for more ZoomX foam underfoot. A new Waffle outsole pattern with perforations gives you multi-surface traction in wet road conditions.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewNike updated the outsole rubber of the Vaporfly 3 and gave it a new Waffle pattern. This gives you better traction in wet conditions and decreases the weight without affecting durability. There is also more ZoomX foam underfoot to give you a smoother transition through your stride.Who It's Best ForThe Nike Vaporfly 3 is a carbon-plated racing shoe that gives you propulsion and spring to take your running to the next level.Why You'll Love ItYou will love how fast you can run in the Nike Vaporfly 3.00

product.description:
The sustainably-made Nike Vomero 18 will take your everyday road runs to a whole new level.

Nike layered two types of foam—ZoomX and ReactX—to create the latest iteration of their essential comfort shoe. The Vomero 18 has a 46 mm stack height in the heel and a 36 mm stack height in the forefoot, making it the tallest midsole in the Vomero series. With that maximum cushion underfoot, this shoe promotes more efficient long runs, thanks to a high energy return.

The Nike Vomero 18 gives the support you need to go the extra mile(s).

Details

  • Upper: A mesh upper keeps the shoe breathable, while the plush tongue and collar enhance the all-around comfort.
  • Midsole: Soft ZoomX foam stacks on top of ReactX foam in the most cushioned Vomero shoe yet. This unique midsole creates a high energy return for maximum comfort on road runs.
  • Outsole: High abrasion rubber on the sole promotes premium durability and great traction on pavement. This redesigned traction pattern, along with the shoe’s upward curve, encourages a seamless heel-to-toe transition with every stride.

product.description:
Get ready to fly past the competition in the Nike Vaporfly 4.

These race-day rockets have been meticulously refined to create Nike's most efficient speed machine yet. From the mile to the marathon, you'll experience unprecedented lightness and responsiveness with every stride. By trimming weight throughout while maintaining the technology that matters most, the Vaporfly 4 delivers the perfect balance of featherweight construction and powerful propulsion that racers will love.

Details:

  • Upper: The redesigned engineered mesh upper significantly reduces weight while providing a more consistent, secure fit throughout your race. A streamlined heel counter and minimalist tongue shed unnecessary grams without compromising comfort, keeping you focused solely on your performance when it counts most.
  • Midsole: The full-length carbon fiber Flyplate features a higher angle than its predecessor, working with the reduced 6 mm drop to create an incredibly propulsive feel. The lighter ZoomX foam runs from heel to toe, unlocking even more energy return with each stride, while the specially designed heel bulge enhances stability when you're pushing your limits.
  • Outsole: Thin rubber strategically placed on the outsole further reduces weight without sacrificing the durability or traction you need for race day performance.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewNike made minor tweaks to the Vaporfly 4 so you can enjoy major gains. The higher-angled carbon fiber Flyplate works with the reduced 6 mm drop for enhanced propulsion. The lighter ZoomX foam delivers more energy return with a slightly reduced midsole profile. The engineered mesh upper, streamlined heel and tongue, and thinner outsole rubber all contribute to meaningful weight reduction without compromising performance.Who It's Best ForThe Nike Vaporfly 4 is the ultimate racing shoe for dedicated runners seeking every possible advantage on race day. From elite competitors to passionate amateurs chasing personal bests, this mile-eating machine delivers uncompromising speed for distances from the mile to the marathon.Why You'll Love ItWhen seconds matter and records are within reach, you'll love how the Nike Vaporfly 4 makes fast feel effortless. With its featherlight construction and responsive ride, you'll experience that magical sensation of floating above the pavement while simultaneously being propelled forward.00
product.productIntroText: The lightest Vaporfly ever combines ZoomX foam with a new full-length carbon fiber Flyplate geometry—a fast, versatile racing shoe built for distances from the 5K to the marathon.

product.description:
Stride with confidence in the Nike Structure 26.

Built for runners who want that perfect balance of stability and comfort, the Structure 26 proves you don't have to choose between support and a smooth ride. With a full-length ReactX midsole and Nike's innovative midfoot support system, the Structure 26 helps keep everything moving in the right direction so you can focus on enjoying your run.

Details:

  • Upper: The plush collar and tongue work with engineered mesh to create that premium fit that moves with your foot while maintaining the support you need. Extra padding makes every step feel comfortable, while the design gives your toes room to breathe without sacrificing that secure midfoot feel.
  • Midsole: The full-length ReactX foam delivers 13% more responsiveness than previous React technology, giving you cushioned comfort with increased energy return. Nike's midfoot support system wraps around your arch and heel to create a stable platform that promotes smooth transitions from heel to toe-off.
  • Outsole: High-abrasion rubber in the heel provides exceptional durability where you need it most, while blown rubber in the forefoot gives you that consistent softness and ground connection that makes every stride feel natural.

product.description:
Get ready to fly past the competition in the Nike Vaporfly 4 EK.

These race-day rockets have been meticulously refined to create Nike's most efficient speed machine yet. From the mile to the marathon, you'll experience unprecedented lightness and responsiveness with every stride. By trimming weight throughout while maintaining the technology that matters most, the Vaporfly 4 delivers the perfect balance of featherweight construction and powerful propulsion that racers will love.

Details:

  • Upper: The redesigned engineered mesh upper significantly reduces weight while providing a more consistent, secure fit throughout your race. A streamlined heel counter and minimalist tongue shed unnecessary grams without compromising comfort, keeping you focused solely on your performance when it counts most.
  • Midsole: The full-length carbon fiber Flyplate features a higher angle than its predecessor, working with the reduced 6 mm drop to create an incredibly propulsive feel. The lighter ZoomX foam runs from heel to toe, unlocking even more energy return with each stride, while the specially designed heel bulge enhances stability when you're pushing your limits.
  • Outsole: Thin rubber strategically placed on the outsole further reduces weight without sacrificing the durability or traction you need for race day performance.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewNike made minor tweaks to the Vaporfly 4 so you can enjoy major gains. The higher-angled carbon fiber Flyplate works with the reduced 6 mm drop for enhanced propulsion. The lighter ZoomX foam delivers more energy return with a slightly reduced midsole profile. The engineered mesh upper, streamlined heel and tongue, and thinner outsole rubber all contribute to meaningful weight reduction without compromising performance.Who It's Best ForThe Nike Vaporfly 4 is the ultimate racing shoe for dedicated runners seeking every possible advantage on race day. From elite competitors to passionate amateurs chasing personal bests, this mile-eating machine delivers uncompromising speed for distances from the mile to the marathon.Why You'll Love ItWhen seconds matter and records are within reach, you'll love how the Nike Vaporfly 4 makes fast feel effortless. With its featherlight construction and responsive ride, you'll experience that magical sensation of floating above the pavement while simultaneously being propelled forward.00

product.description:
Step into confidence with the Nike Structure Plus.

Combining the peace of mind of a stability shoe with the extreme comfort and fun of super foam, the Structure Plus proves that support doesn't mean sacrificing the joy of running. For the first time, Nike brings ZoomX and ReactX foam to their stability lineup, creating an amped underfoot sensation that makes everyday training and long runs feel more enjoyable without compromising the support you need.

Details:

  • Upper: Engineered mesh delivers zonal breathability and support right where you need it. The midfoot fit band adds lockdown, while structural overlays provide extra security. A plush tongue and collar enhance comfort, creating a shoe that feels as good as it performs.
  • Midsole: ZoomX foam sits at the core, surrounded by a ReactX carrier that provides soft, protective cushioning with lateral and medial guidance. At 42 mm in the heel and 32 mm in the forefoot—the tallest stack height ever in the Structure line—you get serious cushioning while the midfoot support system wraps your heel and arch to help slow ankle eversion for stable transitions.
  • Outsole: High-abrasion rubber at the heel ensures durability in high-impact zones, while blown rubber in the forefoot provides that softer compound for smoother transitions and better ground feel.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe Structure Plus introduces ZoomX and ReactX foam to Nike's stability franchise for the first time, creating a softer, more responsive ride while maintaining the support system runners trust. The tallest stack height in Structure history pairs with a wider base for enhanced stability, proving you can have both cushioning and support in one package.Who It's Best ForThe Nike Structure Plus is a great option for runners who need stability support but don't want to sacrifice comfort or energy return. Why You'll Love ItYou’ll love the Structure Plus’ generous cushioning and extra support that makes each step smoother and more enjoyable.00
product.productIntroText: The Nike Structure Plus gives runners smooth, supportive cushioning for daily miles.

The Nike ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 2 is your fast race day shoe with a full-length carbon fiber plate to help you reach new goals and records.

This shoe was built to run fast. Your foot sits on top of ZoomX foam, which is Nike’s lightest and highest energy-returning foam. Sandwiched in between is a full-length carbon fiber plate that gives you an incredibly springy and smooth ride.

Ultra-lightweight, comfortable, and responsive, the Vaporfly Next% 2 fits like a glove. The breathable upper locks down your foot at high speeds while a soft mesh is used in specific areas to conform to your feet for a comfy fit from mile one to 26.2.

Nike adds some thoughtful extra touches to the ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 2 to make it truly best-in-class. Light padding on the tongue helps reduce lace pressure as your foot swells towards the end of a race, and the laces loop through lightweight side sashes that eliminate the need for an arch band. This keeps the laces from coming untied and ensures a secure fit when you’re hitting your stride.

From a 5K to a marathon, the Nike ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 2 is an elite racing workhouse with responsive cushioning and secure support.

Plus, engineered circular mesh conforms to your foot, while the suede material gives you a bit of style.

Whether you’re looking for one of the best treadmill shoes or a daily workhorse for running the road, the Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 40 can handle it all.

Dominate the competition no matter the course or conditions in the Nike ZoomX Dragonfly XC.

For 40 years, the Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 40 has been letting kids run in style and comfort.

Whether they are getting ready for track practice or you just want a good shoe for your kid to run around the playground, the Nike Pegasus 40 is the perfect fit. The cushioned foam gives a responsive and bouncy feel that is just right for your kid’s feet. The Zoom Air unit in the forefoot gives them quick off-the-ground sensations.

The soft engineered mesh upper is lightweight, breathable and structured to help your kid crush their next run. There is an extra skin layer across the toe for kids who drag their feet. Plus, a synthetic leather midfoot band stretches across the top to give them a secure and stable feel while running and moving in all directions, like their next dodgeball game.

The rubber sole has a waffle-inspired traction pattern to give them grip and durability whether they are running around the track or on the gym floor. Plus, the cutout grooves increase flexibility for better heel-to-toe transitions.

Whether your kids are participating in Girls on the Run or just need a good pair of sneakers, the Nike Pegasus 40 is one of the best kids running shoes on the market.

Let your kids run and play in comfort without the worry of untied shoes with Nike Flex Plus.

product.description:
Don’t let a little rain get in the way of your running goals with the weatherized Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 39 Shield.

Nike took its iconic Pegasus 39 and made it perfect for running in the rain and snow. A water-repellent finish and gusseted tongue work together to shield your feet from water, while the heathered lining in the collar keeps your ankles warm.

The knit material in the upper and cozy, fleece-like feel on the inside hold heat in, while strategically placed skins around the toes and insulation in the back of the tongue keep bad weather out.

Nike’s React foam delivers a smooth and responsive ride, and Zoom Air units at the forefoot and heel add a pop to your step. The unique heel shape and thick, responsive foam are designed to optimize your landings and create an effortless heel-to-toe transition.

Plus, the Storm-Tread outsole inspired by winter tires provides traction in inclement weather: micro-grooves grab the road, while multidirectional shapes help shed water for direct contact with the pavement.

One of the best shoes for running in the rain and snow, the Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 39 Shield will keep your feet warm, dry and comfortable.

product.description:
Chase your personal records with the Nike Alphafly Next% 2.

Get ready for speed. This racing shoe features Zoom Air units and a full-length ZoomX midsole to give you a bounce in every step. The newest Alphafly adds ZoomX foam under the Zoom Air unit, raising the heel-to-toe offset, giving you more bounce and improving the heel-to-toe transition.

The ZoomX foam is lightweight and responsive, allowing you to run fast while providing plenty of cushion to keep your feet feeling fresh during the late miles of a marathon. The full-length carbon fiber plate propels you forward and gives you smooth transitions throughout your stride.

Nike made the forefoot and heel a bit wider (it also fits a bit wider than the Vaporfly Next% 2) to give you a more stable platform, and the thin rubber outsole provides data-driven angles of traction placed precisely where you need it, so you can maintain your speed around tight turns.

The Atomknit upper has a contoured fit, while also being lightweight and super breathable. Nike tweaked it for a better fit using specifically designed lofted heel pods for a better heel lockdown and an integrated knit tongue with lofted padding to reduce lace pressure.

Made to go fast, the Nike Alphafly Next% 2 will propel you to your next PR.

Compression molded EVA foam provides a protective, plush landing that transitions smoothly through each stride, while a smooth Meta-Rocker™ rolls you forward naturally so maintaining your pace feels less like effort and more like momentum. Reflective details and 3D silicone touchpoints give it a refined, premium look and a double-lace lock keeps the tongue right where you put it through every mile.

A rearfoot-focused Active Foot Frame™ cradles your heel for natural stability without any added prescriptive technology getting in the way.

computed.product.reviewSummary: The Hoka Bondi 9 earns strong approval for its outstanding comfort, ample cushioning and steadfast support, proving ideal for daily wear, long walks or runs, and extended hours on concrete surfaces. Many people find the Bondi 9 helps alleviate foot, knee and back discomfort, though some perceive it as narrower or less cushioned than earlier Bondi iterations.
product.description:
The HOKA Bondi 9 is designed to eat up the bulk of your everyday miles with peak plushness.

With an extra 2 mm of soft yet responsive, super critical EVA foam and a rolling sensation that propels you forward with less effort, the Bondi 9 delivers the cushion and comfort you crave for long runs, long walks and long hours spent on your feet.

So whether you’re taking your runs to new distances or simply seeking all-day comfort, the Bondi 9’s ultra-cushioned ride and snug, accommodating fit will turn the pavement into clouds.

Details:

  • Upper: A knit upper paired with a retooled 3D molded heel collar offers a more accommodating fit. The extended heel pull makes slipping in and out of the shoe easy while reflective details increase visibility for extra safety during early morning or evening runs.
  • Midsole: This max-cushioned midsole features super critical EVA foam for a softer, more responsive ride. The smooth Meta-Rocker™ geometry is designed for effortless transitions while the rearfoot-focused Active Foot Frame™ cradles your heel for better stability and balance. Plus, an additional 2 mm of cushioning boosts comfort and support underfoot.
  • Outsole: A Durabrasion rubber outsole uses strategically placed zones to provide durability and reliable traction without weighing you down.

Its wide base and tall stack of cushioning also make it a great option for walking or standing on your feet all day. Plus, the Bondi 9 has the American Podiatric Medical Association (APMA) Seal of Acceptance which recognizes products that have been found beneficial to foot health. product.description:
Keep your stride steady with the HOKA Gaviota 6.

Built for runners who need reliable support without sacrificing comfort, this max-cushioned stability shoe brings enhanced H-Frame technology to help guide your gait smoothly from heel to toe. With a plusher collar, an elevated engineered mesh upper and a new internal ghillie lacing system, the Gaviota 6 proves that support can feel as good as it performs.

Details:

  • Upper: Breathable engineered mesh keeps your feet comfortable while the internal ghillie lacing system creates a secure, customizable fit. The plusher comfort collar wraps your ankle softly, and the heel pull webbing makes getting in and out easier on busy mornings. Reflective details help keep you visible during early or late runs.
  • Midsole: Compression-molded EVA foam delivers the max cushioning you need for longer efforts while staying responsive enough for everyday training. The enhanced H-Frame stability technology uses an open "H" shape to provide smooth transitions and support on both the medial and lateral sides—helping you feel balanced and controlled through your entire stride.
  • Outsole: Abrasion-resistant rubber stands up to consistent training miles, giving you the durability and traction to keep showing up week after week.

The updated engineered mesh upper, plusher collar and new internal ghillie lacing system create a more comfortable, secure fit. Plus, the shoe drops about half an ounce in weight while maintaining the max cushioning and support runners count on.Who It's Best ForThe HOKA Gaviota 6 is perfect for runners who need stability support for their daily training and longer runs. Whether you're building your base, working toward a race goal or simply want a shoe that helps you feel balanced and comfortable mile after mile, the Gaviota 6 gives you the foundation to keep moving forward with confidence.Why You'll Love ItYou’ll love the Gaviota 6’s smooth, stable support and plush cushioning that helps you glide through your daily miles.00
product.productIntroText: The Gaviota 6 brings HOKA's maximum cushioning and built-in stability together to create a supportive daily trainer for runners who need a smooth, steady ride.

Prepare for blastoff in the HOKA Rocket X 3.

Built to bridge the gap between training and racing, the Rocket X 3 delivers energetic performance without sacrificing the comfort and stability you need to stay confident at speed. This entry-level supershoe combines dual-density PEBA foam with a winged carbon-fiber plate and HOKA's signature rocker geometry to propel you toward your personal best.

In our HOKA Rocket X 3 review, run tester Caroline said "The step-in feel was everything I'd want in a super shoe. It really comes to life while running and feels quite stable even over uneven pavement."

Details:

  • Upper: The single-layer warp-knit construction gives you stretchy support with excellent breathability. A soft, padded heel collar prevents blisters during long efforts, while textured laces ensure secure lockdown when the pace picks up.
  • Midsole: Dual-density PEBA foam creates the perfect balance of soft comfort underfoot with firm responsiveness. The full-length carbon-fiber plate features innovative winglets that cradle your midfoot for added stability and smooth energy return.
  • Outsole: New sticky rubber compound delivers reliable traction on varied surfaces, from smooth asphalt to morning-dew-covered bridges.

product.description:
The HOKA Challenger 8 is made for where the road meets the trail.

Designed for runners who refuse to be limited by terrain, the Challenger 8 bridges the gap between your neighborhood streets and your favorite trails with confidence-inspiring versatility. This gravel-grinding workhorse delivers HOKA's signature cushy ride with even more foam underfoot than before, while reimagined multi-directional lugs ensure you'll have the traction you need no matter where your run takes you. Whether you're exploring new paths or sticking to familiar routes, the Challenger 8 gives you the freedom to run anywhere your curiosity leads.

Details:

  • Upper: 100% rPET engineered mesh gives you breathable comfort while doing good for the planet. The plush collar surrounds your ankle with soft support, and an extended heel pull tab makes slipping on and off easy after long days on your feet.
  • Midsole: Compression molded EVA foam delivers that signature HOKA cushioning you love, now with even more foam for an ultra-plush ride that absorbs impact whether you're on pavement or dirt.
  • Outsole: Durabrasion rubber adapts to any terrain, while strategically placed multi-directional 4 mm lugs provide ultimate traction. Plus, a durable 3D screen-printed toe cap protects against rocks and roots when the trail gets technical.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's New The Challenger 8 takes everything runners loved about its predecessor and makes it even better. HOKA added more foam underfoot for an even plusher ride, while completely reimagining the orientation of the multi-directional lugs for improved all-terrain traction. The fit has been refined for better comfort, and thoughtful details like reflective elements help keep you visible during dawn patrol or evening adventures.Who It's Best ForThe HOKA Challenger 8 is perfect for adventurous runners who want one shoe that can handle everything from morning coffee runs to weekend trail explorations. It's ideal for those transitioning from road to trail, runners who love mixed-terrain routes and anyone who values the freedom to follow their curiosity without worrying about their gear holding them back.Why You'll Love ItYou'll love how the Challenger 8 removes barriers from your running, giving you the confidence to say "yes" to any route that calls to you.00
product.productIntroText: Versatile enough for both roads and trails, cushioned enough for daily use, the Challenger 8 is HOKA's go-everywhere daily trainer.
product.title: Women's | HOKA Challenger 8

product.description:
The HOKA Arahi SR gives you the trusted traction and supportive ride runners love from the Arahi line with the addition of a slip-resistant outsole.

Whether you’re on the job or running slippery concrete routes, this shoe is made to keep you steady on wet, slick surfaces. A breathable mesh upper with a water-repellent finish helps protect against splashes, while a flexible heel design makes it easy to slide in and out between shifts or runs.

HOKA’s enhanced H-Frame™ technology helps guide your stride without feeling rigid and a responsive toe-off creates a balanced feel that’s comfortable at any pace.

Details:

  • Upper: The vented mesh upper is breathable and features a water-repellant coating to ensure splash protection.
  • Midsole: Compression-molded EVA foam combined with H-Frame™ technology gives you durable support and cushioning on both sides of your foot.
  • Outsole: The outsole is made from a slip-resistant rubber, perfect for on-the-job traction.

product.description:
Taking the proven platform of the Clifton and pushing it further, the HOKA Clifton PRO introduces PROGLIDE™+ series technology to one of running's most dynamic trainers.

SCF foam in the midsole delivers a noticeably more energetic and peppy ride than the standard Clifton. It's cushioned and protective where it needs to be, and lively enough to reward a faster pace when you're feeling good. An aggressive MetaRocker™ geometry rolls you through each stride with a smooth, propulsive feel that makes easy miles feel genuinely effortless and quicker efforts feel naturally fluid.

Details:

  • Upper: A breathable engineered mesh upper pairs with a gusseted tongue that stays put through every mile. A comfort collar gives you a secure and plush step-in feel while reflective details add low-light visibility. Available in standard and wide widths for both men and women.
  • Midsole: PROGLIDE™+ series SCF foam delivers a more responsive, energetic ride than traditional compression molded EVA — protective enough for daily training volume and lively enough to handle uptempo efforts without skipping a beat. An aggressive MetaRocker™ drives smooth, efficient transitions from landing to toe-off.
  • Outsole: A podular outsole design with Durabrasion rubber provides reliable traction and long-lasting durability on road surfaces.

It's a strong choice for runners looking who want a shoe that can tackle easy days, long runs and some speed work in between. The Clifton PRO can take you from daily training all the way to race-day.Why You'll Love ItYou'll love the Clifton PRO's energetic cushioning and smooth, aggressive rocker that keeps your momentum going. The Clifton PRO takes everything that made the original great and adds the kind of performance that makes you want to run fast.00

product.description:
Trusted by runners across every pace, every goal and every kind of mile, the HOKA Clifton 11 keeps delivering the effortlessly cushioned ride that made it a community favorite in the first place.

Compression molded EVA foam provides a protective, plush landing that transitions smoothly through each stride, while a smooth Meta-Rocker™ rolls you forward naturally so maintaining your pace feels less like effort and more like momentum. Reflective details and 3D silicone touchpoints give it a refined, premium look and a double-lace lock keeps the tongue right where you put it through every mile.

Details:

  • Upper: An elevated engineered mesh upper provides a breathable, comfortable fit that wraps your foot securely without feeling restrictive. An open cell sockliner with a softer, more premium feel underfoot adds one more layer of comfort right where you need it most.
  • Midsole: Compression molded EVA foam delivers a protective cushioned landing and a responsive toe-off — soft enough for easy recovery runs, capable enough to pick up the pace when the mood strikes. A rearfoot-focused Active Foot Frame™ cradles your heel for natural stability without any added prescriptive technology getting in the way.
  • Outsole: An inherently durable abrasion rubber outsole delivers long-lasting traction and reliable wear on road surfaces — built to handle the kind of consistent daily mileage the Clifton was made for.

product.description:
Whether you’re run-commuting to work, touring a new city or hitting the trails, the HOKA Transport GTX is a weather-ready shoe that can do it all.

Placed firmly at the intersection of lifestyle and performance, the Transport GTX’s commuter-friendly style and GORE-TEX waterproof construction make it a Swiss army knife for city-dwellers and everyday adventurers alike.

Thoughtful features like quick-toggle laces and 360 degrees of reflectivity are the final touches on these versatile running shoes. Plus, sustainable materials are used throughout the construction of the shoes that keep the Transport GTX’s light on your feet and the planet.

Details:

  • Upper: A Cordura® main mesh upper made with 100% recycled polyester keeps the fit breathable while GORE-TEX Invisible Fit with 70% recycled polyester face fabric helps keep moisture out. There are quick-toggle laces designed to easily take your shoes on and off, 360 degrees of reflectivity for higher visibility and an abrasion-resistant upper that protects against scuffs. Plus, the tongue and collar lining are 100% recycled.
  • Midsole: The compression-molded EVA midsole material provides balanced cushioning that HOKA is known for and is made with 30% sugarcane.
  • Outsole: The Vibram® Ecostep Recycle EVO outsole delivers rugged performance, so you can confidently go for light hikes or walks on slippery roads. Plus, it is made with 30% regrind recycled rubber.

product.description:
There is no forecast too fierce for the HOKA Clifton 9 GTX.

One of the best waterproof running shoes, HOKA took its ever popular Clifton 9 and made it ready to run through the dark, rain and snow. It has a Gore-Tex® upper that will keep your feet warm and dry, while also providing 360 degrees of reflectivity to give you extra visibility when running in the dark.

The Clifton 9 is known as one of the best running shoes thanks to its lightweight cushion and rocking sensation that moves you forward. The GTX version is perfect for those runners who won’t let a little weather get in the way of their training.

Features

  • Upper: GORE-TEX® INVISIBLE FIT gives you a weatherproof upper for protection from the elements while still being breathable. This shoe is ready for splashes thanks to a closed mesh construction for added protection. There is 360 degrees of reflectivity to let you shine, even when the weather doesn’t.
  • Midsole: A very cushioned, yet light CMEVA midsole foam helps you run and walk in comfort, while the early stage Meta-Rocker propels you forward.
  • Outsole: Weather ready traction pods

product.description:
The HOKA Arahi 8 brings the perfect balance of softness and support to your runs.

Completely redesigned from the ground up, the Arahi 8 proves you don't have to choose between plush comfort and reliable stability. This eighth iteration delivers HOKA's softest Arahi yet, with added heel cushioning and innovative H-frame™ technology that supports every runner, regardless of their gait pattern. Whether you're building your base or chasing a personal best, the Arahi 8 adapts to your needs with a smooth, balanced ride that feels like it melts away on your feet.

In our HOKA Arahi 8 review, run tester Heather said "The word that kept coming to mind was 'balance.' This shoe has great, balanced support, balanced cushioning and just gave me an overall balanced feel as I ran."

Details:

  • Upper: Smooth engineered mesh surrounds your foot with breathable comfort, while a padded tongue and flared heel collar eliminate friction and hot spots. Plus, two extra lacing eyelets give you complete customization to dial in your perfect fit.
  • Midsole: Compression-molded EVA foam with 3 mm of additional heel cushioning creates the softest Arahi experience yet. H-frame™ technology gives you durable support on both sides of your foot, while the Active Foot Frame cradles you inside the cushioning for a secure, confident feel.
  • Outsole: Strategic abrasion-resistant rubber covers high-wear areas, while cutouts reveal midsole foam to reduce weight. HOKA's signature Metarocker™ geometry guides smooth, efficient heel-to-toe transitions at any pace.

Propel your way into hyperspeed with the HOKA Carbon X 3.

HOKA fine-tuned the midsole to give you a more energized ride. This endurance racer is engineered with a responsive carbon fiber plate and an aggressive Meta-Rocker to propel you efficiently through your stride. It has a rubberized EVA outsole that is durable and grippy for confidence at top speeds.

Snappy and lightweight, the Carbon X 3 is light and fast enough for racing, but durable enough to use as an everyday trainer. One of the best carbon-plated shoes, the Carbon X 3 has a wider platform compared to others brands in this category to give you a more stable ride.

The upper is brand new in the Carbon X 3. HOKA gave it a premium engineered-knit upper that is designed for lightweight and breathable performance. It has a bootie-like construction with an extended heel tab designed for an easy pull-on. Plus, its bold, asymmetrical colors will make a statement on your run.

Fly to the finish line in HOKA Carbon X 3.

Read more in our HOKA Carbon X 3 review.

product.description:
It feels good to run fast in the HOKA Mach 6.

Have your runs felt stagnant lately? Not anymore. These lightweight trainers are your key to unlocking everyday speed. The new super critical foam is fine-tuned for extra energy return, giving you the perfect amount of snappy responsiveness and bouncy cushioning to push the pace and keep your legs feeling fresh.

“I tested the Mach 6 on an 8-mile run with 30-second pickups every mile. I noticed that it felt peppier and better for up-tempo runs than the Mach 5,” says Kate, who’s currently training for a half-marathon. “I was able to get a good turnover going, and picking up the pace every mile felt smooth.” Read more from our HOKA Mach 6 review.

Details:

  • Upper: The lightweight and breathable creel jacquard mesh upper feels like air conditioning for your feet while extra padding along the heel collar and a gusseted tongue give you a performance fit with foot-hugging comfort to go the distance.
  • Midsole: The new super critical EVA foam midsole is composed of multiple tiny cells (imagine running on millions of small air bubbles), which offer more responsiveness at a lighter weight than traditional midsole compounds. The result is a firm yet peppy ride.
  • Outsole: Strategic rubber coverage on the outsole gives you confident footing while you’re turning corners and running at top speed.

product.description:
Miles feel effortless in the HOKA Skyward X.

This supremely cushioned trainer takes soft and smooth to the extreme. It features HOKA's groundbreaking suspension system with a convex carbon fiber plate that compresses and springs back with every stride. A highly resilient PEBA foam sits closest to your foot for lively, cloud-like cushioning, while a super critical EVA frame provides a stable base below.

In our full review of the HOKA Skyward X, run tester Mandy said, “I felt as if I was rolling through my runs and could run forever. This included both weekend long runs and shorter after-work runs. I liked running hillier sections in these shoes more than flatter sections because the combination of the carbon plate, cushioning and rocker shape allowed me to really let ‘er rip when going downhill.”

Details:

  • Upper: A flat knit upper with zonal engineering molds to your foot for a sock-like fit. Perforated material increases breathability while plush padding on the tongue and heel collar gives you a premium feel. A tapered heel collar reduces chafing and irritation on your Achilles, and extra eyelets allow you to tie the marathon loop to lock down the fit.
  • Midsole: The Skyward X's midsole has three layers that work together to provide a comfortable and efficient ride. The first layer, closest to your foot, is made of PEBA foam, which gives a bit of cushioned bounce with each step. Beneath that is a curved carbon-fiber plate that compresses when your foot strikes the ground, storing energy to spring back and propel you forward as you push off. Finally, the bottom layer is an EVA foam that works with HOKA's signature rocker shape to create a smooth and effortless transition from heel to toe as you walk or run.

product.description:
Blaze new trails and conquer gnarly terrain in the HOKA Speedgoat 6.

The refined Speedgoat 6 builds on its legend with a responsive, lightweight CMEVA midsole that serves up a buttery smooth, high-rebounding ride to keep you feeling fresh over long efforts. But, what really sets the Speedgoat apart is its ultra-grippy Vibram® Megagrip outsole with aggressive Traction Lugs inspired by an actual goat's hoof.

So whether you're chasing FKTs on technical singletrack or just getting after it on your local trails, the HOKA Speedgoat 6 delivers incredible grip and HOKA's cloud-like cushioning in an ultralight, ultra-capable trail shoe.

Details:

  • Upper: A dynamic sandwich mesh upper keeps your feet cool and protected, while a gusseted tongue with plush padding helps you stay comfortable over the long haul.
  • Midsole: All-new, lightweight and resilient CMEVA foam gives you tried-and-true cushioning for all-day trail runs, while the late-stage meta-rocker shape helps roll you through your gait.
  • Outsole: The Vibram® Megagrip outsole with 5 mm Traction Lugs claws into loose dirt, mud and technical terrain so you can charge uphills and bomb downhills with confidence.

Many reviewers cite relief from various foot, knee and back pains, though some note sizing inconsistencies or a different feel compared to previous Bondi models.
product.description:
The HOKA Bondi 9 is designed to eat up the bulk of your everyday miles with peak plushness.

With an extra 2 mm of soft yet responsive, super critical EVA foam and a rolling sensation that propels you forward with less effort, the Bondi 9 delivers the cushion and comfort you crave for long runs, long walks and long hours spent on your feet.

So whether you’re taking your runs to new distances or simply seeking all-day comfort, the Bondi 9’s ultra-cushioned ride and snug, accommodating fit will turn the pavement into clouds.

Details:

  • Upper: A knit upper paired with a retooled 3D molded heel collar offers a more accommodating fit. The extended heel pull makes slipping in and out of the shoe easy while reflective details increase visibility for extra safety during early morning or evening runs.
  • Midsole: This max-cushioned midsole features super critical EVA foam for a softer, more responsive ride. The smooth Meta-Rocker™ geometry is designed for effortless transitions while the rearfoot-focused Active Foot Frame™ cradles your heel for better stability and balance. Plus, an additional 2 mm of cushioning boosts comfort and support underfoot.
  • Outsole: A Durabrasion rubber outsole uses strategically placed zones to provide durability and reliable traction without weighing you down.

product.description:
The HOKA Clifton 10 delivers more cushion with the same comfort.

Step into effortless strides with the HOKA Clifton 10, the latest iteration of one of the most beloved daily trainers out there. Featuring plush cushioning, a smooth ride and a secure yet roomy fit, the Clifton 10 delivers everything runners love—plus a little extra protection underfoot.

Whether you're logging daily miles, heading out for a recovery run or just looking for a cushioned shoe for all-day wear, the Clifton 10 is your go-to for comfort and performance.

Details:

  • Upper: The engineered mesh upper provides breathability and a secure, adaptable fit. A flared heel collar reduces friction, while a wide, padded tongue ensures comfort and lockdown.
  • Midsole: Compression-molded EVA foam offers soft, responsive cushioning that balances plushness with stability. The updated 8 mm drop gives you smooth transitions and an easy ride.
  • Outsole: Strategic Durabrasion rubber placement ensures durability and traction while keeping weight to a minimum.
product.kitContent:
Accordion1What's NewThe Clifton 10 maintains the smooth, cushioned ride runners love while adding subtle refinements. The biggest update is an increased stack height in the heel, shifting the drop from 5 mm to 8 mm for a slightly different ride. Extra cushioning provides even more impact protection, and the wider base enhances stability without changing the signature Clifton feel. Who It's Best For

The HOKA Clifton 10 is a great choice for runners seeking a soft, balanced daily trainer that delivers comfort mile after mile. Whether you're a longtime Clifton fan or trying it for the first time, this shoe is ideal for easy runs, recovery days or anyone who values plush cushioning in a lightweight package.

In our HOKA Clifton 10 review, weartester Caroline said, “The Clifton 10 is a shoe just about anyone can enjoy, which is why it’s one of the most popular running shoes on the market. Not only is it a go-to for runners, but I also see my much cooler, non-running friends wearing them around town.”

Why You'll Love ItYou’ll love how the Clifton 10 feels familiar yet refined, offering the same soft and smooth ride with just a little more protection underfoot. Its comfortable fit, lightweight feel and reliable durability make it an easy favorite for runners and walkers alike.00
product.productIntroText: The Clifton 10 brings that familiar, easy-going feel to your daily miles—a lightweight, cushioned trainer that works for almost any runner.
product.title: Men's | HOKA Clifton 10

product.description:
Calling all trail racing fiends, gravel grinders and 100-milers. There’s a new trail titan in town.

Built for long-haul efforts, the Mafate X delivers supreme plushness with a dual-density, premium foam chassis, PEBA top layer and a pop of propulsion thanks to a forked carbon fiber plate. HOKA implemented an ultralight woven upper that allows for easy drainage and Vibram® Megagrip outsole with pod-like cutouts to ensure a smooth ride over variable terrain.

Details:

  • Upper: The thoughtfully designed woven textile upper with patent-pending dynamic vamp adapts to your foot shape while letting water escape after stream crossings. The gusseted tongue keeps debris out, while the protective toe cap and molded TPU heel counter keep you secure when the trail gets rough.
  • Midsole: HOKA smooth MetaRocker™ works with the rearfoot-focused Active Foot Frame™ to guide your stride naturally. The carbon fiber plate delivers energy that helps you power through fatigue, while the PEBA core and super critically foamed EVA carrier provide cushioning that stays comfortable for miles upon miles.
  • Outsole: Trust your footing thanks to the Vibram® Megagrip compound with 3.5 mm lugs and zonal rubber placement that balances grip, durability and weight.

product.description:
The Infini Hike TC is HOKA's first open-toe sandal, delivering its iconic performance and durability in a design built for the trail and beyond. These sandals combine a deep heel cup, three adjustable straps and a dual-density CMEVA midsole made with 30% sugarcane to provide the ultimate comfort experience. A Vibram® Megagrip outsole dominates through wet and uneven terrain, while a recycled Ariaprene® upper keeps things lightweight and quick-drying. Altogether, the Infini Hike TC brings all the comfort, support and durability HOKA is known for to a completely new silhouette.

Details:

  • Upper: The recycled Ariaprene® upper is built from 100% rPET webbing using a low-water dyeing technique, keeping the sandal lightweight and quick-drying. A W-strap design with an adjustable instep toggle, plus separate forefoot and heel straps, makes it easy to dial in a secure fit and get in and out. Life Natural® anti-odor technology with peppermint oil keeps things fresh through repeated wear.
  • Midsole: A dual-density CMEVA midsole made with 30% sugarcane delivers plush, all-day cushioning while cutting down on environmental impact. MetaRocker™ technology with integrated flex grooves promotes a smooth stride, and a metatarsal bar built into the topsole supports the forefoot at toe off. A deep heel cup adds extra stability and cradles the foot with every step.
  • Outsole: A Vibram® Megagrip outsole with 3.5 mm traction lugs grips through wet and uneven terrain. Its one-piece Vibram® construction also means the sandal can be resoled by an official cobbler, extending its life well beyond a typical sandal.

product.description:
The HOKA Challenger 8 is made for where the road meets the trail.

Designed for runners who refuse to be limited by terrain, the Challenger 8 bridges the gap between your neighborhood streets and your favorite trails with confidence-inspiring versatility. This gravel-grinding workhorse delivers HOKA's signature cushy ride with even more foam underfoot than before, while reimagined multi-directional lugs ensure you'll have the traction you need no matter where your run takes you. Whether you're exploring new paths or sticking to familiar routes, the Challenger 8 gives you the freedom to run anywhere your curiosity leads.

Details:

  • Upper: 100% rPET engineered mesh gives you breathable comfort while doing good for the planet. The plush collar surrounds your ankle with soft support, and an extended heel pull tab makes slipping on and off easy after long days on your feet.
  • Midsole: Compression molded EVA foam delivers that signature HOKA cushioning you love, now with even more foam for an ultra-plush ride that absorbs impact whether you're on pavement or dirt.
  • Outsole: Durabrasion rubber adapts to any terrain, while strategically placed multi-directional 4 mm lugs provide ultimate traction. Plus, a durable 3D screen-printed toe cap protects against rocks and roots when the trail gets technical.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe Challenger 8 takes everything runners loved about its predecessor and makes it even better. HOKA added more foam underfoot for an even plusher ride, while completely reimagining the orientation of the multi-directional lugs for improved all-terrain traction. The fit has been refined for better comfort, and thoughtful details like reflective elements help keep you visible during dawn patrol or evening adventures.Who It's Best ForThe HOKA Challenger 8 is perfect for adventurous runners who want one shoe that can handle everything from morning coffee runs to weekend trail explorations. It's ideal for those transitioning from road to trail, runners who love mixed-terrain routes and anyone who values the freedom to follow their curiosity without worrying about their gear holding them back.Why You'll Love ItYou'll love how the Challenger 8 removes barriers from your running, giving you the confidence to say "yes" to any route that calls to you.00
product.productIntroText: Versatile enough for both roads and trails, cushioned enough for daily use, the Challenger 8 is HOKA's go-everywhere daily trainer.
product.title: Men's | HOKA Challenger 8

The Youth Clifton gives you all of the performance and comfort that you love from the adult version, in a smaller package that is designed to fit the unique shape of kids’ feet. This shoe will be durable enough to keep up with their shenanigans and comfortable enough for them to run and play for hours.

Details

product.description:
Fast feels different in the HOKA Mach X 3.

Bringing the perfect balance of firm responsiveness and reliable comfort, the Mach X 3 combines PEBA midsole foam with a PEBAX plate to create a ride that comes alive once you start moving. The result is a versatile shoe that lets you focus on what matters most—hitting your paces and enjoying every step. In our HOKA Mach X 3 review, run tester Kate said "These shoes feel peppy and fun to run in!"

Details:

  • Upper: The new warp-knit construction feels softer and more breathable than previous versions, while the redesigned heel collar is padded and flares away from your achilles to eliminate rubbing. The secure lacing system includes an extra eyelet to help prevent heel slippage, and the durable mesh upper stands up to whatever your training throws at it.
  • Midsole: The firm PEBA foam paired with a PEBAX plate creates that responsive, propulsive sensation that makes uptempo efforts feel effortless. Combined with HOKA's signature rocker construction, every stride feels smooth and controlled whether you're cruising through easy miles or hitting threshold pace.
  • Outsole: Rubber in high-wear areas and cutouts for weight reduction give you reliable traction and durability for daily training and speed work.

product.description:
Crush technical terrain in the HOKA Speedgoat 7.

This fan-favorite trail shoe gets a boost in energy return with a new super-critically foamed EVA midsole that makes the GOAT more responsive than ever. Keeping the trusted fit and grippy Vibram Megagrip traction trail runners love, this update refines the heel collar for better comfort and adds easy gaiter integration to help keep debris where it belongs—off your feet and out of your shoes.

Details:

  • Upper: Lightweight RPET woven textile combines with a stretchy, patent-pending dynamic vamp for a fit that adapts to your foot on technical trails. The lay-flat tongue with dual gusset stays in place, while the heel pull tab makes getting in and out easier. Plus, reflective details help you stay visible when you're starting early or finishing late.
  • Midsole: The new super-critically foamed EVA midsole brings more energy return to help you tackle long trail days and technical climbs. This responsive cushioning works with the 5 mm Vibram Megagrip lugs to give you the confidence to attack descents and power up steep sections.
  • Outsole: Vibram Megagrip with Traction Lug technology provides the reliable grip that's made the Speedgoat legendary. Updated lug orientation improves traction on mixed terrain, so you can handle everything from smooth hard-pack to loose, rocky scrambles.

The refined heel collar improves comfort for all-day wear, while new gaiter integration helps you tackle muddy, debris-filled trails with confidence. Updated lug orientation adapts better to mixed terrain without changing what makes the Speedgoat grip so trustworthy.Who It's Best ForThe HOKA Speedgoat 7 is perfect for trail runners who want one reliable shoe for everything from local trails to all-day mountain adventures. Whether you're building your trail mileage up, training for an ultra or just love spending hours exploring new terrain, this shoe handles technical challenges while keeping your feet comfortable and protected.Why You'll Love ItThe Speedgoat 7 gives you the confidence to explore further and push harder on technical trails. With grip that inspires trust and cushioning that protects, you're free to focus on the trail ahead, the views around you and the feeling of moving through wild places under your own power.00

product.description:
Move seamlessly from city streets to trail adventures in the HOKA Transport 2.

This versatile shoe levels up the comfort of the original with a higher stack height, plusher collar and cushier sockliner that softens every step. Whether you're walking through your neighborhood, hiking local trails or just living your active life, the Transport 2 brings together practical features like quick-toggle lacing, water-repellent treatment and 360 degrees of reflectivity to keep up with wherever your day takes you.

Details:

  • Upper: 100% recycled polyester vamp and durable Cordura mesh tongue create a breathable, protective fit. The quick-toggle stretch lace system makes adjusting your fit effortless (traditional laces are included too), while topically applied PFC-free/PFAS-free water repellency treatment helps keep your feet dry when conditions get wet.
  • Midsole: The 30% sugarcane EVA midsole provides cushioned comfort with responsive toe-off when you want to pick up the pace. The updated, cushy sockliner adds a softer, bouncier feel underfoot, while the higher stack height delivers more protective cushioning for all-day comfort.
  • Outsole: Vibram EcoStep Recycle rubber (made with 30% regrind materials) gives you reliable traction on varied surfaces - from sidewalks to gravel paths. The symmetrical cushioning bed provides the support you want without prescriptive technologies you don't need.

These updates make an already-versatile shoe even more comfortable for the varied adventures that fill your active life.Who It's Best ForThe HOKA Transport 2 is the perfect do-it-all shoe. It’s a great option for anyone who wants one shoe that can handle a little bit of everything—morning dog walks, weekend hikes, running errands or exploring new cities.Why You'll Love ItYou’ll love the higher stack height and upgraded sockliner create all-day comfort that keeps you moving whether you're on pavement or trails. Quick-toggle lacing means easy on and off when you're juggling a busy life, and the 360-degree reflectivity helps keep you visible during early morning or evening adventures. The versatility to move seamlessly between different activities means you spend less time thinking about your gear and more time enjoying where it takes you.00
product.title: Women's | HOKA Transport 2

product.description:
Move quick and stay nimble with the HOKA Mach 7.

This lightweight trainer brings supercritical EVA foam that feels stable yet peppy, creating a ride that adapts to whatever your training day demands. The Mach 7 gives you responsive cushioning without carbon plates or maximum stack heights—sometimes the best tool is the one that simply gets out of your way and lets you fly.

Details:

  • Upper: The updated creel jacquard material creates a noticeably breezy, breathable feel that stays light on foot. The gusseted tongue provides a better lockdown fit than previous versions, which is helpful when you're picking up speed or whipping around corners.
  • Midsole: Supercritical EVA foam uses millions of tiny air cells to create that peppy, responsive feeling underfoot. Despite the 37 mm stack height, this shoe feels nimble and agile. The moderate stack height combined with responsive foam gives you confidence in your footing whether you're cruising easy or pushing the pace.
  • Outsole: Two types of rubber work together strategically—sticky rubber in the forefoot grips like glue during toe-off, while durabrasion rubber at the heel minimizes wear. This thoughtful design handles wet conditions and stands up to consistent training.

You’ll love how light and playful it feels during your runs.00

product.description:
Built for days that move between trail and water, the HOKA Hopara 2 pairs a recycled knit upper with water-repellent treatment and Cordura® mesh overlays that let water drain out while keeping debris at bay. A sugarcane EVA midsole and topsole cushion every step without weighing you down, while a sticky rubber outsole and durable toe cap add grip and protection over rocky or uneven ground. An adjustable heel strap and quick toggle lace let you dial in the fit in seconds, so you can loosen up for a creek crossing without missing a step.

Details:

  • Upper: The 100% recycled knit upper features a water-repellent treatment for a dry, sock-like fit. Recycled Cordura® mesh overlays allow water to drain out while keeping trail debris at bay, and a quick toggle lace makes the shoe easy to put on and take off.
  • Midsole: A 30% sugarcane EVA midsole provides support and shock absorption underfoot. Paired with a 30% sugarcane EVA topsole, this cross between a sandal and hiker delivers a protective cushion while maintaining a responsive toe-off.
  • Outsole: A sticky rubber outsole delivers reliable grip in wet or dry conditions. A durable rubber toe cap adds extra protection on the trail. An adjustable heel strap rounds out the fit for a secure, customized feel.

A new adjustable heel strap provides a customized, secure fit across any terrain.Who It's Best ForThe Hopara 2 is made for hikers and trail adventurers who want to cross streams, mud, rock and uneven terrain without stopping to change shoes. It suits anyone who splits time between water and land, whether that's paddlers, campers or beach hikers looking for a shoe that feels like a sandal but performs like a hiker.Why You'll Love ItThe new knit upper and sugarcane topsole bring a noticeable comfort and breathability upgrade over the previous model, while quick-dry materials and water repellency treatment mean you can move from creek to trail without missing a step. The adjustable heel strap and toggle lace let you dial in a secure, personalized fit, so the shoe feels dialed in. Recycled Cordura and sugarcane EVA materials also mean a lighter footprint without sacrificing performance or durability.00

product.description:
The Infini Hike TC is HOKA's first open-toe sandal, delivering its iconic performance and durability in a design built for the trail and beyond. These sandals combine a deep heel cup, three adjustable straps and a dual-density CMEVA midsole made with 30% sugarcane to provide the ultimate comfort experience. A Vibram® Megagrip outsole dominates through wet and uneven terrain, while a recycled Ariaprene® upper keeps things lightweight and quick-drying. Altogether, the Infini Hike TC brings all the comfort, support and durability HOKA is known for to a completely new silhouette.

Details:

  • Upper: The recycled Ariaprene® upper is built from 100% rPET webbing using a low-water dyeing technique, keeping the sandal lightweight and quick-drying. A W-strap design with an adjustable instep toggle, plus separate forefoot and heel straps, makes it easy to dial in a secure fit and get in and out. Life Natural® anti-odor technology with peppermint oil keeps things fresh through repeated wear.
  • Midsole: A dual-density CMEVA midsole made with 30% sugarcane delivers plush, all-day cushioning while cutting down on environmental impact. MetaRocker™ technology with integrated flex grooves promotes a smooth stride, and a metatarsal bar built into the topsole supports the forefoot at toe off. A deep heel cup adds extra stability and cradles the foot with every step.
  • Outsole: A Vibram® Megagrip outsole with 3.5 mm traction lugs grips through wet and uneven terrain. Its one-piece Vibram® construction also means the sandal can be resoled by an official cobbler, extending its life well beyond a typical sandal.

product.description:
Seek out the scenic route in the HOKA Stinson 8. Redesigned to feel lighter, smoother and more secure underfoot, it brings plush comfort and steady support to every mile — whether your route sticks to the trail or wanders onto the pavement. The updated breathable upper helps keep things cool, while the grippy outsole gives you confidence when the terrain gets technical. Wherever you’re headed, the Stinson 8 will make the long way feel like the right way.

Details:

  • Upper: An updated breathable mesh upper keeps air flowing and is backed by durable woven overlays that hold up against roots, brush and rocky terrain. A molded cage overlay locks your midfoot in place, while a dual-sided gusset works with the tongue to help keep debris out. At the heel, a webbing loop makes the shoe easy to pull on before you head out the door.
  • Midsole: The enhanced H-Frame top midsole layer is built with trail running in mind, balancing stability with the plush cushion the Stinson line is known for. It's designed to prevent excessive inward roll and overpronation, without overcorrecting your natural gait. Underneath, a soft bottom layer absorbs shock from rocks and uneven ground, so every step still feels as good as the last.
  • Outsole: The durable all-terrain rubber outsole is built to handle rough ground without wearing down quickly. Its 3.5 mm lugs grip loose dirt and soft terrain, giving traction you can trust on the trail.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe Stinson 8 is HOKA’s lightest version yet, and it comes with a handful of upgrades to back that up. An extra-soft layer at the bottom of the midsole gives smoother shock absorption with every step. The H-Frame layer has been refigured to strike a better balance between cushion and stability, while a redesigned upper improves breathability and keeps your foot locked in place. For the outsole, the lug pattern was reworked so the shoe transitions smoothly between road and trail.Who It's Best ForBuilt for trail runners who want max cushion without sacrificing stability on technical terrain. Its plush midsole and supportive H-Frame make it a strong pick for trail runners tackling long miles or ultra distances, where cushioning matters just as much as protection from rocks and roots. The all-terrain rubber outsole and 3.5 mm lugs give it enough grip for twisty trails, while the smooth ride still works well for runners who split their miles between pavement and dirt.Why You'll Love ItThe Stinson 8 got a full redesign, giving you a more stable ride that feels just as plush as the Stinson 7. You’ll love the Stinson’s cushioned ride and road-to-trail versatility that keeps you comfortable and confident, no matter where your route takes you.00
product.productIntroText: Meet the HOKA Stinson 8, a plush, stable trail running shoe built to keep you comfortable from pavement to path.

The HOKA Tecton X 4 puts dual-layer PEBA foam and parallel carbon plates under your stride for purespeed on technical trail race courses. HOKA’s PROFLY™ X midsole pairs its light, resilient foam with an adjusted plate structure and speed-focused MetaRocker™ to give you a responsive, propulsive ride when the terrain gets rough.

A brand-new stretch-knit collar prevents any trail debris from getting into the Zinal 2 for a distraction-free run. It is lightweight and breathable while providing great drainage for creek crossings and surprise puddles. Plus, the integrated knit tongue provides a great fit and midfoot lockdown to give you comfort and confidence on your run.

The HOKA Zinal 2 is lightweight and nimble to let you pick up the pace off-road.

Keep your feet warm and dry on any surface with the HOKA Challenger ATR 6 GTX. The GORE-TEX version of the HOKA Challenger ATR 6 has all of the same great features of the standard Challenger, but has the added benefit of GORE-TEX to keep the elements out.

This all-terrain shoe has a premium lightweight and breathable GORE-TEX bootie. The water-resistant mesh upper works well in rain, mud or snow, so you can wear it all year round, which makes it one of the best waterproof shoes out there.

Plus, the upper has many recycled materials in it. The Challenger ATR 6 GTX uses Unifi REPREVE recycled yarn, recycled poly laces, and a mesh, gusseted tongue from recycled materials, so you can feel good wearing this shoe.

Fly through the miles with the Challenger’s EVA midsole and early-stage Meta-Rocker. The rocker will propel you forward, while the EVA cushioning will make you feel like you are running on soft marshmallows, even when the ground is hard and rocky.

This shoe is great for running on the roads or trails because the lugs are grouped closer together than on most trail shoes, which creates a smoother ride on the pavement. These same lugs are more aggressive than your traditional road shoes, which gives a textured outsole that allows for better grip on dirt surfaces and makes it perfect for those easy and moderate trails.

product.description:
Keep your feet warm and dry on any surface with the HOKA Challenger ATR 6 GTX. The GORE-TEX version of the HOKA Challenger ATR 6 has all of the same great features of the standard Challenger, but has the added benefit of GORE-TEX to keep the elements out.

This all-terrain shoe has a premium lightweight and breathable GORE-TEX bootie. The water-resistant mesh upper works well in rain, mud or snow, so you can wear it all year round, which makes it one of the best waterproof shoes out there.

Plus, the upper has many recycled materials in it. The Challenger ATR 6 GTX uses Unifi REPREVE recycled yarn, recycled poly laces, and a mesh, gusseted tongue from recycled materials, so you can feel good wearing this shoe.

Fly through the miles with the Challenger’s EVA midsole and early-stage Meta-Rocker. The rocker will propel you forward, while the EVA cushioning will make you feel like you are running on soft marshmallows, even when the ground is hard and rocky.

This shoe is great for running on the roads or trails because the lugs are grouped closer together than on most trail shoes, which creates a smoother ride on the pavement. These same lugs are more aggressive than your traditional road shoes, which gives a textured outsole that allows for better grip on dirt surfaces and makes it perfect for those easy and moderate trails.

With the HOKA Challenger ATR 6 GTX you can tackle trails or roads in the rain or sunshine.

To learn more about this shoe, check out our review of the HOKA Challenger ATR 6.

product.description:
When a shoe feels as good as the HOKA Arahi 6, you won’t want to wear anything else.

Whether you're running, walking or simply moving through your day, step into the HOKA Arahi 6 and feel the instant boost in your stride and mood. Designed for those looking for performance style and comfort, these shoes promise an end to the compromise between fashion and feel, giving you an energizing bounce that propels you forward.

The Arahi 6 stands out with its stabilizing J-Frame™ technology that’s designed to combat overpronation or low arches without adding unnecessary weight and stiffness. The result is a smooth ride and a stable feel.

A flared pull tab lets you easily slip into this lightweight stability shoe and immediately the Arahi feels different on your feet. During runs or long hours spent on your feet, a plush tongue and breathable, lightweight upper keep you comfortable, while HOKA’s signature EVA foam cushioning helps prevent aching muscles and joints.

The Arahi 6 also has the American Podiatric Medical Association (APMA) Seal of Acceptance which recognizes products that have been found beneficial to foot health. With its amazing cushioning and arch support, it can be a beacon of relief for those with foot pain or anyone seeking a shoe that supports their health and running goals.

With every mile, the HOKA Arahi 6 can carry you closer to your goals in comfort and style.

Learn more in our HOKA Arahi 6 Review.

product.description:
Breaking the mold with a lively new foam, the HOKA Kawana earns its name from the Gold Coast’s famous beach break.

The Kawana continues to push the boundaries of HOKA foams and geometries, settling itself nicely in between the Clifton and Bondi as a maximally cushioned neutral training shoe. Designed to create endlessly smooth heel strikes, the SwallowTail™ geometry of the extended crash pad will immediately grab your eye. Then, HOKA’s early-stage Meta-Rocker guides you through your gait cycle like a rocking chair to give you a fulcrum effect through toe-off.

HOKA uses an all-new CMEVA foam in the Kawana midsole that's built to give you lasting support. This playful new cushioning gives the shoe a firmer, more responsive ride and solid rebound that doesn’t feel too soft underneath you.

Our reviews liked the smooth, springy, semi-firm ride and comfortable fit in our HOKA ONE ONE Kawana review.

The result is an accessible daily trainer with a well-balanced ride and maximal HOKA comfort that can hold up to any pace.

product.description:
Attack the trails with the carbon-plated HOKA Tecton X.

Inspired by the Earth’s tectonic plates, the Tecton X has two parallel carbon plates and provides a propulsive, smooth and efficient stride on uneven terrain. The carbon plates provide you with protection from rocks and roots, while giving you a snappy ride without being overly stiff. The soft and responsive ProFlyX™ foam gives you enough cushion to run for miles, yet it’s energetic enough to pick up the pace for hard training or a race. Testers in our HOKA Tecton X review loved the shoe’s lively feel both on and off road.

A Vibram® Megagrip with Litebase construction outsole will give you confidence on tricky terrain. This lightweight outsole contains sticky rubber technology designed to maximize ground contact and traction. Plus, HOKA designed the Tecton X with a toe rand to protect your feet from rocks and trail debris.

The upper consists of a jacquard engineered mesh, which is breathable and comfortable. It provides for a secure midfoot lockdown to help you run aggressively on the trails.

The HOKA Tecton X gives you a carbon-plated racing shoe that is durable enough for training miles yet will help you cross the finish line faster.

product.description:
Be a trailblazer in the HOKA Speedgoat 5.

With more traction and less weight, the HOKA Speedgoat 5 has been redesigned to take on the trails with ease. HOKA added Vibram® Megagrip with Traction Lugs to give you more grip, particularly on loose soil and dirt. The redesigned placement gives you more lugs in the heel and toe area to provide more durability and help you handle slippery or uneven terrain.

HOKA also re-engineered the midsole compound and made it lighter so the Speedgoat 5 gives you HOKA’s signature soft marshmallow ride through the trails. A late-stage meta-rocker helps roll you through your gait—making mountain climbs easier and allowing you to barrel downhill for a smooth and propulsive ride.

The upper of the Speedgoat 5 features a stretchy double jacquard mesh to give you the confidence to take on the trails. It improves both the comfort and durability of the shoe. Our reviewers loved the more lock-down fit that the new upper gave them in our HOKA Speedgoat 5 review.

There is a protective toe rand that gives extra protection against rocks and trail debris. Plus, HOKA re-designed the heel counter, giving it an extended heel tab to make it easier to pull on and prevent any rubbing at the Achilles.

The HOKA Speedgoat 5 gives you the cushion and grip to make it one of the best trail shoes for your next adventure.

product.description:
Slip into comfort with the supportive HOKA Gaviota 4.

The Gaviota is HOKA’s premium stability shoe and this version continues the plush tradition. HOKA uses its J-Frame™ support, which is a firmer foam that wraps around the medial (or inside) side of the foot and around the heel in a J-shape to give support when you need it. This is a shoe designed for individuals who excessively overpronate or have flexible arches.

Roll through your stride thanks to HOKA’s late stage Meta-Rocker that gives you a smooth ride and forefoot support. The Gaviota is HOKA’s maximum cushioned stability shoe, giving you the ultimate in comfort, step after step. In our HOKA Gaviota 4 review, one tester said “I like the tall stack of cushion underfoot. The feeling of the foam is soft, but it’s stable as opposed to smushy. The result is a ride that’s soft and protective but highly stable.”

HOKA retooled the upper of the Gaviota to make it more luxurious and comfortable than ever. The ventilated mesh upper is lighter and more supportive compared to previous versions of this shoe. It features a midfoot H-Frame that increases upper support and midfoot lockdown. Designers added cushioning around the heel collar and tongue to provide for a better step-in feel. Plus, HOKA updated the tongue with a single-side gusset and added a hidden eyestay reinforcement to reduce any slippage.

Whether you are training for a half-marathon or on your feet all day at work, you will love the plush and stable HOKA Gaviota 4.

Slip into comfort with the supportive HOKA Gaviota 4.

The Gaviota is HOKA’s premium stability shoe and this version continues the plush tradition. HOKA uses its J-Frame™ support, which is a firmer foam that wraps around the medial (or inside) side of the foot and around the heel in a J-shape to give support when you need it. This is a shoe designed for individuals who excessively overpronate or have flexible arches.

Roll through your stride thanks to HOKA’s late stage Meta-Rocker that gives you a smooth ride and forefoot support. The Gaviota is HOKA’s maximum cushioned stability shoe, giving you the ultimate in comfort, step after step. In our HOKA Gaviota 4 review, one tester said “I like the tall stack of cushion underfoot. The feeling of the foam is soft, but it’s stable as opposed to smushy. The result is a ride that’s soft and protective but highly stable.”

HOKA retooled the upper of the Gaviota to make it more luxurious and comfortable than ever. The ventilated mesh upper is lighter and more supportive compared to previous versions of this shoe. It features a midfoot H-Frame that increases upper support and midfoot lockdown. Designers added cushioning around the heel collar and tongue to provide for a better step-in feel. Plus, HOKA updated the tongue with a single-side gusset and added a hidden eyestay reinforcement to reduce any slippage.

Whether you are training for a half-marathon or on your feet all day at work, you will love the plush and stable HOKA Gaviota 4.

Attack the trails with the carbon-plated HOKA Tecton X.

Inspired by the Earth’s tectonic plates, the Tecton X has two parallel carbon plates and provides a propulsive, smooth and efficient stride on uneven terrain. The carbon plates provide you with protection from rocks and roots, while giving you a snappy ride without being overly stiff. The soft and responsive ProFlyX™ foam gives you enough cushion to run for miles, yet it’s energetic enough to pick up the pace for hard training or a race. Testers in our HOKA Tecton X review loved the shoe’s lively feel both on and off road.

A Vibram® Megagrip with Litebase construction outsole will give you confidence on tricky terrain. This lightweight outsole contains sticky rubber technology designed to maximize ground contact and traction. Plus, HOKA designed the Tecton X with a toe rand to protect your feet from rocks and trail debris.

The upper consists of a jacquard engineered mesh, which is breathable and comfortable. It provides for a secure midfoot lockdown to help you run aggressively on the trails.

The HOKA Tecton X gives you a carbon-plated racing shoe that is durable enough for training miles yet will help you cross the finish line faster.

product.description:
If you can only pack one pair of shoes for your next adventure, make sure it’s the HOKA Stinson ATR 7.

Whether you’re out all day or going all out, this max-cushioned road-to-trail shoe will be your Swiss army knife for running, hiking, walking and everything in between.

The Stinson’s all-terrain versatility starts with its thoughtfully designed outsole that uses 4 mm multi-directional lugs made of grippy Durabrasion rubber for smooth and confident traction on any surface.

Then, a tall stack of plush and lightweight CMEVA foam and HOKA’s H-Frame midsole technology gives you a soft and stable platform for endless miles of comfort and shock absorption from pavement to trail to gravel.

Secure support and a locked-down fit come from the breathable jacquard mesh upper and gusseted tongue that hug your feet and prevent slippage while you’re navigating technical terrain. Plus, parts of the upper, including the laces are made from recycled content.

Lastly, a rubber toe cap gives you the extra protection you need to adventure off-grid.

From street to summit, get excited to run on clouds in the men's HOKA Stinson ATR 7.

product.description:
The women's HOKA Clifton 9 has the cushion and comfort you crave for long runs, long walks and long hours spent on your feet—all in a sleek and lightweight package.

Confident running starts with finding a shoe with the right balance of support, comfort and performance. The Clifton 9’s unrivaled cushioning and soft step-in feel make it easy to get excited about lacing up your shoes and going for a run.

A tall stack of plush, compression-molded EVA foam turns hard surfaces like concrete and pavement into clouds, while HOKA’s signature early-stage Meta Rocker gives you a smooth and effortless stride.

The Clifton 9’s roomy toe box and padded upper hug your feet in a friendly embrace that will keep you comfortable all-day whether you’re running, walking or working. Plus, the flared heel collar won’t rub or chafe and it comes in multiple widths, so it’s easy to find the perfect fit.

With a comfortable fit right out of the box and responsive cushioning that makes running feel easy, it’s no wonder why so many runners say the Clifton is one of the best running shoes they’ve ever worn.

So grab your pair of HOKA Clifton 9’s and say hello to your new daily running shoe.

Watch Caroline in our HOKA Clifton 9 review to learn more.
