The endless cushion and comfort of the HOKA Bondi 8 carries you through long runs, recovery days and long hours standing on your feet.

Considered by many to be one of the best cushioned shoes around, a run in the ultra-cushioned Bondi 8 is like going for a joyride. HOKA amplified the Bondi’s core features with a generous bed of ultralight and resilient foam that keeps each step soft and bouncy, while a smooth rolling sensation transitions you effortlessly from heel strike to toe-off.

The Bondi 8’s billowed silhouette highlights its brand-new extended heel geometry that forgives hard landings and encourages a stable and balanced ride.

The plush memory foam collar and cushioned tongue is like a travel pillow for your ankle and the breathable engineered mesh upper keeps your feet cool and comfortable. Despite the massive stack height of the Bondi 8, it feels nimble and light thanks to zonal rubber placements on the outsole that give you confident grip and reduces the weight even further.

With a ride and fit that is so plush and comfortable you have to try it on to believe it, the women's HOKA Bondi 8 is a max cushioned game-changer.

Learn more in our HOKA Bondi 8 review.

Neutral Cushioned shoes offer very little or no structure or pronation support and are generally more flexible than stability shoes. Runners who require a neutral shoe tend to notice more excessive wear on the lateral(outside) side of the soles of their running shoes. Neutral shoes can vary from lightweight and minimal cushioning to maximum levels of cushioning depending on the needs and preferences of the runner. Runners with high/stable arches tend to notice pain on the outside(lateral side) of their shins and knees and may also battle plantar fasciitis if not wearing a neutral cushioned shoe.

Get ready for adventure with the HOKA Trail Code GTX.

The perfect combination of lightweight and cushioned, this day hiking shoe will help you to your best year yet on the trails. This shoe has an extended Hubble® heel with SwallowTail™ geometry that is designed to limit the impact on the body and make for effortless heel-to-toe transitions.

A responsive new midsole foam provides exceptional cushioning and comfort for hours. HOKA added a PU sockliner for added cushion, and it’s 50% soy-based to be more environmentally friendly. The mesh and laces also contain recycled materials.

Hike in the rain and snow, this water-repellent shoe will keep moisture out with its GORE-TEX leaf technology. Finished with dimensional screen printing to decrease waste and increase durability, the Trail Code was made for exploring.

The Vibram® Megagrip rubber outsole with 5 mm lugs will keep you stable and confident on the uneven or slippery trails.

The HOKA Trail Code GTX will let you explore more trails and see more of nature’s beauty.

Rain or shine, blaze new trails in the cushioned, durable and adventurous HOKA Kaha 2 Gore-Tex.

This waterproof hiking boot brings HOKA’s signature cushioning to the trail. For peak performance and peak plushness during your hikes and treks, the Kaha 2 combines a waterproof nubuck leather and a waterproof GORE-TEX bootie upper with a tall stack of lightweight dual-density foam, so your feet are protected and comfortable no matter where your next adventure takes you.

HOKA designers updated the Kaha 2 by adding a HUBBLE heel with SwallowTail geometry, which gives this hiker cloud-like landings and plush heel strikes, particularly when you’re trudging downhill. Then, HOKA’s late-stage Meta-Rocker with integrated flex grooves in the outsole rolls your foot forward effortlessly so you can keep on trekkin’.

For secure ankle support and a confident ride, the HOKA Kaha 2 has quick lace metal loops to help cinch down your fit and a Vibram® Megagrip rubber with 5 mm lugs outsole to let you hike, jump or clamber over any obstacle.

Consciously crafted, this waterproof trailblazer also uses a variety of recycled materials to construct the upper including GORE-TEX fabric with recycled textile and recycled polyester laces.

Whether you’re walking the dog in the rain or making a long thru-hike, the men's Hoka Kaha 2 GTX can handle it all.

product.description:
The men's HOKA Clifton 9 has the cushion and comfort you crave for long runs, long walks and long hours spent on your feet—all in a sleek and lightweight package.

Confident running starts with finding a shoe with the right balance of support, comfort and performance. The Clifton 9’s unrivaled cushioning and soft step-in feel make it easy to get excited about lacing up your shoes and going for a run.

A tall stack of plush, compression-molded EVA foam turns hard surfaces like concrete and pavement into clouds, while HOKA’s signature early-stage Meta Rocker gives you a smooth and effortless stride.

The Clifton 9’s roomy toe box and padded upper hug your feet in a friendly embrace that will keep you comfortable all-day whether you’re running, walking or working. Plus, the flared heel collar won’t rub or chafe and it comes in multiple widths, so it’s easy to find the perfect fit.

With a comfortable fit right out of the box and responsive cushioning that makes running feel easy, it’s no wonder why so many runners say the Clifton is one of the best running shoes they’ve ever worn.

So grab your pair of HOKA Clifton 9’s and say hello to your new daily running shoe.

Watch Caroline in our HOKA Clifton 9 review to learn more.

Plus, the integrated knit tongue provides a great fit and midfoot lockdown to give you comfort and confidence on your run.

The HOKA Zinal 2 is lightweight and nimble to let you pick up the pace off-road.

Men's Hoka Akasa Running Shoe

Men's Footwear

This plush, maximum cushion shoe is truly versatile. Whether you walk or run, the Akasa offers you comfort and support in an attractive, clean look. The HOKA Active Foot Frame brings a reassuring "bucket seat" fit for the foot, while the rubberized foam adds extra responsiveness to make every step a confident one. Don't limit yourself to how far you can go with the Akasa.

Product Details

Best For:

  • Surface: Road, Gyms, Flats
  • Category: Neutral Cushioned - Intended for runners who have a higher, more stable arch that does not pronate excessively(roll inwards) or may even supinate(roll outwards). Neutral Cushioned shoes offer very little or no structure or pronation support and are generally more flexible than stability shoes. Runners who require a neutral shoe tend to notice more excessive wear on the lateral(outside) side of the soles of their running shoes. Neutral shoes can vary from lightweight and minimal cushioning to maximum levels of cushioning depending on the needs and preferences of the runner. Runners with high/stable arches tend to notice pain on the outside(lateral side) of their shins and knees and may also battle plantar fasciitis if not wearing a neutral cushioned shoe.

Benefits Include:

  • Features an ultra-plush dual-compound memory foam sock liner for all-day comfort
  • Rubberized foam midsole offers a dynamic and responsive ride while the rubberized foam outsole offers high rebound, cushioning and traction
  • Engineered knit upper combines support, comfort and breathability for active and casual use

product.description:
Some shoes just make running feel good. The Cloudmonster 3 is one of them. On went back to what made the original Cloudmonster a fan favorite—a firm, lively ride with a rocker shape that rolls you through every step. The new fit is dialed in, the cushioning has more depth than ever, and whether you're heading out for an easy jog or pushing the pace on a tempo run, this shoe shows up ready.

Details

  • Upper: Engineered mesh keeps things light and breathable without sacrificing structure. The heel and midfoot fit snugly, the toebox gives your toes room to wiggle and the heel collar adds just enough padding for comfort on long runs. Your foot goes in, locks down and stays there.
  • Midsole: Three layers of On’s CloudTec pods sit between you and the road, compressing on landing and springing back on takeoff. On's Helion superfoam delivers dynamic cushioning and impact absorption, while the nylon Speedboard plate adds a touch of forward propulsion without making this feel like a race shoe. The rocker geometry rolls you through each step naturally, so running feels less like effort and more like momentum.
  • Outsole: The CloudTec bottom unit features a redesigned Cloud shape, geometrically engineered for better support and impact absorption. The rubber outsole offers solid traction and durability on road surfaces, with enough grip to hold up in wet conditions.

product.kitContent: Shoe Comparison1Pick Your Perfect PairMen's | On Cloudmonster 3Men's | On Cloudmonster Hyper0Accordion1What's NewOn made two meaningful changes with the Cloudmonster 3. First, the fit. The upper is redesigned for a more secure, true-to-size feel—snug in the heel and midfoot with just enough room in the toebox. Second, the cushioning. A Helion foam and a triple-layer CloudTec setup replaces the previous dual-layer design, giving you more underfoot depth without losing the responsiveness the shoe is known for. Plus, the stack height bumps up slightly to 35 mm, and the drop moves from 5.5 mm to 6 mm.Who It's Best ForThe Cloudmonster 3 is built for runners who want a firm, cushioned trainer that can do a little of everything—easy miles, faster workouts and long days on your feet. If you gravitate toward shoes with a rocker shape and a dynamic feel, this one's worth trying. It also makes a great walking shoe, which not every running shoe can claim.Why You'll Love ItThe Cloudmonster 3 works for more than one kind of run. The rocker shape and triple-layer CloudTec cushioning make easy miles feel effortless, and the firm, responsive platform holds up when you want to move faster. It transitions just as naturally to walking and all-day wear, so you're not swapping shoes between your run and the rest of your day.00

product.description:
The Cloud X 5 pairs sleek, lightweight design with all-day comfort, making it just as easy to wear through a workout as it is through the rest of your day.

CloudTec® cushioning and Helion™ superfoam absorb impact, while the sculpted footbed adds flexibility for a more natural feel underfoot. Inspired by the Year of the Goat, this special-edition collection blends soft-touch materials with colors that symbolize calm, creativity, luck and prosperity, giving the shoe a look that fits right into everyday rotation. Extra padding in the tongue and heel collar adds comfort, and a rubber outsole delivers dependable traction no matter where your day takes you.

Details:

  • Upper: The light, breathable engineered mesh upper keeps air flowing whether you’re training or running errands. Added padding in the tongue helps reduce pressure from your laces, while extra cushioning in the heel collar creates a soft, secure feel around the ankle. Together with the secure heel hold, these updates help keep your foot comfortable and locked in through quick transitions and long days on your feet.
  • Midsole: The Helion™ superfoam midsole delivers soft, responsive cushioning with the stability you need for versatile workouts or just going about your day. On’s CleanCloud® technology transforms carbon emissions into high-performance foam, giving the shoe a lightweight feel with an innovative edge. A sculpted footbed replaces the Speedboard® to encourage more flexibility and natural movement without sacrificing support.
  • Outsole: The rubber outsole gives you reliable grip on gym floors, city streets, and everything in between. It’s designed to support side-to-side movements, so you can move confidently through bodyweight workouts and quick changes in direction. Deeper flex grooves help the shoe move naturally with your foot for a stable feel all day long.

The On Cloudmonster Hyper brings an unprecedented level of energy and cushioning to your runs.

This max-cushioned super trainer uses a layer of PEBAX-foam called a Bounceboard nestled directly underneath your forefoot, while Helion superfoam and CloudTec pods give you a bouncy, responsive and energetic run.

In the middle is Helion superfoam for a cushioned ride, while a layer of PEBAX-foam called a Bounceboard in the forefoot sits on top for a springy and energetic toe-off.
  • Outsole: A closed-channel outsole keeps rocks and debris out while giving you the grip to run confidently.

Shoe Comparison1Pick Your Perfect PairWomen's | On Cloudmonster HyperWomen's | On Cloudmonster 30Accordion1What's new

The Cloudmonster Hyper is a new shoe in On’s lineup that builds off their best-selling Cloudmonster 2. The Cloudmonster Hyper enters the super-trainer category with a tall stack height, lighter weight and propulsive PEBAX-foam Bounceboard that gives you energetic toe-offs without the rigidity that can come with a carbon plate.

Compared to the Cloudmonster 2, “The Cloudmonster Hyper is softer and I believe it’s a better overall shoe to run in,” says one of our run-testers, Brandon. “It’s lighter, faster, and just as stable underfoot as the Monster.”

Who It's Best For

From racing to daily training, the On Cloudmonster Hyper is a great option for runners looking for some extra pep in their step and would prefer to not run in a shoe with a carbon plate.

“The Cloudmonster Hyper is an ideal shoe for long runs and recovery days,” says Kate in our Cloudmonster Hyper review. “It seems to absorb a lot of impact and can be nice and protective if you’re putting a lot of miles in. I’d recommend this shoe to people who like a medium-cushioned shoe. It’s soft, responsive and not super squishy, which is a good thing in my book.”

Why You'll Love It

You’ll love the Cloudmonster Hyper’s combination of cushioning and energy return that keeps you comfortable for easy miles and lets you pick up the pace with ease if you’re racing or doing speedwork.

product.description:
Your long runs deserve a shoe that's built for them. The on Cloudmonster 3 Hyper takes everything runners love about the Cloudmonster platform and pushes it further—a taller stack height, a Pebax midsole pulled straight from On’s race-day supershoes and CloudTec cushioning tuned specifically for power and energy return. If you're training for a marathon, stacking back-to-back long runs or putting in the kind of miles that demand real cushioning without sacrificing pace, this is the shoe for you.

Details

  • Upper: A recycled polyester engineered mesh keeps things light and breathable over long efforts. The fit is secure and structured, with an engineered heel construction that locks your foot in place. It holds secure without squeezing, so comfort doesn't enter the conversation midway through your run.
  • Midsole: A full-length Helion HF top midsole is the same responsive foam On uses in their race day supershoes—delivering serious cushioning and high energy return underfoot. This isn't just plush cushioning for cushioning's sake. The foam actively returns energy with every stride, so your legs feel fresher longer. CloudTec pods are tuned specifically for power and energy return, working with the Pebax midsole to keep the ride lively deep into long runs.
  • Outsole: The forward-rolling geometry and CloudTec bottom unit support natural momentum through each stride. The rubber outsole offers solid traction and durability on roads.

And the CloudTec pods—tuned here specifically for power—keep the ride lively when you need it most. It's a long run shoe that actually helps you finish strong.00

product.description:
Smooth out your runs in the On Cloudsurfer Max.

The Cloudsurfer Max combines On's innovative double-layered CloudTec Phase cushioning with a subtle rocker design to guide you effortlessly through every mile. In our On Cloudsurfer Max review, run tester Tom said "The Cloudsurfer Max has taken the top spot in my rotation for most of my road miles. It provides a slight trampoline effect, whether I'm heel-striking or landing on my midfoot."

Details:

  • Upper: The smooth, engineered mesh construction delivers excellent breathability even on hot summer days. A flat knit ankle collar and stretchy tongue create a locked-in feel, while pillowy heel cushioning wraps your foot in comfort. The handy pull-tab makes slip-on easy without causing irritation during runs.
  • Midsole: The double-layered CloudTec Phase cushioning uses computer-based simulation technology to create the perfect balance of soft landings and energetic transitions. The unique oblong pods collapse like dominoes, rolling you smoothly from heel to toe with every step.
  • Outsole: Designed for road running with durable construction that maintains ground connection despite the generous stack height.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe Cloudsurfer Max brings double the cushioning power with its innovative double-layered CloudTec Phase technology. This AI-designed midsole system predicts foot-to-ground impact for perfectly tuned cushioning that's soft in the heel and firms up through the midfoot and forefoot. The high-volume interior accommodates runners with broader feet, while the deep-sitting design keeps you stable despite the generous stack height.Who It's Best ForThe On Cloudsurfer Max is perfect for runners seeking maximum cushioning without sacrificing responsiveness. It's ideal for half and full marathon training, daily miles and anyone who wants a reliable shoe that can handle everything from easy recovery runs to workout sessions. The roomy fit makes it especially great for runners with high-volume feet.Why You'll Love ItYou'll love how the Cloudsurfer Max makes every mile feel effortless, giving you the confidence to go the distance while keeping your legs fresh. Whether you're building base miles or tackling your biggest training goals, this shoe will roll you smoothly toward your next PR.00

product.description:
Run with confidence from start to finish in the On Cloudrunner 3.

Built for stable landings and smooth toe-offs, this supportive daily trainer features deeper CloudTec cavities and higher sidewalls that cradle your feet for a secure, confidence-inspiring ride. Whether you're just starting out or you're an experienced runner looking for reliable support, the Cloudrunner 3 gives you a stable yet responsive platform to feel energized and in control for every mile.

Details:

  • Upper: The well-padded construction features a cushy tongue and heel collar that hug your feet comfortably. Suede accents on the lacing system add a touch of style, while the high-quality materials create a premium feel that works for running and everyday wear.
  • Midsole: CloudTec cushioning uses deeper cavities that expand inward, allowing your feet to sit inside the shoe rather than on top of it for truly immersive support. The lightweight Helion superfoam creates a firm yet comfortable ride, while TPU heel clips provide gentle reinforcement on both sides without feeling cumbersome. The decoupled heel lets the shoe move with you naturally while maintaining that supportive platform.
  • Outsole: The wide base delivers stable, steady landings that help you feel connected to the ground. The design creates smooth transitions and predictable footing that builds confidence whether you're navigating tight turns or uneven surfaces.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe Cloudrunner 3 brings deeper CloudTec cavities for enhanced stability during landings and toe-offs, plus a more pronounced decoupled heel that allows for natural movement. It's slightly lighter than the previous version with a lower heel-to-toe drop for a more nimble, natural feel.Who It's Best ForThe On Cloudrunner 3 is a great option for runners and walkers at all levels who appreciate a firm, yet forgiving ride with steady support. Whether you have flexible feet that benefit from a little extra reinforcement or you simply prefer feeling planted and in control of your stride, this shoe provides that confidence-inspiring platform for daily training, walking and workouts.Why You'll Love ItYou’ll love the supportive and stable ride of the Cloudrunner 3 that makes every run more fun.00
product.productIntroText: The Cloudrunner 3 refines On's supportive everyday formula—a smooth, cushioned trainer with the stability and style runners can count on daily.

The heel cap is dialed in for an even more secure fit that allows for dexterity on the run. Plus, the new upper uses more recycled content than ever before.

Challenge yourself in comfort in the updated Cloudflow 3.0.

product.description:
The On Cloudultra delivers a plush ride on even the roughest of trails.

On engineered the Cloudultra trail shoe with double the Cloudtec for more cushion with each step. Designers packed the midsole with On’s feather-light Helion superfoam to absorb impact from uneven trail surfaces. Taking inspiration from On’s responsive Cloudventure, the midsole of the Cloudultra features a snappy Speedboard to power strong takeoffs as you cruise over the trails.

The Cloudultra features an updated outsole of closed Cloud elements to keeps stones and debris out. The Missiongrip outsole uses three distinct traction patterns to provide multi-directional grip on slippery terrain.

An updated, two-layer mesh upper is durable, yet extremely breathable thanks to perforations throughout. The upper is reinforced with ultra-light TPU and uses a sock-fit construction to hug your foot and provide the support you need as you run. An all-new Flip Release tab on the laces allows you to adjust the fit and relieve pressure as your feet swell while you run over long distances.

Whether you wear it for long trail runs or an ultramarathon, the On Cloudultra is built to provide comfort for the long haul.

The On Cloudspark’s dual-density midsole and nylon blend Speedboard gives you a propulsive ride and high-energy return you can feel.

  • Outsole: Rubber outsole for smooth grip and long-lasting durability.

Little kids move fast, and the On Cloudleap is built to keep up.

CloudTec Phase™ cushioning activates at lower weights so every step—from the playground to the school hallway—lands soft and takes off strong.   • Outsole: Rubber inserts at the heel and forefoot deliver grip on any surface, keeping little runners sure-footed wherever the day takes them.

The latest iteration of On’s Cloudswift sneaker comes with a major performance upgrade. With an updated knit upper, premium CloudTec® technology and sustainably-made Speedboard®, the Cloudswift 4 offers supreme comfort and breathability without compromising a sleek style.

  • Upper: Made from recycled polyester, this single piece of flat-knit engineered mesh allows maximum airflow. The perforated toe box boosts the shoe’s breathability. A pull-on tab at the heel and standard shoe lacing make securing the Cloudswift 4 a breeze.

  • Outsole: The classic rubber outsole gives the Cloudswift 4 ideal traction for road running on city streets.

product.description:
Unlock your speed with the On Cloudflow 5.

Built for the moments when you're ready to push beyond what feels comfortable, the Cloudflow 5 brings race-day technology to your everyday training. With breakthrough Helion™ HF hyper foam inspired by On's elite racing shoes and a glass fiber-infused Speedboard® that transforms every step into forward momentum, the Cloudflow 5 gives you that exhilarating feeling of truly letting loose.

Details:

  • Upper: Engineered woven mesh creates an ultralight, breathable fit that moves with you seamlessly. The updated toebox design accommodates your foot's natural expansion during intense efforts, while reflective elements keep you visible during those early morning or evening runs.
  • Midsole: Revolutionary Helion™ HF hyper foam delivers maximum energy return and rebound with every footstrike. Traditional CloudTec cushioning provides On's signature dynamic feel, while the rocker shape creates that addictive forward-rolling sensation that makes picking up the pace feel effortless. The nylon-blend Speedboard® infused with glass fibers creates powerful propulsion without the stiffness of full carbon.
  • Outsole: Forefoot grip pads add support during toe-off, helping you maintain control when the speed really kicks in.

The athlete-inspired design with bold logos and distinctive grip pads means you'll look the part while feeling the incredible energy return that comes from truly premium performance technology.Who It's Best ForThe On Cloudflow 5 welcomes every runner ready to add some serious speed to their training toolkit. It's perfect for athletes building toward breakthrough performances, recreational runners who want to feel what elite-level technology can do and anyone who's curious about exploring their faster gears.Why You'll Love ItYou'll love how the Cloudflow 5 makes speed feel accessible and fun rather than intimidating or exclusive.00

product.description:
Get comfortable for the long haul in the On Cloudultra 3.

Designed to handle your most demanding adventures, this hard-hitting trail shoe delivers incredible energy return and impressive cushioning that keeps you going strong hours into your run. Whether you're tackling rugged mountain terrain or pushing through technical single track, the Cloudultra 3 will keep your legs feeling fresh so you can enjoy the view.

Details:

  • Upper: The engineered Leno weave construction is as tough as it looks, featuring strategic zoning that's highly durable and abrasion-resistant where you need it most. The breathable, quick-dry design keeps your feet comfortable during those long hours on the trail, so you can focus on what’s ahead.
  • Midsole: The dual Helion HF hyperfoam midsole is engineered using cutting-edge Finite Element Analysis to deliver maximum energy return with plush cushioning that lasts. Combined with an engineered rocker design, every step propels you forward with efficiency that helps you tackle even the longest trail adventures.
  • Outsole: Meet On's most advanced grip ever. The redesigned Missiongrip outsole features a new lug profile developed through precision engineering to give you unparalleled traction and confidence on technical terrain. When the trail gets challenging, you'll have the grip to keep moving forward.

Built to make your trail runs feel effortless, this trail shoe combines On's computer-optimized CloudTec Phase technology with enhanced grip and an improved fit. Whether you're exploring local paths or tackling long stretches of singletrack, lace up the Cloudsurfer Trail 2 and enjoy the outdoors.

product.description:
The Cloudrunner 3 Max takes the reoriented CloudTec system that debuted on the Cloudrunner 3 and stacks a full layer of energetic Helion HF hyper foam on top of it. That pairing is the whole idea behind this shoe. The hyper foam handles softness and rebound up top while a layer of standard Helion foam underneath keeps the platform durable and predictable, so the ride feels cushioned and confident. At 38 mm in the heel and 30 mm at the forefoot, there's real height here, and the wide base and moderate forefoot rocker keep it grounded through every phase of your stride.

Support comes from the shape of the shoe rather than from anything that fights your foot. Higher sidewall cupping and a broad platform reduce side-to-side movement, and an asymmetric TPU heel cup wraps the rearfoot to hold it centered from the moment you land. A plush heel collar and molded foam tongue add a layer of plushness where the shoe meets your foot, and a heel clip locks everything down. Longer ground contact through the rocker means the transitions stay smooth whether you're running easy miles or walking a full day.

Details:

  • Upper: The engineered upper is built around a secure, comfortable fit with a plush heel collar and a molded foam tongue that stay put without pressure. A heel clip reinforces the rearfoot and works with the internal shaping to keep your foot centered on the platform.
  • Midsole: A dual-density Helion setup pairs a Helion HF hyper foam top layer for cushioning and rebound with a Helion foam bottom layer for durability and structure. The reoriented CloudTec pods sit underneath and compress in sequence for a stable ride, while higher sidewall cupping and an asymmetric TPU heel cup add support without adding stiffness. A moderate forefoot rocker encourages longer ground contact and smoother transitions.
  • Outsole: Rubber coverage in the high-wear zones handles the miles on pavement and keeps traction consistent on wet roads.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe Cloudrunner 3 Max carries over the reoriented CloudTec system introduced on the Cloudrunner 3 and adds a full layer of Helion HF hyper foam above it, pushing the stack height to 38 mm at the heel and 30 mm at the forefoot. An asymmetric TPU heel cup and higher sidewall cupping join the wide base to hold the foot centered, and the plush heel collar and molded foam tongue round out the fit. The result is more cushioning and more structure at once, beyond what earlier versions offered.Who It's Best ForRunners and walkers who want a stable, well-cushioned daily shoe, especially anyone building mileage for the first time or adding volume to an established routine. It's also a strong fit for people on their feet all day who want support that holds up through long hours.Why You'll Love ItYou get soft, high-stack comfort without the wobble that usually comes with it, so you can add miles with confidence. When your feet feel good at the end of a run, going farther next time feels a lot more likely.00
product.productIntroText: A max-cushioned stability trainer with dual-layer Helion foam, On's CloudTec® cushioning system and a wide, stable base built for beginner runners and high-mileage athletes who want confident, supported strides on every run.

The Cloudboom Strike 2 arrives at the starting line packing fifteen percent lighter foam, a stiffer carbon plate and a brand-new forefoot cushioning system. Evolved Helion HF compound delivers more resilience with less weight underfoot, while a lighter and stiffer full carbon fiber Speedboard drives more aggressive forward propulsion with every toe-off.

New CloudTec® Sphere technology in the forefoot allows multi-directional foam expansion for enhanced comfort and feel during the miles where cushioning needs to work hardest. Eliminating one of the most common sources of discomfort that shows up late in a marathon.

New CloudTec® Sphere technology in the forefoot allows multi-directional foam expansion for better comfort and feel across long efforts. A full carbon fiber Speedboard — lighter and stiffer than the previous version — channels energy forward with aggressive, efficient propulsion from start to finish.

product.description:
The On Cloudstratus 3 gives you cushioning, comfort and sustainability for a winning combination. The rolling sensation of this daily trainer will help push you forward on your runs to help you go just a little further. One of the best cushioned shoes out there, the double layer of On’s CloudTec technology not only looks cool but makes your feet feel like royalty. Plus, the Cloudstratus 3 is made with even more recycled materials, so you can feel good about helping out the planet.

Features

  • Upper: 100% Recycled Polyester Engineered Mesh. The newest Cloudstatus has removed all TPU and plastic overlays to be more eco-friendly and give it a sleeker look. An improved heel collar increases the comfort level both when you first step into the shoe as well as during your run. Our runners noticed it went up a little higher than usual in our On Cloudstratus 3 review.
  • Midsole: a combination of Helion™ Superfoam with a double layer of CloudTec and a Speedboard®. The Speedboard® is made of a nylon blend that maximizes your energy return and rolls you forward. The Helion™ Superfoam has been re-engineered to make it softer, especially when connected with the double layer of CloudTec technology that disperses your impact and provides cushioned landings.
  • Outsole: an updated rubber grip compound provides even more traction on the road. Designers reworked the base geometry to prevent rocks from collecting in the shoe.

product.description:
Stylish, lightweight and cushioned, the On Cloudsurfer gives you a smooth ride to roll through the miles.

This shoe is a complete reboot of the On Cloudsurfer. New CloudTec® Phase midsole technology gives you active cushioning that compresses and springs you forward. It collapses in a domino-like sequence to deliver cushion and a gentle heel-to-toe transition.

On uses a midsole that consists of a Helion™ Superfoam in an entirely new construction based on computer-optimized FEA engineering. Designers then eliminated the Speedboard® present in many of their other shoes to make the Cloudsurfer lighter, give you a more cushioned feel and reduce the chance of catching stones during your run. In our On Cloudsurfer review, one runner stated, "“After the first mile, I could confidently say that the Cloudsurfer is the softest pair of On running shoes I’ve ever run in.”

Super lightweight, this shoe can be used for walking, running and speedwork. Plus, lightweight rubber pads on the outsole give you durable traction in all conditions.

The upper gives you a plush step-in feel with a breathable engineered mesh.

On continues their efforts to make their shoes more sustainable by eliminating plastic overlays, while 30% of the shoe is made from recycled materials and uses dope dye technology that saves significant water in the dying process.

Feel like you are running on clouds in the On Cloudsurfer.

Feel luxurious support every step of the way in the On Cloudrunner.

This stylish shoe gives you a light and cushioned ride that encourages you to go that extra mile. The foam in this shoe cradles your foot and, when combined with the foam around the heel collar and plush tongue, gives it a comfortable feel from your very first step.

The CloudTec cushioning and ultra-light zero-gravity foam absorbs both the vertical and horizontal impact of every foot strike, making the ground feel soft as you run. Soft to the touch with plenty of ventilation, the Cloudrunner stays comfortable throughout your runs. “The Cloudrunner is soft and stable enough for longer runs, but light and responsive enough to get some tempo work in,” one tester said in our On Cloudrunner review.

Defy gravity in the On Cloudrunner.

product.description:
Keep your feet cool and dry, all while feeling luxurious support every step of the way in the On Cloudrunner Waterproof.

Featuring an upgraded 360-degree waterproof membrane upper, your feet will stay dry whether you are running in the rain or through puddles. The upper is Swiss-engineered to be breathable, while still protecting you from the elements.

This stylish shoe gives you a light and cushioned ride that encourages you to go that extra mile. The foam in this shoe cradles your foot and, when combined with the foam around the heel collar and plush tongue, gives it a comfortable feel from your very first step.

The CloudTec cushioning and ultra-light zero-gravity foam absorb both the vertical and horizontal impact of every foot strike, making the ground feel soft as you run. On’s signature Speedboard gives you the responsiveness and energy return to propel you forward. The wider bottom unit and cradle-shaped construction support you throughout your stride and help you run further. It also provides a bit of stability for those with flexible arches or who overpronate.

Defy gravity and stay dry in the On Cloudrunner.

product.description:
Stylish, lightweight and cushioned, the On Cloudsurfer gives you a smooth ride to roll through the miles.

This shoe is a complete reboot of the On Cloudsurfer. New CloudTec® Phase midsole technology gives you active cushioning that compresses and springs you forward. It collapses in a domino-like sequence to deliver cushion and a gentle heel-to-toe transition.

On uses a midsole that consists of a Helion™ Superfoam in an entirely new construction based on computer-optimized FEA engineering. Designers then eliminated the Speedboard® present in many of their other shoes to make the Cloudsurfer lighter, give you a more cushioned feel and reduce the chance of catching stones during your run.

Super lightweight, this shoe can be used for walking, running and speedwork. Plus, lightweight rubber pads on the outsole give you durable traction in all conditions.

The upper gives you a plush step-in feel with a breathable engineered mesh.

On continues their efforts to make their shoes more sustainable by eliminating plastic overlays, while 30% of the shoe is made from recycled materials and uses dope dye technology that saves significant water in the dying process.

Feel like you are running on clouds in the On Cloudsurfer.

product.description:
The On Cloudventure has been a faithful companion on countless outdoor adventures and trail runs. Now on its third iteration, the Cloudventure 3.0 continues to improve on its blend of traction and comfort and remains a versatile trail running shoe for daily training and hiking.

Reconnect to the ground with each step and feel in control on technical trails thanks to the addition of a split-design Speedboard and redesigned forefoot shape. This update gives the trail running shoe a better ground feel and a smoother heel-to-toe transition for a sensational ride through your local trail.

For endless miles of comfort on backpacking trips and long-run days, On uses its soft and responsive Helion™ superfoam and a lightweight, durable upper to keep your feet cool and protected.

The grip on the Cloudventure is second to none whether conditions are wet or dry, and its closed midsole channel means no more stones getting stuck underneath your foot.

If you’re looking for a trail running shoe that can just as easily replace your hiking boots, the On Cloudventure is ready for any adventure you can throw at it.

computed.product.reviewSummary: The On Cloud 5 earns high marks for its exceptional lightness and lasting comfort, often providing significant relief from foot and back discomfort, even for extended wear. While many appreciate the easy slip-on laces and versatile design for daily activities or walking, some reviewers note issues with the thin material in cold weather, heel slippage, or narrowness in the toe box.
product.description:
The On Cloud 5 looks good with anything—and can do a little bit of everything.

When you want one shoe for exercise, travel and everyday wear, look no further than the Cloud 5. It’s lightweight and breathable for HIIT classes, speed work or strength training, and has the style and comfort for running errands, travel or touring a new city.

The iconic look of these running shoes isn’t just for turning heads on the street—On’s unique CloudTec® cushioning feels like you’re walking on clouds and is great for staying comfortable and pain-free while you’re on your feet.

Plus, for those of us who stopped tying our laces a long time ago, the On Cloud’s speed lacing system makes it easy to slip them on and off.

With plenty of eye-catching colors to choose from, elevate your style and comfort with the On Cloud 5. Just don’t be surprised with all the compliments you get.

Read more: On Cloud 5 review.

product.description:
The On Cloud 5 Push gives you extra stability and comfort, so you can be your best all day long.

Featuring On’s signature Zero-Gravity CloudTec® technology, the individual clouds are Swiss-engineered to give you soft landings followed by explosive take-offs. The light, responsive sensation is perfect for travel, all day wear or the occasional jog. A Speedboard that is uniquely adapted to the Cloud Push adds power to your forward motion.

The On Cloud 5 Push features a tighter, athletic upper that provides added security, stability and an extra snug step-in feel, which is great if you are walking in the city or doing a HIIT class. Plus, it is made from 98% recycled materials.

The speed-lacing system allows you to slip your foot in quickly and holds it securely, which is perfect when your hands are full from the grocery store. A layered mesh fabric on the tongue and unique elastic function work in a net structure to provide plenty of stretch and breathability.

The On Cloud 5 Push looks as good as it feels on your feet.

product.description:
Don’t let a little rain or snow prevent you from running trails. The On Cloudventure Waterproof 3.0 is a shoe that can handle all the elements Mother Nature throws your way. It is a great lightweight waterproof trail option that still provides cushion and grip. This shoe typically runs a bit short, so we would recommend sizing up.

On has developed a membrane outer material that is 100% waterproof, but still lets your feet breathe. This material stretches to allow your foot to move freely over uneven terrain, but is a bit stiffer than the Men’s Cloudventure 3.0, making it a great option for hiking. They also included an elastic loop on the tongue, so you can tuck in your laces to prevent tripping over the ends.

The On Cloudventure Waterproof also has the same outsole as the On Cloudventure 3.0, featuring Missiongrip™, which combines different grip patterns so you can prevent slipping in wet conditions.

The split-designed Speedboard™ combined with a narrower midfoot allows for added torsion and lets your feet flow over rocks and roots. This shoe is moderately cushioned, making it perfect for those mid-distance to long-distance runs.

This shoe does great on hills or mountains. Strategically placed clouds absorb the impact while climbing uphill. The cushioning of the Gravity Cloud elements allow you to flow through the downhills.

If you are looking for a shoe that can handle any condition—be it mud, rain or snow—this is a great shoe for you.

Be ready for supreme comfort and support in the On Cloudflyer 4.

Whether you want to start running, run every day or enjoy a different workout every day, the Cloudflyer 4 gives you plush support thanks to bigger, dual-density CloudTec® technology.

This shoe features On’s unique Speedboard®, which is crafted with high-quality polypropylene and engineered for speed, while the Helion™ superfoam gives you highly responsive cushioning, so you can crush your next speed workout.

A wider platform, new molded sock-liner and external heel counter keep your foot as secure as it gets, making it perfect for those with flexible arches or who overpronate. The thicker laces in a star pattern give your forefoot extra support throughout your run.

This shoe provides serious comfort with a re-engineered mesh that improves durability and breathability. Plus, it has On’s plushest ever tongue. You can also feel good about wearing the On Cloudflyer 4—it contains 90-95% recycled polyester and a total of 35-40% recycled content overall, so it is both premium performance and planet-friendly.

The On Cloudflyer 4 gives you performance, stability, cushion and style—all in one shoe.

product.description:
Two of ASICS' bounciest foams are stacked on top of each other in the SONICBLAST 2, and you feel both of them doing their job on the run. FF TURBO SQUARED sits on top and gives you the springy, powerful return, while FF BLAST MAX underneath brings the cloud-like softness to your steps and handles impact absorption. A FF TURBO SQUARED trampoline pod sits at the forefoot to amplify the bounce right where you push off for an energetic ride.

The Pebax ASTROPLATE gives the shoe propulsion without locking your foot into one rhythm, so you get a faster feel underfoot and still keep the flexibility that makes the shoe equally enjoyable on an easy day.

Details:

  • Upper: Lightweight engineered mesh keeps your foot secure and reduces the need for extra overlays. The build is more breathable than the previous version, so air moves through when your pace and your temperature both climb.
  • Midsole: A two-layer foam setup pairs FF TURBO SQUARED on top for springy, powerful energy return with FF BLAST MAX underneath for cushioned softness and impact absorption. A FF TURBO SQUARED trampoline pod at the forefoot amplifies the bounce through toe-off, and the Pebax ASTROPLATE runs through the platform in a new forked shape that balances propulsion with flexibility.
  • Outsole: ASICSGRIP rubber gives you advanced traction across a variety of surfaces and holds its grip when you push into a corner at speed.

product.description:
Three things runners want from a daily trainer: comfort, responsiveness and versatility. The ASICS Novablast 6 delivers all three in a package that keeps getting better with every generation.

A dual-foam midsole pairs the proven softness of FF BLAST™ MAX with the addition of FF TURBO² foam — borrowed from ASICS' higher-performance lineup — to create a lively, bouncy ride that feels smooth and protective at easy paces and naturally responsive when you decide to pick things up. The new trampoline pod under the forefoot gives the shoe a springy, energetic quality that makes transitions feel effortless without ever tipping into the stiff, rigid feel of a plated shoe.

Details:

  • Upper: A new engineered woven upper is noticeably breathable and does an impressive job managing moisture. The fit strikes a smart balance between secure and roomy, wrapping the foot with structure through the midfoot and heel while giving your toes enough space to stay comfortable deep into longer efforts. No hot spots, no break-in period, no irritation — just a soft, premium step-in feel right out of the box.
  • Midsole: Dual-foam construction combines FF BLAST™ MAX for a soft, cushioned base with FF TURBO² foam at the forefoot for added bounce and energy return. The FF TURBO² trampoline pod creates a lively, responsive sensation underfoot that makes the Novablast 6 feel more refined and more fun than its predecessor — plush without being mushy, energetic without feeling stiff.
  • Outsole: ASICSGRIP™ rubber at the forefoot delivers improved traction for confident footing on road surfaces at any pace.
product.kitContent: Shoe Comparison1Pick Your Perfect PairMen's | ASICS Novablast 6Men's | ASICS Sonicblast 20Accordion1What's NewThe Novablast 6 adds FF TURBO² foam and a new trampoline pod to the midsole for a noticeably more energetic, responsive ride while preserving the soft, comfortable feel that made the shoe popular. An updated engineered woven upper improves breathability, fit and overall structure, making the Novablast 6 the most refined version of the shoe yet. A recycled polyester upper and dope-dyed sockliner reflect ASICS' continued commitment to more sustainable materials.Who It's Best ForRunners looking for a versatile daily trainer that handles easy miles, moderate efforts and all-day wear with equal confidence. The Novablast 6 is also a strong choice for runners who want a race day option without the stiffness or price tag of a carbon-plated shoe — the responsive, bouncy ride makes uptempo efforts feel natural and efficient without any of the trade-offs.Why You'll Love ItRare is the shoe that genuinely gets better with every version — and the Novablast 6 is exactly that. Whether you're running your first easy miles of the week or pushing toward something faster, this is the shoe you'll keep reaching for.00

product.description:
Land on clouds with the ASICS GEL-Nimbus 28.

One of the most comfortable shoes in the ASICS running lineup, the Nimbus 28 sheds approximately 25 grams while keeping the excellent cushioning that makes longer distances feel smoother and more manageable. The combination of FF BLAST PLUS foam and PureGEL technology creates lightweight and soft landings that help you stay comfortable from your first step to your final mile.

Details:

  • Upper: Engineered knit material softly wraps your feet in breathable comfort while using at least 75% recycled content. The lightweight construction reduces the need for extra overlays, keeping things simple and sustainable. Reflective details help keep you visible during early morning or evening runs.
  • Midsole: FF BLAST PLUS cushioning blends cloud-like softness with responsive feedback, giving you a ride that feels lighter than standard FF BLAST foam. PureGEL technology is approximately 65% softer than standard GEL, maintaining all the impact absorption properties ASICS is known for while feeling even more plush underfoot. The premium OrthoLite X-55 sockliner adds extra cushioning and moisture management to keep your feet comfortable and dry.
  • Outsole: HYBRID ASICSGRIP combines two rubber compounds—ASICSGRIP and AHARPLUS—for advanced grip on various surfaces and improved durability.

product.description:
The ASICS GEL-Kayano 31 combines innovative cushioning, adaptive stability and lightweight performance for an exceptional ride.

This premium stability shoe features energetic FF BLAST PLUS ECO midsole foam for cloud-like softness. In our review of the GEL-Kayano 31, run tester Spencer said, “I love the incredibly plush landing, which lasts through the entirety of my runs. As a higher cushion model, the Kayano 31 runs quite efficiently. The tall stack height still offers a lightweight feel instead of a clunky experience.”

Combined with a 4D Guidance System and an internal GEL cushioning compound in the heel for soft landings and smooth stability, the GEL-Kayano 31 is an incredible luxe and plush daily trainer that’s perfect for everything from long runs to standing on your feet all day.

Details:

  • Upper: A new engineered mesh upper and knit collar construction give this shoe a luxurious step-in experience while still keeping things breathable. Plus, an advanced pull-tab makes it easy to get the shoe on and off.
  • Midsole: FF BLAST PLUS ECO foam, ASICS’ softest and most energetic midsole foam made with 24 percent bio-based content gives you a plush and energetic underfoot experience. Then, the revolutionary 4D Guidance System provides on-demand pronation control through a flared midsole, wide base and medial guidance foam. Finally, lightweight PureGEL cushioning in the rearfoot delivers exceptional impact absorption.
  • Outsole: A combination of strategically placed ASICSGRIP™ and AHARPLUS™ outsole materials improves grip and softness without compromising durability.

Read more in our full ASICS GEL-Kayano 31 review.
product.kitContent:
Accordion1What’s NewThe GEL-Kayano 31 comes upgraded with a new engineered mesh upper and knit collar construction for a modernized look and amazing step-in feel that doesn’t compromise on weight or support. The outsole was also updated with a combination of ASICSGRIP™ and AHARPLUS™ rubber.Who It’s Best For

The ASICS GEL-Kayano 31 is a high-cushioned stability shoe for runners looking for a combination of softness and support during their runs.

“The Gel-Kayano 31 is tremendous for any type of distance running, ranging from 5K to marathon training,” says Spencer in our Kayano 31 review. “There was more turnover than I expected when I increased my cadence, and the shoe invites for a little bit of speed on account of its slight forward tilt. It’s agile enough for quick, short runs but durable enough to put miles and miles into.”

Why You’ll Love ItYou’ll love the adaptive stability features that keep you feeling supported when your legs get tired and the cloud-like cushioning that makes runs feel like a breeze.Sustainability50% recycled polyester upper. Dope dyed sockliner.00
product.title: Men's | ASICS Gel-Kayano 31

product.description:
Find stability and speed in the ASICS GEL-Kayano 28.

ASICS designers updated the GEL-Kayano 28 to include their fastest midsole foam, FF Blast. ASICS FF Blast foam is super lightweight and provides responsive rebound over long miles or intense speedwork. Signature GEL technology in the heel and forefoot of the Kayano 28 offers shock absorption and cushioning over landings and toe offs.

The GEL-Kayano 28 is an excellent stability shoe for those with low arches, overpronators, or runners who favor a more stabilized feeling on the go. ASICS DYNAMIC DUOMAX technology works with the midsole foam to reduce overpronation and prevent uneven wearing on the outsole.

Plus, 3D Space Construction in the forefoot offers gender-specific compression and added stability throughout the footbed of the shoe.

Find the lightweight stability you need to reach top speeds in the updated ASICS GEL-DS Trainer 26.

The redesigned upper and sockliner contour to your foot to provide the engaging support and comfort you need to move fast. The knit upper is flexible and breathable, moving naturally with your foot as you run. Plus, bold new colorways let you make a statement on the roads or the track.

What makes the GEL-DS Trainer 26 great for overpronators and stability-lovers alike is the dual density DUOMAX midsole system. Tactfully placed on the medial (inner) side of the shoe, a firmer midsole foam supports the natural inward roll of a pronating foot, offering stability and comfort. The DUOMAX system works with ASICS signature GEL cushioning system to absorb impact and create a stabilized ride.

A FLYTEFOAM midsole foam works with PROPULSION TRUSSTIC technology in the blown-rubber outsole to create a responsive, durable ride that will last you mile after mile.

The ASICS GEL-Cumulus 23 delivers customized comfort to every runner.

The updated GEL-Cumulus 23 includes a full-length bottom layer of FLYTEFOAM technology to deliver even more cushioning and a silky smooth ride. Lightweight FLYTEFOAM works with super-soft GEL cushioning to provide ideal shock absorption in the heel, creating supported landings and poppy take-offs.

In addition to the GEL tech, ASICS introduced its 3D Space Construction design to the Cumulus 23. This helps the shoe compress specifically to the individual runner’s needs without reducing the overall stability of the shoe. Plus, 3D Space Construction in the women’s model offers gender-specific cushioning and compression in the forefoot.

A seamless mesh upper is engineered from friction-free 3D printed mesh to wrap your foot in a perfectly secure, yet flexible, fit. The upper works with the blended midsole foams to deliver smooth transitions and cushioned landings mile after mile.

Step into luxury with the cushioned and supportive ASICS GEL-KAYANO® 29.

The GEL-KAYANO® has been around for decades and is now lighter, more cushioned and more stable than ever before. ASICS added their FF BLAST™ PLUS foam that gives you more bounce with each step.

Whether you are training for a marathon or wearing them to walk the dog, the ASICS GEL-KAYANO® 29 will bring you premium stability and a plush experience making it one of the best stability shoes available.

Details

  • Upper: The soft and supportive recycled stretch knit upper gives the Kayano a sleek profile and superior breathability and comfort. Our testers loved how the new upper because of its comfort and ability to fit a variety of footshapes in our ASICS GEL-KAYANO 29 review.
  • Midsole: Providing support and stability for people who overpronate or have flexible arches, the GEL-KAYANO® 29 features a LITETRUSS™ placed on the midsole’s inside angle that is designed to help keep your foot from rolling too far inward during your stride. The updated shoe also features a low-profile external heel counter that cradles your foot to keep it secure and provide rearfoot support.
  • Outsole: This newest version still features ASICS’ signature GEL technology that absorbs impact and feels amazing underfoot.

product.description:
Get ready to blast through your runs with the supportive ASICS GT-2000 v11.

This stability shoe has LITETRUSS™ technology positioned on the inside of the midsole that improves stability by preventing your foot from rolling too far inward to give you a smoother stride.

ASICS re-engineered the GT-2000’s midsole by adding FF BLAST™ cushioning for extra bounce at toe-off and more energy return with every stride. The result is a comfortable shoe that gets you excited to run. Our testers loved the feeling in our ASICS GT-2000 v 11 review, "The ASICS GT-2000 11 is stable in the heel with flexibility in the forefoot, which I find to be a comfortable combination. The shoes feel lightweight and offer smooth transitions with just the right amount of pep."

The upper of the new GT-2000 is made with a jacquard mesh that provides a supportive and comfortable foothold. ASICS’ Adaptive Fit technology allows the breathable mesh upper to adapt to your foot’s natural shape so it can fit a variety of foot shapes. Plus, at least 50% of the upper material is made with recycled content to reduce waste and carbon emissions, so you can feel good about wearing it.

Whether you are running your 50th marathon or your first 5K, the ASICS GT-2000 v11 is a lightweight, energetic shoe that will help you get to the finish line.

Designers updated the upper with recycled materials to give you more breathability and a more adaptive fit. Finally, ASICS improved the LITETRUSS system by beveling the heel with gel cushioning to give you more support and a smoother ride. Who It’s Best ForFrom long runs to fast-paced speedwork, the ASICS GT-2000 v11 is a great stability trainer with enough cushioning to be your everyday workhorse running shoe. product.description:
For 30 years, ASICS has been revolutionizing comfort, technology and stability to make the ASICS Gel-Kayano 30 the best version yet.

Designers have created a shoe that feels cozy the moment you step into it and steady as you take on those longer runs. In our ASICS Gel-Kayano 30 review, one of our runners even stated that it felt as comfortable as her house slippers.

Stability never felt more comfortable than in the ASICS Gel-Kayano 30.

Details:

  • Upper: The plush and comfortable engineered mesh upper provides support and breathability, ensuring a perfect fit that feels as comfortable as house slippers.
  • Midsole: The midsole incorporates fan-favorite FF Blast™ Plus Eco foam for a super cushioned and energetic ride, along with PureGel cushioning in the rearfoot to absorb impact. An arched recovery pod helps position your arch for a balanced stride.
  • Outsole: ASICS widened the base to enhance stability and beveled the heel for better initial ground impact, contributing to the smoothest, most cushioned, and comfortable ride.
product.kitContent:
Accordion1What’s New

ASICS replaced the Litetruss™ system with a 4D Guidance System, incorporating a medial foam unit and redesigned shoe geometry based on biomedical research to enhance stability. They introduced the new FF Blast Plus Eco foam, crafted from 24% bio-based materials, which offers a softer and lighter feel. Additionally, they upgraded the PureGel rearfoot unit, making it 65% softer than traditional gel cushioning.

Who It’s Best ForThe ASICS Gel-Kayano 30 is great for beginners or experienced runners and walkers alike. It works best for those who have flexible arches or overpronate and like a super cushioned and plush ride. This shoe feels amazing whether you are running a marathon or just need a good pair of sneakers to play with your kids.Why You’ll Love ItYou will love how the ASICS Gel-Kayano 30 provides luxurious cushioning and support for every run or walk. 00

product.description:
The ASICS GEL-Kayano 31 combines innovative cushioning, adaptive stability and lightweight performance for an exceptional ride.

This premium stability shoe features energetic FF BLAST PLUS ECO midsole foam for cloud-like softness. In our review of the GEL-Kayano 31, run tester Spencer said, “I love the incredibly plush landing, which lasts through the entirety of my runs. As a higher cushion model, the Kayano 31 runs quite efficiently. The tall stack height still offers a lightweight feel instead of a clunky experience.”

Combined with a 4D Guidance System and an internal GEL cushioning compound in the heel for soft landings and smooth stability, the GEL-Kayano 31 is an incredible luxe and plush daily trainer that’s perfect for everything from long runs to standing on your feet all day.

Details:

  • Upper: A new engineered mesh upper and knit collar construction give this shoe a luxurious step-in experience while still keeping things breathable. Plus, an advanced pull-tab makes it easy to get the shoe on and off.
  • Midsole: FF BLAST PLUS ECO foam, ASICS’ softest and most energetic midsole foam made with 24 percent bio-based content gives you a plush and energetic underfoot experience. Then, the revolutionary 4D Guidance System provides on-demand pronation control through a flared midsole, wide base and medial guidance foam. Finally, lightweight PureGEL cushioning in the rearfoot delivers exceptional impact absorption.
  • Outsole: A combination of strategically placed ASICSGRIP™ and AHARPLUS™ outsole materials improves grip and softness without compromising durability.

Read more in our full ASICS GEL-Kayano 31 review.
product.kitContent:
Accordion1What’s NewThe GEL-Kayano 31 comes upgraded with a new engineered mesh upper and knit collar construction for a modernized look and amazing step-in feel that doesn’t compromise on weight or support. The outsole was also updated with a combination of ASICSGRIP™ and AHARPLUS™ rubber.Who It’s Best For

The ASICS GEL-Kayano 31 is a high-cushioned stability shoe for runners looking for a combination of softness and support during their runs.

“The Gel-Kayano 31 is tremendous for any type of distance running, ranging from 5K to marathon training,” says Spencer in our Kayano 31 review. “There was more turnover than I expected when I increased my cadence, and the shoe invites for a little bit of speed on account of its slight forward tilt. It’s agile enough for quick, short runs but durable enough to put miles and miles into.”

Why You’ll Love ItYou’ll love the adaptive stability features that keep you feeling supported when your legs get tired and the cloud-like cushioning that makes runs feel like a breeze.Sustainability50% recycled polyester upper. Dope dyed sockliner.00

The ASICS Superblast 2 transforms your run from feeling ordinary to super.

The Superblast 2 was designed to give you the most responsive and energized experience among ASICS’ cushioning shoes. It features an ultralight construction combined with a new dual-layer midsole that integrates FF BLAST TURBO™ cushioning, ensuring a soft and bouncy ride.

In our ASICS Superblast 2 review, shoe reviewer Heather said, “It somehow manages to feel both soft and firm at the same time. I feel connected to the ground while also feeling like I have miniature trampolines on my feet. It’s bouncy and exciting to run in without feeling out of control. I look forward to my long runs with this shoe underfoot.”

  • Upper: An asymmetrical mesh upper improves airflow to help your feet keep cool. The gusseted tongue keeps your midfoot secure and reduces sliding.

  • Outsole: The ASICSGRIP™ outsole improves durability and responsiveness, giving you excellent traction and stability during your runs.

product.description:
Soft as a marshmallow, the ASICS Gel-Nimbus™ 26 Paris will give you a luxurious and plush experience every step of the way.

Whether you’re walking, running or working all day the Gel-Nimbus 26 will get you excited to lace up your sneakers. One of the best cushioned running shoes, you will feel like you're floating on the pavement as you workout. One runner even stated, “From the cushioning in the heel collar to the whole underfoot feel, it’s soft, soft, soft. When I run in these, I feel protected from the impact of the road since there’s such a tall stack of plush cushion,” in our ASICS Gel-Nimbus 26 review. Plus, they are pretty darn stylish too.

Details:

  • Upper: A lightweight engineered knit upper gives you plenty of breathability, style and comfort. There is a new and improved midfoot hold to create a more supportive fit. ASICS updated the knit collar construction which improved the fit and feel and made it easier to put on as well.
  • Midsole: The FF Blast™ Plus Eco is a light and energetic foam that provides you with a soft and plush ride. There is Puregel™ at the heel which provides additional cushioning, is lighter weight and is 65% softer than conventional visible GEL™ technology. It also has 24% bio content to make its construction sustainable.
  • Outsole: A new hybrid outsole combines ASICSGRIP™ and AHAR™ outsole rubbers to give you better traction and improved softness, while still being durable enough to keep up with your miles.

This shoe will put a spring in your step with its bouncy cushioning system, trampoline-inspired outsole and plush, comfortable upper that wraps around your feet. One runner even mentioned this shoe made him smile all run long in our ASICS Novablast 4 review, saying ”it’s got a density to it, but it also feels very energetic and springy.”

Details

  • Upper: A breathable woven upper delivers a plush, comfortable fit with plenty of stretch, ventilation and durability. The padded mesh tongue has a wing construction to help make the shoe fit better and reduce any tongue slippage. At least 75% of the shoe’s upper materials are made with recycled materials.
  • Midsole: FF Blast™ Plus Eco cushioning provides plenty of bounce and comfort. It is made with approximately 20% bio-based content for more sustainability.
  • Outsole: The AHAR® outsole is nice and durable. The outsole design was inspired by a trampoline to provide a more responsive bounce as you run.

product.description:
The ASICS GT-2000 v13 adapts to your every move for comfortable, confident strides.

This classic stability shoe has been a go-to of runners and walkers for years. It reliably delivers cloud-like cushioning on a stable platform to give you a smooth and balanced ride from heel strike to toe-off.

Details:

  • Upper: The jacquard mesh upper gives you a supportive, comfortable fit and incorporates at least 50% recycled content. It also has reflective details to help you stay visible during those early morning or evening runs.
  • Midsole: A full-length FF BLAST™ PLUS midsole with PureGEL™ technology in the heel delivers an energized toe-off with plush softness underfoot. The innovative 3D GUIDANCE SYSTEM™ technology provides on-demand support, ensuring a smooth transition from heel strike to toe-off.
  • Outsole: The lightweight AHARPLUS™ heel plug and AHAR™ LOW HARDNESS outsole improve durability without compromising flexibility.

product.description:
The ASICS GlideRide Max is the ultimate distance cruiser designed for smooth, consistent training.

ASICS’ FFBLAST™ MAX foam and a rockered geometry deliver amazing cushioning and responsiveness with every stride, so whether you're logging daily miles or training for a marathon, the GlideRide Max will give you unparalleled comfort and efficiency for your long-distance pursuits.

Details:

  • Upper: An engineered mesh upper improves breathability and the OrthoLite™X-55 sockliner gives you soft step-in comfort.
  • Midsole: FFBLAST™MAX cushioning, ASICS' most responsive foam, delivers cloud-like softness and exceptional responsiveness. Below that sits FFBLAST™PLUS ECO foam, made with at least 20% renewable resources, for lightweight, energetic performance. The innovative GUIDESOLE™ technology reduces ankle flexion and promotes efficient toe-offs, while the rockered sole design helps you glide through your miles with less effort.
  • Outsole: The AHARPLUS™ outsole improves durability for long training weeks and hybrid ASICSGRIP technology gives you reliable traction.

Prepare for blast-off in the ASICS Novablast 5.

This high-cushioned daily trainer will take your run to new heights thanks to its trampoline-inspired outsole and new FF BLAST MAX foam that gives your runs a dynamic bounce and responsive energy return.

In our ASICS Novablast 5 review, wear-tester Mandy said, “The new FF BLAST MAX cushioning gave me the perfect combination of bounce and cushion while remaining lightweight.”

Details:

  • Midsole: New FF BLAST MAX foam delivers an enhanced bounce and responsiveness while maintaining the shoe's signature lightweight feel.
  • Outsole: The outsole retains its distinctive trampoline-inspired geometry that's made the Novablast series a favorite for many runners. A soft AHAR® LO outsole is durable and improves traction on a variety of surfaces.

product.description:
Enjoy cloud-like comfort with the ASICS GEL-Nimbus 27, featuring enhanced cushioning and breathability for your daily miles.

This latest version of ASICS' premium daily trainer adds 2 mm of softer FF BLAST PLUS ECO cushioning while maintaining its lightweight feel thanks to an airy jacquard mesh upper. Whether you're logging easy miles or recovering from a long run, the Nimbus 27 delivers a plush, stable ride that's made it a favorite among comfort-seeking runners.

Read what our wear-testers thought in our full ASICS Gel-Nimbus 27 review.

Details:

  • Upper: Light, breathable jacquard mesh with a padded collar and stretchy tongue keep you secure and comfortable all-day
  • Midsole: Soft FF BLAST PLUS ECO foam and an increased stack height give you maximum cushioning for a smooth, soft ride
  • Outsole: Durable rubber provides reliable traction and smooth transitions

In our Nimbus 27 review, wear tester Caroline said, “Thanks to an extremely high stack height and plenty of soft FF BLAST ECO FOAM cushioning underfoot, the Nimbus 27 is a cushion-lover’s dream come true. product.description:
Whether you’re going for a run, walking around the neighborhood or just want a reliable pair of shoes to spend all day in, the ASICS Gel-Cumulus 27 has your back.

This trusted daily trainer delivers that perfect sweet spot of cushioning and responsiveness that makes every step feel natural and fluid. FF BLAST PLUS™ midsole foam with PureGEL™ in the heel gives you enough cushioning for soft landings, while the mesh upper keeps you comfortable and locked in.

Details:

  • Upper: A comfortable and secure engineered mesh wraps your foot like a gentle hug. The updated design features a thicker tongue that stays in place while a handy pull tab makes slipping these on a breeze.
  • Midsole: FF BLAST PLUS™ foam creates that Goldilocks feeling—not too soft, not too firm. Combined with PureGEL™ technology in the heel, the Cumulus 27 gives you smooth landings that let you focus your run.
  • Outsole: The durable outsole design gives you reliable traction on the roads while maintaining a balance between grip and flexibility.

The slightly thicker outsole adds durability without compromising the balanced ride you know and love. Whether you're taking your first steps into running or training for your next big race, this shoe feels right for just about any distance or activity.Why You'll Love ItYou'll love the Cumulus 27 familiar comfort and dependable ride. It's the kind of shoe that lets you forget about your feet so you can focus on enjoying the run ahead.00

product.description:
The ASICS GEL-Kayano 32 delivers smooth support and stability with every step.

Built on ASICS' innovative 4D Guidance System, this shoe works with your natural movement to deliver structured support that feels smooth and natural. The thick stack of FF BLAST™ PLUS cushioning provides reliable comfort mile after mile, while the flared midsole gives you that ultra-stable platform you can count on through every step of your gait cycle.

In our review of the ASICS GEL-Kayano 32, run tester Heather said, "The Kayano seemed to disappear on my foot while I enjoyed some easy Saturday morning miles with my husband, which is a great thing. It felt nice and natural, which is exactly the goal of the 4D Guidance system in the shoe."

Details:

  • Upper: The engineered stretch knit material adapts to your foot shape while staying breathable on those long runs. ASICS' 3D Space Construction technology creates different compression patterns for men's and women's models, ensuring the perfect step-in comfort that recognizes we all have different needs.
  • Midsole: FF BLAST™ PLUS foam delivers structured cushioning that absorbs impact without feeling squishy or unstable. The 4D Guidance System includes resilient foam right under your arch for extra reinforcement and a touch of energy return, while the rounded heel bevel helps control impact as you land. A flared midsole extends beyond the upper to create a wider, more stable platform for confident landings and smooth toe-offs.
  • Outsole: The HYBRID ASICSGRIP™ outsole combines ASICSGRIP™ rubber and AHARPLUS™ materials to give you advanced grip and durability.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewASICS refined the Kayano 32 by reducing the heel-to-toe drop from 10 mm to 8 mm, adding extra foam under the forefoot for smoother transitions. They've also returned to the engineered knit upper after feedback about breathability issues with the previous mesh version. The result is a shoe that honors the Kayano's supportive legacy while delivering the smooth, natural feel that today's runners expect.Who It's Best ForThe ASICS GEL-Kayano 32 is perfect for runners who want to feel confident and supported in every step. Whether you're building your weekly mileage, returning from time off or simply prefer a structured, stable feel underfoot, this shoe delivers the reliability you need. It's also great for anyone who spends long hours on their feet and wants that extra layer of support and comfort.Why You'll Love ItYou'll love how this shoe just disappears on your feet, letting you focus on the conversation with your running buddy or that podcast that makes the miles fly by. The solid, structured feel gives you peace of mind on uneven pavement and tight corners, while the 4D Guidance System works so naturally you won't even think about it.00
product.productIntroText: The GEL-Kayano 32 is built for the long haul—premium cushioning and structured support for runners and walkers who put in the miles.
product.title: Men's | ASICS Gel-Kayano 32

Outfitter's Note: this is a UNISEX-sized shoe. Men's sizes are shown — women should order 1.5 sizes below their standard running shoe size. For example: for a women's size 9.5 shoe, order a size 8.

Start fast and finish faster in the ASICS METASPEED™ SKY TOKYO.

Built specifically for stride-style runners who naturally lengthen their steps when they speed up, the METASPEED SKY TOKYO features a flatter carbon plate positioned on top of revolutionary FF LEAP cushioning to propel you upward with every stride (If you change your cadence to run faster, then the ASICS METASPEED EDGE TOKYO was designed for you). Speed feels natural in the ASICS Sonicblast.

Ready to graduate from everyday training shoes to something snappier? The Sonicblast combines the familiar comfort of FF BLAST MAX cushioning with ultra-bouncy FF Turbo² foam and a flexible Pebax Astroplate to create a springy ride that thrives at faster paces. In our ASICS Sonicblast review, wear-tester Heather said "The FF Turbo² foam felt light and responsive, and it's just an exciting shoe to run in."

Details:

  • Upper: The jacquard woven construction delivers that "just right" Goldilocks fit—not too loose, not too tight, but perfectly dialed in. The traditional feel includes a thin, stretchy tongue and slightly padded heel collar that disappears on your foot once you start moving, letting you focus entirely on your run.
  • Midsole: The innovative dual-layer design places FF BLAST MAX on the bottom for stability and familiar comfort, topped with FF Turbo² foam for that wild energy return. The teardrop-shaped Pebax Astroplate flexes naturally between the layers, creating an experience that's firm and engaging without feeling harsh or unforgiving.
  • Outsole: ASICSGRIP technology gives you the confidence to tackle any surface, so you can focus on enjoying your run instead of worrying about your footing.

product.description:
Run with confidence in the ASICS GT-2000 14.

Built for runners who need supportive stability without giving up that energetic feel, this versatile daily trainer combines FF BLAST MAX cushioning with ASICS’ 3D GUIDANCE SYSTEM to keep your stride balanced and your runs enjoyable. The innovative trampoline-inspired forefoot pod helps create better stability while giving you that extra bounce when you push off — because support and speed work better together.

Details:

  • Upper: The breathable woven mesh keeps your feet comfortable and dry, while using at least 50% recycled materials. The asymmetric tongue wing provides a secure midfoot feel without shifting around during your run, and reflective details help keep you visible during early morning or evening miles.
  • Midsole: Full-length FF BLAST MAX foam provides one of ASICS' lightest, most energetic cushioning experiences. The 3D GUIDANCE SYSTEM offers adaptive stability that guides your feet forward from landing through toe-off, while rearfoot PureGEL technology under the heel delivers shock absorption and soft landings.
  • Outsole: A bouncy, trampoline-inspired forefoot pod strategically placed in the outsole gives you an amplified toe-off with added stability, helping you maintain momentum through your stride. AHAR® LO outsole rubber placed in key areas of the outsole give you reliable grip and traction, while ASICS' pinnacle high abrasion resistant rubber, AHARPLUS™, located in the heel is approximately three times more durable than standard outsole rubbers.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe GT-2000 v14 upgrades to full-length FF BLAST MAX cushioning for a more energized ride compared to the previous FF BLAST PLUS foam. The new engineered woven upper provides better fit and durability, while the trampoline-inspired forefoot pod adds stability and energy return to your stride.Who It's Best ForThe ASICS GT-2000 v14 is a versatile daily trainer that works well for anyone seeking reliable support without the bulk, making it ideal for training runs, tempo work and everyday miles.Why You'll Love ItYou'll love how the GT-2000 14 gives you the stability you need without weighing you down, letting you focus on your pace and performance rather than worrying about your stride.00

Run with confidence in the ASICS GT-2000 14.

Built for runners who need supportive stability without giving up that energetic feel, this versatile daily trainer combines FF BLAST MAX cushioning with ASICS’ 3D GUIDANCE SYSTEM to keep your stride balanced and your runs enjoyable. The innovative trampoline-inspired forefoot pod helps create better stability while giving you that extra bounce when you push off—because support and speed work better together.

AHAR® LO outsole rubber placed in key areas of the outsole give you reliable grip and traction, while ASICS' pinnacle high abrasion resistant rubber, AHARPLUS™, located in the heel is approximately three times more durable than standard outsole rubbers.
