The METASLEEK is built to make you stronger, not just faster. The FF TURBO² midsole is light and responsive, but it skips the exaggerated rocker and toe spring you'll find on most race shoes, so your lower legs do the real work. Train in it, and race day feels earned.

Underfoot, a lower stack height keeps you close to the ground, so you can feel what your feet and legs are doing as you run. The ASICSGRIP outsole bites into fast turns and quick paces without wearing down early.

Whether you're running short repeats, chasing track splits or just building toward race shape, the METASLEEK rewards the work you put in.

Details:

  • Upper: Light padding wraps the collar for extra comfort where the shoe meets your ankle. MOTION WRAP 3.0 gives the upper a sheer, barely-there feel, fitting snugly through the heel and midfoot while leaving more room through the toe box. This lightweight, breathable design lets your toes splay and push off naturally. Slim sawtooth laces are attached to the tongue to help keep them from shifting mid-run.
  • Midsole: FF TURBO² superfoam is a featherweight midsole material typically reserved for racing shoes, and it's the most responsive TURBO foam ASICS has built to date. There's no exaggerated toe spring or aggressive rocker up front, so your lower leg muscles stay in charge. Train in this shoe, and your race day speed will be unmatched.
  • Outsole: ASICSGRIP rubber gives this outsole its grip, keeping traction high without minimizing softness underfoot or durability over time. It's smooth on the surface but grippy where it counts, so the outsole can dig into the pavement when you're hitting top-end paces.

Note: This product runs short. Consider purchasing a half size up from your standard running shoe size.

The ASICS GT-2000 v12 Trail combines lightweight comfort and stability with a durable and grippy trail outsole, so you can take your runs off-road.

  • Outsole: A hybrid trail/road tread pattern is built into the outsole so you can run wherever the wind takes you.

product.description:
The carbon-plated ASICS MetaSpeed Edge is built to crush your PRs.

This is a shoe for cadence-style runners who change cadence easier as they run faster. (If you change your stride to run faster, then the ASICS MetaSeed Sky. was designed for you). The MetaSpeed Edge features ASICS’ FF BLAST TURBO™, a lightweight cushion that improves compression and creates a responsive feel underfoot. This is combined with a carbon plate to guide and propel your foot forward.

The MetaSpeed Edge’s curved sole design helps to reduce ankle flexion, which allows runners to conserve more energy and run further. The ASICSGRIP™ outsole is grippy to handle twists and turns (as well as wet pavement) on race day. This shoe is stable, with a lower stack height and firmer cushion than other carbon-plated shoes, which makes it great for 5K to half marathons, particularly if they have a lot of twists and turns.

The upper is light, breathable and a bit stiff, so you can get a good lockdown feel and run those corners with ease. This shoe fits a bit narrower and shorter than other ASICS shoes, so if you are in between sizes, you may want to get a half size larger.

Start fast and finish faster in the ASICS MetaSpeed Edge.

Whether you are going for long runs or short walks, the versatile ASICS GEL-Cumulus 25 will give you a cushioned and peppy ride every step of the way.

Get ready for soft landings and snappy take-offs. ASICS’ new PureGel™ technology and FF Blast™ Plus foam give you pillow-like landings and responsive take-offs. Designers added 2 mm of cushioning underfoot to give you a plusher experience, while the PureGel pods in the rearfoot offer plenty of shock absorption during your run.

Fleet Feet runners loved the new cushioning in our ASICS Gel-Cumulus 25 review and how it added versatility to the shoe. One runner even said "for a daily trainer, they handled uptempo miles like a secret race-day shoe. I felt both light on my feet and protected."

The engineered jacquard layered mesh upper is stylish and comfortable with a gusseted tongue that wraps around your foot like a gentle hug. Plus, it’s environmentally friendly, with over 90 percent of the polyester materials used coming from recycled sources, making it one of the best sustainable running shoes.

Every run will feel like you are floating in the lightweight and cushioned ASICS GEL-Cumulus 25

Cover the court from net to baseline in the ASICS Gel-Challenger 14.

Wherever the ball goes, you’ll be there—this court shoe has the stability and support to help you make hard cuts and quick changes of direction during your tennis or pickleball matches.   • Outsole: An AHARPLUS™ outsole improves durability and features a separated heel construction to help you experience better stability during abrupt landings.

You’ll feel a spring in your step when you’re running the trails in the ASICS Novablast 3 TR.

Part of ASICS’ NATURE BATHING™ Collection, this trail version of the popular Novablast road shoe is inspired by the Japanese phrase, "shirin yoku," which translates to “forest bathing.” It features a trail-specific AHAR™ outsole that is more durable and functional for going off-road on gravel or light trails.

The Novablast 3 TR now features FF BLAST™ PLUS foam that creates a more energizing rebound coupled with a trampoline-inspired outsole design. ASICS also added more cushioning, while making the shoe significantly lighter with its new midsole compound. Reviewers loved the light, bouncy ride in our ASICS Novablast 3 review.

A heel stabilizer supports the foot to give you a more balanced stride, while the gusseted tongue wing fit system improves the midfoot fit and reduces any tongue sliding. Inspired by geometric origami, the upper not only looks fast, but the new engineered monofilament mesh keeps the foot cool and comfortable as your run heats up.

The ASICS Novablast 3 TR is a great everyday trainer that provides a lively, cushioned ride.

product.description:
The ASICS GT-2000™ v10 keeps your mind and body focused on the road ahead. This great moderate stability everyday trainer has gotten an update to provide a smoother and more stable ride.

ASICS GT-2000 is perfect for those runners with flexible arches that need a little extra stability. The new LITETRUSS™ technology provides for a more accommodative stability feature, enhancing midfoot durability without overcorrecting the runner. They added 3D SPACE CONSTRUCTION™ creates a more comfortable running experience tuned for the biomechanical differences of male and female runners without reducing stability.

Previously, the GT-2000 had two different uppers: engineered mesh and knit. The new version combines the best features of each with its new engineered knit upper. It delivers the look and feel of knit, with the fit, structure and function of engineered mesh. It offers a more secure and comfortable fit, wrapping around the foot like a second skin. The engineered knit modernizes the visual appearance of the shoe and softens the experience, while maintaining the durability and performance of previous versions.

ASICS added 2mm of their FLYTEFOAM® Propel cushioning under the forefoot and added an additional flex groove on the bottom insole for a softer, bouncier experience. This changed the shoe to an 8mm heel-to-toe offset. The change in offset combined with the new full ground contact on the outsole translates into a smoother, more efficient ride. The combination of Flytefoam® Propel, Flytefoam® and gel make this shoe lightweight, plush and comfortable.

This is a great update to ASICS’ go-to moderate stability shoe that is perfect for someone running their first 5K or their 100th marathon. Check out our review on the GT-2000 v10 to learn more.

product.description:
Run for miles in the soft, comfortable ASICS GEL-Cumulus 24.

The legendary ASICS GEL-Cumulus gets an update to make it softer and more plush. ASICS added FF Blast foam to the midsole that gives it a soft, responsive ride. Plus, designers increased the stack height of the foam to give you a more comfortable run. ASICS’ signature rearfoot and forefoot gel technology provides impact absorption and a softer feeling at the forefoot.

ASICS use their gender-specific 3D Space Construction, which compresses differently to address the biological differences between men’s and women’s feet. They also continued their trend of decreasing the heel-to-toe drop from previous models to provide full ground contact for a smoother and more efficient run.

The new outsole of the GEL-Cumulus 24 is made of ASICS Lite and contains flex grooves to give you some flexibility at push off. This is a stronger and more durable material than standard outsoles. Testers loved the new outsole in the GEL-Cumulus because it gives traction and grip, while being minimal and durable in our ASICS GEL-Cumulus 24 review.

The jacquard mesh upper wraps around your foot for a comfortable fit. The new mesh is more breathable to prevent your feet from sweating when you are bringing the heat during your run. It also stays true to ASICS sustainability measures and is made with recycled materials to reduce waste and carbon emissions. The tongue and heel are both padded to provide the ultimate in comfort and the tongue is semi-gusseted, so it stays in place throughout the run.

Although it is known as one of the best running shoes for beginners, the ASICS GEL-Cumulus 24 is a workhorse of a shoe for anyone who is running or walking.

Watch our video review of the ASICS Gel-Cumulus 24 with insights from Paul Lang, ASICS senior merchandising manager.

The carbon-plated ASICS MetaSpeed Edge is built to crush your PRs.

This is a shoe for cadence-style runners who change cadence easier as they run faster. (If you change your stride to run faster, then the ASICS MetaSeed Sky. was designed for you). The MetaSpeed Edge features ASICS’ FF BLAST TURBO™, a lightweight cushion that improves compression and creates a responsive feel underfoot. This is combined with a carbon plate to guide and propel your foot forward.

The MetaSpeed Edge’s curved sole design helps to reduce ankle flexion, which allows runners to conserve more energy and run further. The ASICSGRIP™ outsole is grippy to handle twists and turns (as well as wet pavement) on race day. This shoe is stable, with a lower stack height and firmer cushion than other carbon-plated shoes, which makes it great for 5K to half marathons, particularly if they have a lot of twists and turns.

The upper is light, breathable and a bit stiff, so you can get a good lockdown feel and run those corners with ease. This shoe fits a bit narrower and shorter than other ASICS shoes, so if you are in between sizes, you may want to get a half size larger.

Start fast and finish faster in the ASICS MetaSpeed Edge.

product.description:
The carbon-plated ASICS MetaSpeed Edge Paris is built to crush your PRs.

This is a shoe for cadence-style runners who change cadence easier as they run faster. (If you change your stride to run faster, then the ASICS MetaSeed Sky. was designed for you). The MetaSpeed Edge features ASICS’ FF BLAST TURBO™, a lightweight cushion that improves compression and creates a responsive feel underfoot. This is combined with a carbon plate to guide and propel your foot forward.

The MetaSpeed Edge’s curved sole design helps to reduce ankle flexion, which allows runners to conserve more energy and run further. The ASICSGRIP™ outsole is grippy to handle twists and turns (as well as wet pavement) on race day. This shoe is stable, with a lower stack height and firmer cushion than other carbon-plated shoes, which makes it great for 5K to half marathons, particularly if they have a lot of twists and turns.

The upper is light, breathable and a bit stiff, so you can get a good lockdown feel and run those corners with ease. This shoe fits a bit narrower and shorter than other ASICS shoes, so if you are in between sizes, you may want to get a half size larger.

Start fast and finish faster in the ASICS MetaSpeed Edge Paris.

product.description:
Every kid deserves a shoe that keeps up — and the ASICS GT-1000 14 is designed to do exactly that. A kids-specific last ensures a fit that actually works for younger feet, and a handy size checker on the sockliner makes it easy to know when it's time for the next size up. Rearfoot GEL® technology cushions every landing so active feet stay comfortable through long school days, afternoon practices and everything in between. A medial forefoot wrap-up outsole and toe rubber stitch add durability in the areas that take the most wear — because kids are hard on shoes and these are built to handle it.

A lightweight mesh upper keeps things breathable and comfortable, and an EVA sockliner provides cushioning and moisture management for a cooler, drier feel throughout the day. Made with at least 75% recycled content in the main upper material — a small but meaningful step toward a healthier planet for the next generation of runners.

Details:

  • Upper: Lightweight, breathable mesh construction built for durability and all-day comfort. Made with at least 75% recycled upper materials.
  • Midsole: Rearfoot GEL® technology absorbs shock and cushions landings for comfortable movement during daily activities and active play.
  • Outsole: Medial forefoot wrap-up outsole and toe rubber stitch improve durability in high-wear zones to stand up to the demands of active kids.

product.description:
Get ready to run fast in the ASICS Magic Speed™ 2.

ASICS updated the Magic Speed to make it more versatile for both tempo runs and races. A full-length carbon and TPU plate gives you plenty of pop to propel your feet forward, crafting a smoother and more propulsive rebound during the toe-off phase of your stride. The top layer has FF Blast™ Plus cushioning to give you a more responsive rebound while keeping the shoe lightweight.

A new double jacquard upper provides a better fit while you run. The upper is durable enough for everyday training, but light and breathable enough for racing. Designers also retooled the shoe to make it fit and feel more comfortable on your foot.

The ASICS Magic Speed 2 is light enough for racing, responsive enough for speedwork and durable enough for daily training.

product.description:
Keep your runs stable and light while you help protect the environment with the ASICS GEL-KAYANO® Lite 3.

The Flytefoam® cushioning ASICS uses is made from organically derived materials. This lightweight foam puts a spring in your step, which ASICS combines with their signature Gel cushion that provides excellent shock absorption for a great underfoot experience. They also added more Flytefoam in the forefoot to create a more energetic rebound at toe-off, which makes for a smoother ride.

The GEL-KAYANO LITE 3 is engineered to reduce the effects of overpronation and has ASICS Guidance Line® technology to improve gait efficiency. Plus, the jacquard engineered mesh upper is made with more recycled materials than ever before and feels amazingly comfortable and breathable on your feet.

The ASICS GEL-KAYANO LITE 3 provides a stable and sustainable shoe that is lightweight and comfortable, making running in it a joy.

product.description:
Play, skip and run in the comfortable and supportive ASICS GT-1000 v11 GS.

The youth GT-1000 was designed to keep energized feet in motion. The GEL™ technology is soft and comfortable underfoot and will keep your kid playing for hours. ASICS engineered these shoes with a child-specific last that gives them a more accommodating fit for growing feet.

Kids can be tough on their shoes, so ASICS added a solid rubber outsole, medial (inside) wrap-up and toe rubber stitching to improve durability. Plus, it has a LITETRUSS™ support system that increases stability as kids roll through their stride. This added support works well for kids who overpronate or have flexible arches.

The ASICS GT-1000 v11 GS is a stability shoe that will let your kid run a 5K or play at school in comfort.

product.description:
Game. Set. Match. The ASICS Gel-Challenger 13 will help you dominate on the tennis court

This tennis shoe gives you the stability you crave for covering the baseline. The supportive upper keeps your feet locked-in on top of the shoe’s platform as you volley the ball back and forth.

Wingwall™ technology is placed in the sidewall to improve your lateral movement, while the PGuard™ Toe Protector gives you enhanced toe durability.

The Gel technology in this shoe makes it super comfortable and helps absorb shock during impact and toe-off. It also allows movement in multiple planes as the foot transitions through the gait cycle. Plus, ASICS strategically positioned their exceptionally durable AHAR® Plus Outsole in critical areas of the outsole.

Whether you are playing tennis or pickleball, the ASICS Gel-Challenger 13 will provide comfort and support, so you can focus on that winning shot.

product.description:
Get ready to blast through your runs with the supportive ASICS GT-2000 v11.

This stability shoe has LITETRUSS™ technology positioned on the inside of the midsole that improves stability by preventing your foot from rolling too far inward to give you a smoother stride.

ASICS re-engineered the GT-2000’s midsole by adding FF BLAST™ cushioning for extra bounce at toe-off and more energy return with every stride. The result is a comfortable shoe that gets you excited to run. Our testers loved the feeling in our ASICS GT-2000 v 11 review, "The ASICS GT-2000 11 is stable in the heel with flexibility in the forefoot, which I find to be a comfortable combination. The shoes feel lightweight and offer smooth transitions with just the right amount of pep."

The upper of the new GT-2000 is made with a jacquard mesh that provides a supportive and comfortable foothold. ASICS’ Adaptive Fit technology allows the breathable mesh upper to adapt to your foot’s natural shape so it can fit a variety of foot shapes. Plus, at least 50% of the upper material is made with recycled content to reduce waste and carbon emissions, so you can feel good about wearing it.

Whether you are running your 50th marathon or your first 5K, the ASICS GT-2000 v11 is a lightweight, energetic shoe that will help you get to the finish line.

product.description:
The ASICS Solution Speed FF 2 will have you saying game, set, match.

ASICS fastest tennis model, the Solution Speed FF 2 is all about getting to more shots, quicker. It combines stability with a more flexible fit based on the PU (polyurethane) application on the upper and DYNAWRAP technology that gives you better midfoot stability by keeping the foot centered on the shoe’s platform, which is particularly important for side to side movement.

The Solution Speed FF 2 also has ASICS TWISSTRUSS™ technology that assists players moving from the baseline to the net by improving quickness, stability and cutting motions. ASICS Flytefoam® cushioning and Flytefoam® Propel cushioning combine to give you a lightweight, responsive shoe that will keep you on your toes.

This tennis shoe is built to go from standing still to quick sprints in all directions, so you can get to the ball faster, and a brand new outsole design gives better traction to give you snappier transitions.

Whether you are playing tennis or pickleball, the lightweight, flexible and stable ASICS Solution Speed FF 2 will expand your reach, getting you to the ball at lightning speed.

product.description:
Best For:

  • Surface: Road, Gyms, Flats
  • Category: Neutral Cushioned – Intended for runners who have a higher, more stable arch that does not pronate excessively(roll inwards) or may even supinate(roll outwards). Neutral Cushioned shoes offer very little or no structure or pronation support and are generally more flexible than stability shoes. Runners who require a neutral shoe tend to notice more excessive wear on the lateral(outside) side of the soles of their running shoes. Neutral shoes can vary from lightweight and minimal cushioning to maximum levels of cushioning depending on the needs and preferences of the runner. Runners with high/stable arches tend to notice pain on the outside(lateral side) of their shins and knees and may also battle plantar fasciitis if not wearing a neutral cushioned shoe.

Benefits Include:

  • Flytefoam Blast is a lightweight midsole foam that delivers responsive propulsion and a soft landing.

You’ll shine bright when running in the dark in the ASICS Novablast 3 Lite-Show.

This Lite-Show version of the ASICS Novablast 3 features reflective details that are strategically positioned to improve visibility when running in low-light settings, making it safer to run in the dark.

The Novablast 3 Lite-Show features FF BLAST™ PLUS foam that creates a more energizing rebound coupled with a trampoline-inspired outsole design. ASICS also added more cushioning, while making the shoe significantly lighter with its new midsole compound.

A heel stabilizer supports the foot to give you a more balanced stride, while the gusseted tongue wing fit system improves the midfoot fit and reduces any tongue sliding. Inspired by geometric origami, the upper not only looks fast, but the new engineered monofilament mesh keeps the foot cool and comfortable as your run heats up.

The ASICS Novablast 3 Lite-Show is a great everyday trainer that provides a lively, cushioned ride and extra reflectivity for those early morning or nighttime runs.

product.description:
Keep your feet warm and dry as you blast through your runs with the supportive ASICS GT-2000 v11 GTX.

ASICS designed the upper of this waterproof running shoe with a GORE-TEX™ membrane that helps prevent rain and snow from entering the shoe’s interior. Designers also added reflective details to help you stay visible when running in the dark. Plus, at least 50% of the upper material is made with recycled content to reduce waste and carbon emissions, so you can feel good about wearing it.

This stability shoe has LITETRUSS™ technology positioned on the inside of the midsole that improves stability by preventing your foot from rolling too far inward to give you a smoother stride.

ASICS re-engineered the midsole by adding FF BLAST™ cushioning to give you extra bounce when you toe off and more energy return with every stride. The result is a comfortable shoe that gets you excited to run.

Whether you are running your 50th marathon or your first 5K, train in any weather with the light and supportive ASICS GT-2000 v11 GTX.

product.description:
Get all of the cushion you crave and stay visible in the dark with the ASICS GEL-Nimbus 25 Lite-Show.

Whether you are learning how to run or have dozens of races under your belt, the Nimbus 25 Lite Show has been completely redesigned to give you the best experience possible. Continuing its tradition of being one of the best running shoes, ASICS gave the Nimbus 25 more cushioning, adding 20% more FF Blast™ Plus Eco foam underfoot that is made with at least 20% bio-based material from renewable sources.

ASICS updated its gel with brand new PureGEL™ technology that is lighter and softer. It is strategically positioned in the heel to give you enhanced shock absorption, softer landings and smoother transitions.

A brand new upper completes the redesign of the Nimbus with an updated tongue and collar construction that has more stretch and extends around the ankle to give you a plush and premium experience. The Lite-Show version has additional reflective elements to help you stay visible when you run before the sun comes up or after it goes down. Plus, it has a fun design.

Shine brightly and stay comfortable whether you are walking with friends or running a solo 10 miler in the ASICS GEL-Nimbus 25 Lite Show.

The men's ASICS GEL-Kinsei Blast LE 2 gives you a smooth, fast stride as you go the distance.

Designed to look as good in the streets as it does on race day, push the pace and set a new PR in the ASICS GEL-Kinsei Blast LE 2.

product.description:
Get ready to say “game, set, match” in the ASICS Solution Speed FF 2 Clay shoes.

These clay court tennis shoes are lightweight, fast and flexible, perfect for running around the court to hit the perfect shot. Everything about these shoes is engineered for speed on the court.

Designed with more stability and better traction for clay courts, they facilitate a fast acceleration—whether you are going from the baseline to the net or side to side. Expand your territory with the ASICS Solution Speed FF 2 Clay shoes.

Features

  • Upper: The upper offers both a flexible fit with more stability. The PU (polyurethane) application gives you better support, flexibility and improved fit. The Dynawrap™ technology provides more stability for side-to-side movements and keeps your foot centered over the shoe.
  • Midsole: The midsole combines Flytefoam® and Flytefoam® Propel to give you lightweight and energetic foam underfoot. There is a rearfoot Gel® pod that disperses the shock during impact and allows for smooth transitions to midstance. ASICS places its Twisstruss™ technology in the midsole that assists players by improving their cutting motions and quick transitions.
  • Outsole: ASICSGRIP™ technology is an outsole rubber that gives plenty of grip on various terrain without compromising durability. ASICS placed AHAR® (or High Abrasion Rubber) on critical areas of the outsole to give you even more durability. Plus, the shoe is specifically designed for clay courts with better traction in the heel, forefoot and toe sections.

product.description:
The Brooks Addiction GTS 15 lets you spend more time on your feet.

For runners and walkers who need cushioned support, the new and improved Addiction GTS 15 now uses Brooks’ GuideRails® holistic support system. Similar to bumper rails in a bowling alley, this GuideRail system sits on both sides of your heel and midfoot to align your body with its natural motion path and reduce excess joint movement.

A stable base, soft cushion and smooth ride helps with balance and lets you easily transition from walking to running when you feel like going fast.

Comfortable for all-day wear or long walks and runs, the Addiction GTS 15 uses a well-built 3D printed mesh upper with plenty of stretch and structure to avoid rubbing or blisters. The roomy fit and forefoot construction is spacious enough to accommodate orthotics and insoles as well, making it a great option for flat or high-volume feet.

Now even lighter than previous models, the Brooks Addiction GTS 15 has the stability and cushion you need to maintain your daily mileage and exercise.

product.description:
Picture the dependable, trustworthy Brooks Ghost — then give it a shot of espresso. That's the Brooks Ghost Amp. Sharing the same structural last as the Ghost 18, the Amp delivers that familiar, comfortable fit runners already know while swapping the traditional midsole foam for something considerably more energetic. DNA HYPE foam blends EVA cushioning with PEBA responsiveness for a ride that feels soft and protective on easy days and genuinely peppy when you decide to push the pace.

No carbon plate here, but Brooks' SpringRamp technology makes a strong case that you don't need one. A denser foam under the forefoot creates a firm, springy platform that launches you into your next stride with a satisfying pop. The result sits somewhere between a classic daily trainer and a true performance shoe, making the Brooks Ghost Amp a versatile option that handles easy miles, run club evenings and tempo efforts with equal enthusiasm.

Details:

  • Upper: A thin warp-knit upper with bold color blocking gives the Ghost Amp a performance-forward look, while generous padding in the heel collar and tongue keeps the comfort level squarely in everyday trainer territory.
  • Midsole: DNA HYPE foam combines EVA cushioning and PEBA responsiveness in a single midsole package — delivering the soft, comfortable feel of a traditional daily trainer with noticeably more energy return. SpringRamp technology adds a denser foam layer under the forefoot for a firm, propulsive toe-off without the rigidity of a carbon plate.
  • Outsole: A strategically zoned rubber outsole covers high-abrasion areas at the heel and forefoot for lasting durability without unnecessary weight.

product.description:
Year after year, the Ghost earns its place as one of the running shoes out there, and the Ghost 18 continues that tradition with meaningful updates that make a great shoe even better.

Nitrogen-infused DNA Loft v3 foam delivers a consistent, protective ride that feels balanced and stable underfoot, and reliable in the way that matters most when you're logging the kind of everyday miles that build a real running base. A new Ortholite X-60 sockliner adds a noticeably plusher step-in feel that longtime Ghost fans will appreciate right away.

The biggest upgrade in the Ghost 18 is the new engineered air-mesh upper — more breathable, more accommodating and more comfortable than the previous version. A flat-knit tongue, plush heel collar and slightly roomier toe box work together to create a step-in feel that our wear testers couldn't stop talking about. "The upper of the Ghost 18 is what most other brands aim to create," said our reviewer Max. "The step-in feel is unmatched." Whether you have narrow feet, wide feet or something in between, the Ghost 18 makes room for everyone.

Details:

  • Upper: A new engineered air-mesh upper delivers improved breathability and a more accommodating fit. A flat-knit tongue and plush heel collar provide a comfortable, secure lockdown with a slightly roomier toe box than the previous version.
  • Midsole: Nitrogen-infused DNA Loft v3 foam provides consistent, balanced cushioning for daily training miles. A new Ortholite X-60 sockliner adds an extra layer of plush comfort underfoot for a noticeably better step-in feel.
  • Outsole: A reliable rubber outsole delivers durable traction and smooth transitions on road surfaces mile after mile.

The Brooks Glycerin Max 2 has everything you love about max cushioning, but with a surprising spring that makes your miles feel effortless.

The Glycerin Max 2 delivers a reliable ride with ultimate softness and an easy, energetic spring forward due to the thoughtfully crafted GlideRoll Rocker. It features nitrogen-infused DNA Tuned cushioning, engineered with innovative dual-size cell technology to target the areas of your foot that need it most. This innovative cushioning protects your body from impact, keeping your legs feeling fresh run after run.

Details:

  • Upper: The engineered triple jacquard air mesh wraps your foot securely, while breathable materials keep your feet cool. Soft padding on the tongue and heel collar adds instant step-in comfort and a luxurious feel to this daily trainer.

product.description:
Find your perfect support in the Brooks Adrenaline GTS 25.

Celebrating its 25th anniversary, this trusted stability shoe brings extra cushioning to the party while keeping Brooks’ GuideRails technology that's guided millions of miles. With 3 mm more DNA Loft v3 foam than last year's model, the Adrenaline GTS 25 delivers that balanced, supportive ride that's made it a favorite for daily training, long runs and everything in between.

Details:

  • Upper: The engineered mesh wraps around your foot with a comfortable, secure feel. The plush tongue and padded heel collar add extra security, while the stretchy pull tab makes getting out the door faster on busy mornings. The fit feels true-to-size across different foot shapes.
  • Midsole: DNA Loft v3 foam is injected with nitrogen to stay light, soft and durable over hundreds of miles. The extra 3 mm of cushioning (2.5 mm in the heel, 3.5 mm in the forefoot) brings the drop down to 10 mm for smoother transitions. GuideRails technology provides firm support on both sides of the shoe, with extra rigidity on the medial side for runners who need it.
  • Outsole: Durable construction delivers reliable traction and long-lasting wear for runners and walkers building consistent mileage.

The women's Brooks Catamount delivers faster miles on trail.

Brooks designed the Catamount with an all-new DNA Flash midsole. The nitrogen-infused foam is super light and extremely bouncy, giving you a snappy step when you go off-road.

Reliability and versatility are what come to mind for the Brooks Ghost 16. It’s a do-everything daily trainer that can eat up the bulk of your miles.

A newly nitrogen-infused DNA v3 midsole keeps the ride underfoot soft and consistent for walking, running and daily activities. Whether you’re on your feet all day or training for a 5K, the upper gives your foot that familiar Ghost feeling that’s both supportive and plush.

product.description:
Step up your run with the Brooks Ghost Max 2. Designed for unparalleled comfort and smooth transitions, this max-cushioned trainer is the elevated version of the fan-favorite Brook Ghost.

A DNA Loft v3 midsole delivers plush support perfect for long runs or everyday training, while the GlideRoll Rocker system gives you effortless strides.

“These are just the ticket for some easy miles. The fat stack of DNA Loft v3 foam strikes a really nice balance of soft and firm, something I’ve been looking for in a long run shoe,” says Max during our Brooks Ghost Max 2 review.

Details:

  • Upper: The breathable, double-layer upper gives you a secure and comfortable fit. A unique Linear Last construction adds more volume to the shoe for a comfortable fit inclusive of foot shapes and orthotics.
  • Midsole: The DNA Loft v3 nitrogen-infused midsole foam and GlideRoll Rocker system make all the difference during longer runs. It balances plush landings and responsive toe-offs perfectly, while sidewalls cradle your foot for extra stability.
  • Outsole: A wide base with good rubber coverage gives this shoe a smooth and durable ride.

product.description:
Rain or shine, you'll be ready for your next run or walk with the Brooks Adrenaline GTS 23 GTX. This shoe gives you support and stability exactly where and when you need it with GuideRail® technology. It keeps your body in its natural motion path by helping to address the deviation in your ankle and knee joints, perfect for those who have flexible arches or overpronate.

One reviewer in our Brooks Adrenaline GTS 23 review said, "The firm midsole foam in combination with the Guide Rails provides plenty of guidance and support, making it a great option for those seeking a stable ride.”

Combined with a waterproof upper for all-weather protection, the Brooks Adrenaline GTS 23 GTX makes it easier than ever to do more outside.

Details

  • Upper: A waterproof GoreTex upper offers you comfort and breathability no matter the weather.
  • Midsole: DNA Loft v2 is a softer and lighter version that gives you plenty of cushion and bounce.
  • Stability technology: GuideRails® holistic support system is Brook’s innovative technology that supports your body in its natural motion path while keeping excess movement in check. The GuideRails act like bumpers on a bowling alley, keeping your ball straight and ready to knock down some pins.

product.description:
The Brooks Glycerin Max takes cushioning to new heights.

Delivering a soft yet responsive feel for miles of comfort, this neutral trainer’s brand-new nitrogen-infused DNA Tuned midsole and GlideRoll Rocker geometry give you smooth transitions and an effortless ride.

In our Brooks Glycerin Max review, wear tester Mandy said, “The Glycerin Max offers the perfect combination of cushion and propulsion with a nice rocker shape to keep me running.”

Whether you're out for a casual run or logging serious miles, the Glycerin Max will keep your legs feeling fresh from start to finish.

Details:

  • Upper: The engineered triple jacquard material wraps your foot securely, while breathable materials keep your feet cool on the go. Soft padding on the tongue and heel collar add instant step-in comfort and a luxurious feel to this daily trainer.
  • Midsole: Brooks’ brand-new DNA Tuned midsole uses dual-cell, nitrogen-infused foam. Large cells in the heel and midfoot create soft landings, while small cells towards the forefoot give you responsive toe-offs. Then, the GlideRoll Rocker geometry gently nudges you forward for a smooth stride.

product.kitContent:
Accordion1What's New

For the very first iteration of the Glycerin Max, Brooks introduced their brand-new DNA Tuned midsole foam which uses nitrogen-infused foam that perfectly balances soft landings and responsive take-offs.

Read what Brooks Footwear Product Line Manager Brittany Gleaton had to say about this new midsole material in our Brooks Glycerin Max review.

Who It's Best ForDo you love soft cushioning for long miles that doesn’t sacrifice responsiveness when you want to pick up the pace? Then the Glycerin Max might be for you.

In our Glycerin Max review, wear tester Mandy said, “I recommend the Brooks Glycerin Max for anyone looking for some cushion and bounce for long runs, walks or recovery days,” says Mandy. “I also think it would work well for people with insoles, especially ones that can be a bit thicker.”

Why You'll Love ItAside from its futuristic and stylish look, you’ll love the soft and bouncy ride of Glycerin Max.00

product.description:
Brooks developed a coveted racing spike with the Hyperion Elite LD. This race day shoe embodies the smoothness necessary to cruise past the competition in long distance races. Worn by world champions and record holders, the Brooks Hyperion Elite LD has all the features you need to make the most out of every race.

The midsole cushioning keeps the shoe comfortable and light, while the carbon plate helps transfer your energy into sustained speed on the track. On the outsole, the spikes support a smooth stride with optimal traction for every step of the race. The toe box is slightly wider to give your toes some room, while the upper keeps your foot secure as you run.

Details

  • Upper: The deconstructed upper is very porous, offering a highly breathable and lightweight fit with the security to keep you locked in for the entirety of your race. Victory tape badging highlights the Brooks logo, and a roomy toe box enhances comfort.
  • Midsole: The full-length carbon fiber composite SpeedVault Race Plate enhances the midsole by propelling you forward like a catapult. While the DNA Flash v2 foam is a firmer foam, the midsole in the Hyperion LD still feels incredibly reactive and not too stiff during long distance races.
  • Outsole: The forefoot spike plate features six detachable spikes for a more relaxed construction that rolls you through your stride for longer distances on the track. While not overly rigid, the spikes are still bouncy and promote efficient runs.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe midsole of the Brooks Hyperion Elite LD has been innovated with new features to help you hit those PRs. The DNA FLASH v2 cushioning is infused with nitrogen, delivering greater energy return while reducing weight. The new carbon fiber plate allows for a greater bending stiffness and stronger propulsion with every stride.Who It's Best ForBrooks made the Hyperion Elite LD for distance fiends with a need for speed. For relaxed and efficient runners specializing in races from the 1500 to the 10k, you want this innovative super spike underfoot on raceday. If you compete in middle distance races, from 800m to the mile, check out the Brooks Hyperion Elite MD instead.Why You'll Love ItEven in long distance track races, every step and every millisecond counts. The Brooks Hyperion Elite LD, as a simple yet efficient spike, reacts to the energy you bring to the track and optimizes every stride. Share the same spikes as distance world champions and world record holders as you challenge the competition. 00

product.description:
Brooks developed a coveted mid-distance super spike with the Hyperion Elite MD. This racing shoe embodies the toughness of all middle-distance runners and helps you get the most out of every race. Developed in partnership with pro athletes, the Brooks Hyperion Elite MD has all the features you need to pull away from competition before the finish line.

The midsole cushioning keeps the shoe comfortable and light, while the carbon plate helps transfer your energy into top speeds on the track. On the outsole, the spikes keep you on your toes to support mid-race surges and that final kick necessary to beat your competition. The toe box is slightly wider to not cramp your toes, but the upper keeps everything secure as you run.

Details

  • Upper: The deconstructed upper is very porous, offering a highly breathable and lightweight fit with the security to keep you locked in for the entirety of your race. Victory tape badging highlights the Brooks logo, and a roomy toe box enhances comfort.
  • Midsole: The full-length carbon fiber composite SpeedVault Race Plate enhances the midsole by propelling you forward like a catapult. For the goldilocks of cushioning, the DNA Flash v2 foam has a barely-there feel while providing the ideal support for middle-distance races. This foam in this spike is top loaded so that more of it will activate when pushing off your toes.
  • Outsole: The forefoot spike plate features six detachable spikes for reliable traction that delivers grip and powerful toe-offs when you need it most during your race.

product.description:
The Brooks Glycerin 22 delivers an expertly balanced ride that combines luxurious comfort with responsive performance.

This max-cushioned trainer features all-new, nitrogen-infused DNA Tuned cushioning, engineered with innovative dual-size cell technology which allows Brooks’ designers to create different zones of cushioning. The result gives you plush landings in the heel that transition smoothly into energetic toe-offs, making your miles feel effortless.

In our Brooks Glycerin 22 review one of our wear-testers noted, "Overall, this shoe has a great ride. It’s smooth, soft, and has some nice pop to it.”

Details:

  • Upper: A new engineered double jacquard mesh upper provides a premium, adaptable fit with a plush heel collar and stretchy heel tab for easy on/off. The sock-like construction wraps your foot in comfort while keeping it secure.
  • Midsole: DNA Tuned cushioning uses larger cells in the heel for soft landings and smaller cells in the forefoot for responsive toe-offs. Plus, a broad platform ensures stable, smooth transitions.
  • Outsole: Durable rubber provides reliable traction and long-lasting wear.

product.description:
The Brooks Hyperion Max 3 delivers the perfect blend of speed and comfort to help you get the most out of every training run.

Whether you're working toward your first 5K or training for a marathon PR, the Hyperion Max 3 makes every workout feel like a step forward. DNA GOLD cushioning provides that lightweight, responsive feel that helps you maintain good form even when you're pushing the pace, while the high-stack design gives you the protection you need to bounce back faster between sessions. The RapidRoll Rocker creates smooth, natural transitions that help you find your rhythm and stay there, making speed work feel less intimidating and long runs more enjoyable.

Details:

  • Outsole: The RapidRoll Rocker helps guide your foot through each stride, making transitions feel smooth and effortless. It's the kind of feature that helps you settle into a comfortable rhythm faster.

product.description:
Discover what comfort feels like in the Brooks Ghost Max 3.

Designed for runners and walkers who want every step to feel supported, the Ghost Max 3 delivers maximum cushioning without compromising the smooth, natural transitions that make long miles feel effortless. This isn't just about more foam—it's about smarter cushioning that works with your body's natural movement. With nitrogen-infused DNA LOFT v3 foam and GlideRoll Rocker technology, the Ghost Max 3 helps reduce underfoot pressure while actively assisting your heel-to-toe transitions, so you can focus on enjoying your run instead of counting down the miles.

Details:

  • Upper: New high-fidelity textile delivers a soft, premium feel that wraps your foot in comfort from the first step to the last. The design balances breathability with the protective support you need for longer efforts.
  • Midsole: A high stack of nitrogen-infused DNA LOFT v3 cushioning provides maximum protection without the weight penalty. The low 6 mm offset works with GlideRoll Rocker technology to create smooth, assisted transitions that make every step feel effortless.
  • Outsole: A broad base delivers inherent stability that supports neutral runners without interfering with your natural stride. Strategic design promotes smooth heel-to-toe transitions whether you're running or walking.

product.description:
Take on any trail with complete confidence in the Brooks Cascadia 19.

Built for runners who want one reliable shoe that handles everything the outdoors can throw at you, this trail-ready workhorse combines stable, adaptable cushioning with all-terrain traction that performs whether the ground is wet, dry, rocky or smooth. When you need a shoe that's as versatile as your adventures, the Cascadia 19 has your back on every single mile.

Details:

  • Upper: The updated airy mesh construction with added structure gives you that secure, breathable fit that keeps you comfortable during those long trail sessions. Plus, it’s made with 69.6% recycled materials because taking care of the trails we love matters just as much as running on them.
  • Midsole: The improved Trail Adapt System integrates a flexible rock plate within soft DNA LOFTv3 foam cushioning, giving you even better protection and adaptability for those extended trail runs. With 2 mm more nitrogen-infused cushioning in the heel and 4 mm more in the forefoot, every step feels noticeably softer and more comfortable.
  • Outsole: The all-terrain traction pattern, made with 25% recycled content, delivers reliable grip in both wet and dry conditions. Whether you're navigating muddy single track or scrambling over dry rocks, you'll have the confidence to keep moving forward.

product.description:
Most plated shoes ask you to choose between cushioning and speed. The Brooks Hyperion Max 4 was built around the idea that serious training shouldn't require that trade-off.

DNA GOLD and DNA FLASH v2 work together in a way that's genuinely uncommon at this price point — plush enough to absorb the cumulative impact of high mileage and responsive enough to hold your splits on a tempo run. A nylon SpeedVault plate adds the propulsive assist that makes faster efforts feel more controlled and sustainable, and the curved RapidRoll™ Rocker keeps your turnover quick and efficient even when your legs are asking for a rest day.

Details:

  • Upper: A new triple jacquard warp knit upper is lighter and more breathable than its predecessor, with thoughtful attention to the high-irritation zones that reveal themselves during harder efforts. A gusseted tongue locks your midfoot down cleanly with lofted zones that add protective cushioning exactly where long runs and workouts tend to cause problems.
  • Midsole: DNA GOLD foam provides a plush, impact-absorbing base while DNA FLASH v2 adds responsiveness and energy return — two foams doing two different jobs in one midsole stack that totals 45 mm. A nylon SpeedVault plate channels that energy forward with each toe-off for a propulsive, assisted ride that makes goal-pace efforts feel more achievable.
  • Outsole: Strategically placed rubber delivers reliable traction and long-term durability for runners logging serious training volume on roads.

If the cost of your race entry has you taking training seriously, the Hyperion Max 4 belongs in your kit.Why You'll Love ItForty-five millimeters of dual foam absorbs the miles your legs would otherwise feel tomorrow. The plate and rocker give you back the energy you need to keep hitting your times today. That trade-off is exactly what serious training shoes are supposed to make.00

Pro athletes helped build this shoe, and it shows. The Brooks Hyperion Elite 6 represents the most advanced racing shoe Brooks has ever put on the market, combining a reformulated pure PEBA DNA GOLD midsole with an updated carbon SpeedVault+ plate engineered specifically to push you forward sooner and faster.

New nitrogen-infused DNA GOLD is softer, lighter and more responsive than its predecessor, optimizing force production with every stride so your energy goes where it matters most.

The SpeedVault+ plate features an increased angle of descent developed through pressure mapping with Brooks-sponsored athletes, locking up the forefoot and driving aggressive propulsion at the exact moment your foot needs it. Plus, updated RapidRoll™ rocker geometry works with the plate to accelerate your transition and get you to your next step faster.

Details:

Silicone lace-sheaths and a full TPU-pressed construction seamlessly connect the shoe to your foot, keeping you planted on the platform at race pace. Breathability and reinforcement are engineered precisely where each is needed — no extra layers, no excess weight, nothing that doesn't earn its place.
  • Midsole: Reformulated nitrogen-infused DNA GOLD made with pure PEBA delivers softer, lighter and more responsive cushioning than the previous version, designed to optimize force production and give you a measurable advantage over the marathon distance. A carbon SpeedVault+ plate with an increased angle of descent drives aggressive forward propulsion, engineered through pressure mapping with elite athletes for the most efficient toe-off Brooks has ever achieved.
  • Outsole: Precision rubber placement delivers reliable race day traction at minimal weight on road surfaces.

Whether you are walking your dog, standing on your feet all day, or going for a quick run, the Brooks Beast is all about comfort and stability. The broad base is combined with Brooks’ GuideRails® holistic support system that acts similar to bumpers in a bowling alley, keeping your body in its natural motion path while keeping excess motion in check.

  • Outsole: Blown rubber outsole with HPR in the heel for added durability.

Made for sustained speed on the trails, this shoe feels like it disappears on your feet. The plated midsole keeps you running fast, helping to push you uphill with ease, while the outsole gives you plenty of traction and grip to run confidently.

Details:

  • Upper: A premium one-piece upper is made with TPEE mesh that makes it soft, lightweight, durable and helps it drain faster. There is a mudflap on the toe for added protection and overlays for extra security.

product.description:
Go ahead and jump in the puddles with the Brooks Cascadia 16 GTX.

Brooks took their flagship Cascadia 16 trail shoe and added a lightweight GORE-TEX upper that gives you full waterproof coverage. The lightweight GORE-TEX Invisible Fit membrane is bonded directly to the upper for a light, flexible fit that keeps your feet warm and dry.

Mud and debris will stay out of your shoes thanks to a gusseted tongue construction and gaiter tab on the heel that secures trail gaiters for extra protection. This shoe also contains drainage ports so water can escape quickly if you step into a creek that goes up to your knees.

These trail shoes are ready for technical terrain. Brooks enhanced the adaptability of the shoe by changing the midsole and outsole construction to allow it to mold easily to the ground, improving the stable ride. They added more release grooves in the midsole to help running on rough ground and the TrailTack rubber outsole provides wet-dry traction so you can run through puddles or snow. One reviewer said “I wouldn’t be afraid to take these on an extremely rocky trail. The tread is grippy and reminds me of aggressive tires you’d want on an off-road vehicle, but it’s just in a great shoe.”

They also updated the Ballistic Rock Shield, including vertical grooves to protect against pebbles and rocks while adapting to uneven terrain.

Brooks made the Cascadia even softer by adding their new DNA Loft v2 to the midsole and 2mm of extra foam to the midsole for added comfort. This makes it 5% softer and 20% lighter than previous versions. Perfect for those long trail runs or hikes.

Be visible and get the support you crave when you run with the Brooks Run Visible Glycerin GTS 20. Brooks designed this shoe to help you stand out as a runner in motion when it’s dark outside by adding strategic reflective elements and fluorescent accents that deliver a pop of color.

Brooks’ tradition of making the Glycerin GTS softer and more cushioned continues in version 20. The Glycerin GTS 20 uses Brooks’ signature GuideRail® technology along the heel and midfoot to give the shoe stability and support. This innovative technology supports your body in its natural motion path while keeping excess movement in check—perfect for those who overpronate or have flexible arches and want a little more support.

Brooks redesigned the midsole and outsole by widening the platform to make for smooth and easy transitions. The upper gives you a secure fit thanks to plush and breathable engineered air-mesh. Plus, the toe box has more volume for your toes to spread out.

Plush, responsive and supportive, the Glycerin GTS 20 will keep your mind off your feet and on your workout.

Run your best in the Levitate StealthFit 5.

product.description:
[Featured in our Best Trail Running Shoes Guide]

Completely redesigned from top to bottom, the Brooks Caldera 6 gives you cushioning and comfort for the long haul.

Brooks used their nitrogen injected DNA LOFT v3 foam in the Caldera’s midsole that was also used in the out-of-this-world Brooks Aurora-BL. For long miles offroad, this soft and lightweight foam gives you plenty of pop to keep the legs feeling fresh, while also absorbing the impact of roots and rocks.

Comfort is ultra-important for going ultra-distances—the Caldera uses an internal midfoot saddle and raised midsole foam walls to keep your foot secure and supported. A widened base and split-heel outsole adapt and flex to stabilize your landings, smoothly carrying you over uneven terrain. Our reviewers loved how supportive and stable this shoe felt on the trails in our Brooks Caldera 6 review.

To keep you confident and nimble on varying terrain, Brooks added multidirectional lugs on the outsole that bite when the trails get messy. The quick-drying upper will come in handy for stream crossings or deep puddles, while the TPU toe cap offers plenty of protection from debris.

Go the distance—the supreme softness and stable ride of the Brooks Caldera 6 will help you go farther on the trails.

product.description:
Get the most out of every walk and run with the Brooks Ghost Max.

This shoe is full of cushion and comfort thanks to the amount of super soft and bouncy DNA Loft v2 midsole foam underfoot. Our runners loved the smooth ride and cushioned feel in our Brooks Ghost Max review. One of the best shoes for standing all day, the Brooks Ghost Max uses a unique rocker geometry to make your walks and runs feel effortless while taking pressure off of the soft tissues in your feet.

The Brooks Ghost Max will help you do more—whether that is taking another walk around the block, running another mile or working just a little more comfortably.

Details

  • Upper: Breathable mesh. The high volume linear last is accommodating to many different foot shapes and allows you to easily put an orthotic insert into this shoe. A padded tongue and collar complete this comfortable upper.
  • Midsole: a high stack of super-soft DNA Loft v2 foam and Brooks’ GlideRoll Rocker work together to decrease pressure underfoot for protective comfort. The GlideRoll Rocker makes your runs feel effortless and it seamlessly rolls you through your heel/toe transitions.
  • Outsole: A wider last gives you a more stable and protected ride, while a central decoupled outsole provides additional stability that doesn’t interfere with a neutral stride.

0Accordion1Who It’s Best For

The Brooks Ghost Max is a great shoe for anyone who wants a cushioned, effortless ride as they walk or run. It is ideal for those with different foot ailments*, such as plantar fasciitis and Morton’s neuroma because of the GlideRoll Rocker, soft cushioning and lower offset. It also has an accommodating foot shape for those that have thicker orthotic inserts.

*While we at Fleet Feet aim to provide our customers with the best information possible, nothing beats the expertise of a medical professional. If you experience new or worsening pain, consult a doctor or physical therapist before taking any further action.

Why You’ll Love ItYou will love how the Brooks Ghost Max helps you effortlessly walk and run in comfort.Differences Between Brooks Ghost 15 and Ghost Max

The biggest difference between the Brooks Ghost 15 and Ghost Max is the heel-to-toe transition experience. The Brooks Ghost 15 is designed to be flexible and move with your foot, while the Brooks Ghost Max is designed to move for your foot—so it’s slightly more rigid with a rocker for smoother transitions.

Another thing you will notice about the Ghost Max vs. the Brooks Ghost 15 is that the Brooks Ghost Max has more cushion and a taller midsole stack height. To complement the different transition experience, the heel-to-toe offset of the Ghost Max is 6 mm as opposed to the Ghost 15’s 12 mm drop. Brooks added 8 mm more cushion in the forefoot and 2 mm more cushion in the heel of the Ghost Max.

Race your best and crush the competition in the Brooks ELMN8 v7.

The Brooks Glycerin StealthFit GTS 21 has the softness, stability and style for all of your runs and workouts.

This plush shoe is optimized for your comfort by being lightweight, responsive, durable and cushioned. The updated knit upper not only looks great on your foot but provides a blend of stretch and compression that moves with your foot and fits a bit closer.

Brooks uses their GuideRail technology to support your body in its natural motion path while keeping excess motion in check, ideal for those with flexible arches or who overpronate and like a bit of extra stability.

Details

  • Upper: An updated flat knit upper gives you a sleek fit, plenty of style and offers a blend of stretch and compression that moves with your feet.
  • Midsole: The new nitrogen-infused DNA LOFT v3 foam gives you a plush, durable and responsive ride. A broad platform makes sure you have smooth heel-to-toe transitions.
  • Stability: Brooks’ GuideRail® holistic support system supports your body in its natural motion path while keeping excess movement in check, similar to bumpers on a bowling alley.
  • Outsole: New RoadTrack rubber on the outsole is lightweight, durable and includes recycled silica.

product.description:
The Brooks Ghost 15’s blend of comfort, style and functionality help it stand out as one of the best running shoes you’ll find.

Designed for runners and active individuals looking for a shoe that keeps up with their active lifestyle, the Ghost is more than just a running shoe—it's an extension of your body. Whether you're powering through a half marathon, running your first 5k or enjoying a walk around the city, these shoes adapt seamlessly to keep you comfortable with every step.

The Ghost 15’s midsole gives you the perfect balance between cushioning and responsiveness. Its DNA LOFT v2 cushioning delivers a buttery smooth heel-to-toe transition, while keeping your feet cradled with just the right amount of support.

Experience the Ghost 15's magic from the first time you lace them up. Its comfortable fit is perfect for all-day wear, whether you're standing, walking or getting a workout in. The engineered air mesh upper feels like your favorite slipper, while the 3D fit print provides structure to prevent any distractions and keep you focused on your run.

It's common to wonder if a new running shoe can truly make a difference. But have no fear. Universally loved by our testers in our Brooks Ghost 15 review, take it from one reviewer who said, "The shoe feels wonderfully responsive in the forefoot while retaining an extra softness in the heel, making it very adaptable to different running styles and different types of workouts."

Get ready to fly through the trails with the new Brooks Catamount 2.

Featuring Brook’s new SkyVault propulsion plate, the Catamount 2 delivers a snappy and responsive ride with each step. Not only will you power uphill with ease, but the plate doubles as a rock shield for protection against roots and rocks.

Get ready for speed—the nitrogen-infused DNA Flash midsole is fine-tuned to deliver a responsive and lightweight ride to let you run your fastest. The TrailTrack outsole gives you traction on both wet and dry surfaces, so you are surefooted as you speed through the trail.

The upper is made for the rugged outdoors with a dual-side air mesh that is abrasion-resistant and hydrophobic on the outer layer, while the inner layer is made from recycled materials that are soft and dry fast. There are internal reinforcements around the midfoot and a half-bootie tongue construction to keep your foot locked in, while a TPU toe cap protects against debris. Plus, there are drainage slits that allow water to quickly drain from your shoe when you cross a creek or step into puddles.

The Brooks Catamount 2 catapults you to the tops of mountains with ease.

Brooks re-designed the Cascadia to give runners more confidence, stability and grip on the trails. product.description:
Saucony’s PWRRUN PBX superfoam is new for this generation, and it's the reason the Endorphin Speed 6 sits 2 mm taller underfoot without weighing more. Most shoes that add stack also add grams, and this one adds softness and rebound while staying at 6.9 oz. The result is a supertrainer that makes your tempo session, and the easy day after it, equally as fun.

A redesigned nylon plate runs through the midsole and drives your transitions. The nylon flexes in a way carbon doesn't, so you get snappy propulsion through toe-off without the rigid, all-or-nothing feel of a race shoe — which is what makes the Speed 6 so versatile across a range of paces. The lightweight mesh upper holds your foot in place when you shift gears and keeps you comfortable throughout your run.

Details:

  • Upper: Breathable lightweight mesh keeps your foot locked down when you pick up the pace. The construction stays minimal to hold weight down without giving up security through turns and faster efforts.
  • Midsole: PWRRUN PBX is a next-generation superfoam that delivers more cushioning and better efficiency at a lower weight than the foam it replaces, with 2 mm more of it underfoot. A newly designed nylon plate sits inside the midsole and adds propulsion through smoother, faster transitions. An SRS sockliner tops the platform for step-in comfort.
  • Outsole: Strategic rubber coverage in the heel and forefoot handles the traction demands of road miles at tempo pace.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewPWRRUN PBX superfoam replaces the previous midsole foam and brings more cushioning and more efficiency at a lower weight, with 2 mm of additional stack underfoot. The nylon plate has been redesigned for stronger propulsion and smoother transitions through your gait cycle. The upper has been rebuilt in lightweight breathable mesh for a more secure hold when you pick up the pace. Together those updates make the Speed 6 more cushioned and more responsive at once, beyond what earlier versions offered.Who It's Best ForRunners who want one shoe for tempo work, intervals and everyday training, especially anyone who finds a full carbon racer too aggressive for daily use. It's also a strong fit for runners building toward a goal race who want plate-driven propulsion in a shoe they can log real volume in.Why You'll Love ItYou get the pop of a plated shoe with enough cushioning to keep using it the next day. When one pair covers your workouts and your easy miles, your rotation gets a lot simpler.00

product.description:
Daily training miles add up fast, and the shoe you reach for most needs to handle the load. The Saucony Hurricane 26 is a max-cushioned stability shoe that brings together plush comfort and reliable support in a package designed for big training weeks and daily miles.

The centerpiece is the incrediLUX foam midsole — a lighter, more cushioned ride than what you'd find in previous versions, with a bouncy, responsive feel that makes longer efforts more enjoyable. An incrediLUX insole adds a luxuriously soft step-in feel, while a dual-density PWRRUN frame wraps the midsole with a stable chassis that protects and supports through the demands of daily mileage.

CenterPath technology features a broader platform and higher sidewalls that guide your stride through each footfall, making it a strong choice for runners managing mild to severe overpronation who need consistent, trustworthy support. The premium mesh upper wraps the foot in a secure, comfortable fit, and a durable XT-900 carbon rubber outsole handles the wear and tear of road mileage without breaking down.

Details:

  • Midsole: incrediLUX foam with and incrediLUX insole gives you a super bouncy and lightweight ride. CenterPath technology with broader platform and higher sidewalls delivers stride support, while a dual-density PWRRUN frame provides inherent stability.
  • Outsole: XT-900 carbon rubber for long-lasting durability on road surfaces.

product.description:
Step into the perfect blend of cushioning and stability with the Saucony Guide 18.

For runners and walkers seeking a soft and supportive ride, the Guide 18 adapts seamlessly to your stride, providing a smooth, stable experience with every step. It works by combining Saucony’s soft and responsive PWRRUN foam with their Center Path Technology which keeps the foot centered and supported.

“I like how the Guide 18 feels less bulky,” says Spencer in our full Saucony Guide 18 review. “Sometimes weight can be a tradeoff when adding more cushion, but this latest model seems lighter weight and more agile.

Details:

  • Upper: An engineered mesh upper keeps the fit breathable and secure while leaving enough space to accommodate wider foot shapes if needed. A gusseted tongue helps to lock down your foot for a comfortable and distraction-free run.
  • Midsole: PWRRUN foam delivers soft yet responsive cushioning, striking the perfect balance for long-lasting comfort. Plus, Center Path Technology gives you smooth transitions and plenty of support thanks to the broader platform, higher sidewalls and asymmetric profile to guide your stride.
  • Outsole: The XT-900 carbon rubber outsole gives you durable traction made to last.

product.description:
Meet your new daily driver in the Saucony Ride 19.

This neutral daily trainer gets lighter, softer and more responsive with reformulated PWRRUN+ foam that adapts to however you move. Whether you're heading out for your daily run, taking a walk around the neighborhood or just staying active throughout your day, the Ride 19 delivers versatile comfort that works as hard as you do.

Details:

  • Upper: The new engineered mesh balances breathability with stretch for a more inclusive fit that accommodates different foot shapes. Added cushioning in the heel collar brings next-level comfort from the moment you slip them on, while the vegan-friendly construction uses recycled materials.
  • Midsole: Reformulated PWRRUN+ foam packs more cushioning underfoot while reducing weight. The result is a softer, more responsive ride with increased energy return that makes every step feel a little easier, whether you're logging miles or moving through your day.
  • Outsole: Strategic rubber placement in the forefoot improves durability where you need it most, while new flex grooves create smoother transitions. The enhanced traction helps you feel confident on any surface.

product.description:
Rule your run with the Saucony Guide 19.

Delivering max cushioning that hugs your foot and guides your stride, this shoe brings together softer PWRRUN foam and exclusive CenterPath Technology for confidence in every step. With enhanced forefoot flexibility and a welcoming, spacious fit, the Guide 19 gives you the control and comfort to focus on what matters most—your experience, your run.

Details:

  • Upper: The engineered mesh offers optimal breathability and stretch for a fit that adapts to your foot all day long. Added collar comfort creates a secure feel, while the spacious toe box and accommodating width give you room to move naturally without pinching or tightness.
  • Midsole: Softer, more responsive PWRRUN foam delivers that perfect balance of cushioning and bounce—soft enough for relief from the pavement with just enough pop to keep your stride feeling lively. CenterPath Technology features higher sidewalls that hug your foot and guide you through each step with balanced support that doesn't feel stiff or intrusive.
  • Outsole: The wide, stable base keeps you grounded and confident mile after mile while the smooth heel-to-toe transition helps you maintain your natural stride.

product.description:
Saucony rethought the Triumph 24 from the midsole up, and the result is one of the most comfortable daily trainers they've ever made.

New incrediLUX foam brings a thick stack of premium cushioning that feels noticeably lighter and more responsive than before — plush enough for easy recovery runs, energetic enough to hold its own when the pace picks up. Soft design lines and luxurious details round out a shoe that feels as premium as it performs.

Details:

  • Midsole: All-new incrediLUX foam delivers a thick stack of premium cushioning with lightweight energy return for daily runs, long efforts and all-day wear. An incrediLUX sockliner adds one more layer of underfoot comfort right where your foot meets the shoe.
  • Outsole: XT-900 carbon rubber delivers unmatched durability and protection on road surfaces for runners who put serious miles on their shoes.

product.description:
One of the best shoes for stability and comfort, the Saucony Omni 20 lets you go the distance in cushioned support.

Celebrating its 20th anniversary, the Omni has long been one of the top running shoes for overpronators or runners and walkers that prefer some extra guidance from their shoes.

Saucony’s PWRRUN foam cushioning is what gives the Omni 20 its pep and durability. But the feature that wearers will appreciate most is the shoe’s extended medial post that helps to support the inside of the foot and arch while encouraging a more natural body alignment.

While some stability shoes can feel clunky and stiff, the Saucony Omni 20 uses a combination of high-wear rubber materials for a more flexible outsole and smooth transition.

Wide enough to accommodate a variety of foot shapes, Saucony’s well-structured FORMFIT upper material hugs and secures your foot but remains stretchy and breathable. A great running shoe for beginners or anyone looking for just a bit more cushion and support, the Omni 20 will become your trusty companion that feels comfortable from day one (even if you haven't laced up for years).

This is what dream runs are made of.

The Saucony Triumph 19 provides dreamy cushioning and lightweight support thanks to Saucony PWRRUN+ midsole foam. The foam provides a plush cushion to absorb shock as you land, and it delivers propulsive pop to your take-offs. A durable outsole gives you the grip you need to push to top speeds, and it protects your shoe through heavy mileage.

The Triumph 19 features a new engineered mesh that allows more flexibility and breathability than before, making the Triumph supremely cool and comfortable. Plus, the upper is constructed from recycled materials, so you can be light on your feet and light on the planet. An articulated eye-row lacing system lets you comfortably dial in the fit of your shoes without extra hassle.

Get after your next run in cloud-like comfort in the Triumph 19.

This non-plated trainer brings the super foam experience of the Endorphin series to your everyday miles. Built with full-length PWRRUN PB cushioning and SpeedRoll technology, the Azura gives you light and bouncy comfort for easy runs while still delivering responsive snap when you're ready to pick up the pace.

The Unleash SD 3 is the key to unleashing your full potential in shot put, discus and hammer throw competitions. Strap into this throwing shoe from Saucony to elevate your performance.

With a combination of FlexFilm overlays, a sturdy cross strap and a high density rubber outsole, this shoe will help throwers of all levels achieve more power and precision in their throws.

Details

  • Upper: The updated lightweight upper provides exceptional support and breathability, ensuring comfort during the most intense training sessions. The dynamic midfoot strap locks your foot in place so you can focus on perfecting your technique.

  • Outsole: The high density rubber provides versatile durability with every movement. Saucony’s specialized rubber is designed for both glide and grip throwing techniques.

product.description:
Chase those personal records in the Saucony Tempus.

The Saucony Tempus is a stability shoe that’s supercharged with a full-length bed of Saucony’s PWRRUN PB foam, providing lightweight cushioning and amazing energy return.

The PWRRUN PB foam is set inside a PWRRUN Frame that supports your foot as you land, stabilizes it through the midfoot and provides for a snappy takeoff. Your foot sits securely in the shoe for a plush and supportive fit thanks to deep contouring. The midsole geometry gives you a supportive base and a super smooth ride. All these features combine to give you support and stability during your run, which is particularly helpful if you overpronate or have flexible arches.

A lightweight, breathable mesh upper complements the Tempus perfectly. The rounded heel counter hugs your heel and keeps you secure. Plus, a lightweight midfoot saddle and adaptive lacing allow you to dial in your perfect fit.

The Saucony Tempus will give you confidence and comfort whether you’re going for a long run or want to pick up the pace.

Streamlined for race day, the Endorphin Pro 4 is built for speed. With updated cushioning, an improved race-ready upper and a new outsole design, your runs will feel faster than ever. The carbon plate and rocker geometry propel you forward in a flash to help you break those personal records.

product.description:
From mile one to run done, the Saucony Triumph 22 is ready to eat up the bulk of your training.

The Triumph 22 packs Saucony’s lightweight and responsive PWRRUN PB midsole foam beneath a plush and padded upper for a premium ride whether you’re going on a long run or standing on your feet all day.

“As I slipped my feet into the new pair of Triumphs, the upper made me feel like I was wrapping a comfortable and cozy blanket around my feet—plush, soft and oh-so-comfortable,” Mandy says in our review of the Saucony Triumph 22.

Details:

  • Upper: The engineered mesh upper gives you a premium fit and feel thanks to a padded heel collar and gusseted tongue that wraps your midfoot and gives you plenty of wiggle room in the toe box.
  • Midsole: To give you a well-cushioned platform for your daily miles, Saucony upgraded the midsole with a wide base of PWRRUN PB foam that’s firm and responsive for a smooth and stable ride.

product.description:
When you're in it for the long haul on rugged trails, you need an ultra-cushioned shoe that can go the distance. Enter the Saucony Xodus Ultra 3—rebuilt from the ground up to keep you comfortable and stable mile after mountain mile.

With responsive cushioning, billy goat-like grip and a durable, breathable upper to keep you going, the Xodus Ultra 3 is your ultimate trail running shoe for all-day adventures.

Details:

  • Upper: A durable, breathable mesh upper wicks moisture and has a high evaporation rate to keep your feet dry and comfortable. There’s also additional lightweight protection in high abrasion areas and a D-Ring for gaiter adaptability.
  • Midsole: Underfoot, an ultra-thick layer of responsive PWRRUN PB foam delivers unparalleled step-in comfort while keeping your legs feeling fresh. It's framed by a supportive PWRRUN chassis that enhances durability without weighing you down. The broader platform and higher side walls give you a stable, confidence-inspiring ride over uneven trails. Plus, a Forefoot Rock Guard gives you flexible protection against harsh terrain.
  • Outsole: Newly formulated PWRTRAC rubber with versatile 4 mm lugs ensures excellent grip and durability on any surface.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What’s NewSaucony designers increased the cushioning in the Xodus Ultra 3 with a broader platform and higher sidewalls to keep you comfortable and stable for long days on the trail. They also used a newly formulated PWRTRAC rubber on the outsole and reduced the lug depth from 4.5 mm to 4 mm for more versatile traction over varying terrain.Who It’s Best ForIdeal for those seeking premium cushioning and stability on technical trails, the Xodus Ultra 3 is perfect for all-day adventurers whether you’re tackling a grueling ultra race or just racking up the miles.Why You’ll Love ItYou’ll love the Xodus Ultra 3 for its energetic cushioning and confidence-inspiring grip that lets you tackle any terrain.SustainabilityThis style is vegan and contains recycled materials.00

The Saucony Ride 18 blends comfort and performance seamlessly.

With its streamlined design and dependable cushioning, this lightweight shoe is the ultimate training partner for runners seeking a smooth, balanced ride without unnecessary frills.

In our Saucony Ride 18 review, reviewers loved the premium feel and plush fit of the upper. “I was really blown away by the upper. It’s the same engineered mesh material as the previous version, but small details give it an extra luxurious feeling,” says Caroline.

Whether you’re logging easy miles or chasing new goals, the Saucony Ride 18 keeps you moving forward in comfort.

  • Outsole: The durable rubber outsole features a refined tread pattern, enhancing traction and promoting smooth transitions from heel to toe.

product.description:
The Saucony Peregrine 15 will take you to the summit and back, no matter the terrain.

Named after the fastest bird on earth, the lightweight and low-profile Peregrine 15 is designed to handle challenging trails with ease. With aggressive traction, enhanced cushioning and superior protection it delivers a nimble yet forgiving ride for any distance.

Details:

  • Upper: The high-strength mesh upper is designed with reinforced protection in high-abrasion areas to shield you from roots and rocks, while the D-Ring gaiter compatibility keeps debris out on dusty or muddy trails. This durable construction offers a secure and adaptable fit for all-day comfort.
  • Midsole: A newly formulated PWRRUN foam midsole enhances cushioning, comfort and flexibility like never before. Whether you're tackling steep climbs or uneven descents, the responsive feel keeps your stride smooth and stable, offering the perfect balance of protection and agility. A forefoot rock guard adds an extra layer of defense, so you can focus on your run without distraction.
  • Outsole: A full-coverage PWRTRAC rubber outsole with aggressive 5 mm lugs gives you unparalleled durability and traction.
