product.description:
Find out what fast feels like in the Saucony Endorphin Speed 5.

Designed to help you find your version of fast, the Endorphin Speed 5 combines Saucony's lightweight, responsive cushioning with their rocker SPEEDROLL technology and a nylon plate to propel you forward with confidence. In our Saucony Endorphin Speed 5 review, run tester Kate said "The Speed 5 provides a smooth, buoyant underfoot feel. It makes me feel like I'm floating. Don't be surprised if your running buddies have to tell you to slow down."

Details:

  • Upper: The new Hexagon Mesh upper features six-sided perforations for enhanced breathability and a performance-focused feel. A 3D heel counter locks your foot in place for secure, confident runs.
  • Midsole: The refined PWRRUN PB cushioning delivers a firm, controlled ride that's perfect for speed work. It's combined with a full-length nylon plate and SPEEDROLL technology that creates smooth, propulsive transitions.
  • Outsole: Enhanced rubber coverage extends to the heel edge for improved durability, while a new vertical flex groove under the forefoot provides increased flexibility during toe-offs.

product.description:
The Saucony Triumph 23 delivers plush comfort, reliable cushioning and smooth performance mile after mile.

This premium cushioned shoe features softer PWRRUN PB foam that creates the perfect balance of softness and durability for your daily miles. In our review of the Saucony Triumph 23, run tester Max said, "The PWRRUN PB foam is soft, which is what I want in a high-cushion shoe built for daily miles and long runs, but it's also surprisingly energetic. It provides some pep in my step, even during longer runs."

Combined with Saucony's innovative Super Responsive Sockliner that adds another layer of underfoot comfort, the Triumph 23 will be your go-to for easy runs, recovery days and those important training miles that build the foundation for your bigger goals.

Details:

  • Upper: Thick, cushy padding wraps your foot in luxurious comfort without adding weight. The engineered mesh upper gives you a roomy fit that accommodates different foot shapes while the tubular laces and extra eyelet let you customize the lockdown exactly how you need it.
  • Midsole: A PWRRUN PB blend uses super-critically foamed ePEBA material that's softer than previous versions, delivering plush cushioning that still feels responsive. Plus, the Super Responsive Sockliner adds an extra layer of foam underfoot for a gloriously comfortable ride.
  • Outsole: A redesigned carbon-rubber outsole creates more flexibility in the midfoot for smoother transitions, while maintaining the durability you need for logging serious mileage.

Chase your fastest times with the Saucony Endorphin Pro 5.

Built for the moments when everything you've trained for comes together on race day, this premium carbon-plated shoe brings together dual-layer super foam and an aggressive new carbon plate to help you run faster when it counts. With Super Critical PWRRUN HG foam on top and PWRRUN PB foam below, the Endorphin Pro 5 gives you the lightweight, responsive ride you need to chase down those personal bests.

Tackle any trail with the Saucony Peregrine 16.

Built for runners exploring beyond the pavement, this rugged trail shoe brings full-coverage VIBRAM Megagrip traction and proven PWRRUN cushioning to help you handle whatever the terrain throws at you. The men's Saucony Procyon Max is built for runners and walkers who want a smooth, protective ride they can count on every day. A broad platform and elevated sidewalls create a stable base, while a generous stack of PWRRUN foam delivers the kind of soft comfort that makes long days on your feet feel a little easier. Whether you're clocking training miles or just running errands, this shoe is designed to keep you feeling secure and cushioned from the first step to the last.

Details:

  • Upper: The Procyon Max features a breathable mesh upper that keeps feet comfortable and cool through every mile. It wraps the foot in a lightweight, secure fit without adding bulk, so the shoe feels light on your feet.
  • Midsole: A thick layer of PWRRUN foam gives this shoe its soft, protective ride. Higher sidewalls cradle the foot and add a locked in feeling that helps keep every stride controlled even at a max cushion stack height.
  • Outsole: Zoned XT-900 rubber lines the bottom of the shoe for reliable traction and long-lasting durability. The outsole is designed to let the foot move naturally, so transitions from heel to toe feel smooth rather than restricted.

The Saucony Kinvara Pro is primed to be your carbon-plated running shoe for 99% of your runs. Not just race day.

With cushioning for days and the comfort of your favorite daily trainer, the Kinvara Pro’s ride is as fun and addictive as bouncing on a trampoline.

The Saucony Xodus Ultra 2 Runshield is designed to give you maximum comfort and dry feet over the long haul.

Keep your feet warm and dry while you run through puddles, snow, slush and more— the waterproof Runshield upper keeps the elements out and uses ripstop fabric that is as rugged and tough as the trails you take them on. Plus, there is an internal midfoot cage to help secure your foot with a nice lockdown so you have the confidence to tackle uneven trails.

The Xodus Ultra 2 has plenty of cushion underfoot and extra room in the toe box for long miles on the trail. Its PWRRUN PB foam midsole is lightweight, responsive and springy to give you an energy boost for those later miles, while Saucony’s PWRRUN frame adds stability when you’re running over uneven terrain.

These trail shoes let you run technical trails with ease. Saucony used a three-piece PWRTRAC outsole to give you plenty of grip in unfavorable conditions, while the rock guard and debris shield protect your foot from rocks, roots and dirt.

Get ultimate comfort for ultra-distances with the Saucony Xodus Ultra 2 Runshield.

Get ready for speed when you lace up the Saucony Endorphin Pro 3.

This fast shoe is designed with a carbon-fiber plate and an even thicker stack of PWRRUN PB foam to give you more pop underfoot as you run at breakneck speeds. Saucony added 4 mm of their PWRRUN PB cushioning to increase the stack height of the shoe (just under the 40 mm Worth Athletics’ limit for competition), to provide more cushion and comfort while you run by the competition. Saucony also changed the geometry of the shoe to fit the additional stack height.

Saucony uses its SPEEDROLL technology combined with an S-curve carbon-fiber plate to propel you forward effortlessly, making it one of the best carbon-plated shoes. Even with this increase in cushion and new geometry, the Endorphin Pro 3 is lighter than the previous version. The XT-900 outsole grips the road better, allowing you to race around corners with ease.

A lightweight upper is breathable and comfortable thanks to Saucony’s FORMFIT design that hugs every part of your foot for a personalized fit and feel.

Push past your limits in the Saucony Endorphin Pro 3.

Read more in our Saucony Endorphin Pro 3 review.

The Saucony Xodus Ultra is designed to keep you comfortable while you answer the question “how far can I run?”

Built for long trails, the ultralight, ultra-cushioned and ultra-responsive PWRRUN PB midsole foam is surrounded by a durable PWRRUN frame to keep you running all day (and night) long. This combination gives you a stable and cushioned ride with excellent energy return. A new 6mm heel-to-toe drop gives you a grounded feeling throughout your run, while the roomier toe box provides comfort for your toes.

A redesigned three-piece PWRTRAC outsole gives you the grip and traction you need while navigating even the gnarliest terrain. It also gives you the flexibility necessary for a smooth stride when the ground is anything but smooth. The improved rock plate provides durable protection against rocks and roots.

A minimal upper decreases hot spots and allows for your foot to breathe. There is a debris shield that keeps dirt and rocks out of your shoes and on the path where they belong. Plus, a contoured sockliner hugs your foot for the perfect fit.

Go the distance in comfort with the Saucony Xodus Ultra.

product.description:
Run with effortless support in the Saucony Guide 15.

The Guide 15 is softer and lighter than its predecessor thanks to a new PWRRUN formula that is pillowy soft, yet springy. Saucony increased the stack height and changed the midsole geometry to bring you more comfort and rolling, smooth transitions from heel to toe. There is also more flexibility in the forefoot to allow for a more fluid stride.

Saucony’s new lightweight HOLLOW-TECH guidance system gives stability to those who have flexible arches or excessively overpronate. Designers also included more underfoot contouring and higher sidewalls, so you sit into the footbed as opposed to on top of it. This allows the shoe to hug your foot, creating a better underfoot sensation and more supportive fit. Plus, Saucony added more outsole rubber in high-abrasion areas to increase the durability of the shoe.

Saucony’s FORMFIT upper ensures a personalized fit and feel, top to bottom. The upper is comprised of lightweight and breathable mesh for a sleek fit.

More foam, less weight, and a touch of support—take your running to new heights in the Saucony Guide 15.

Learn more in our Saucony 15 review.

Each run will be smooth as silk in the Saucony Ride 16.

Every step is comfortable and peppy in the Ride 16 thanks to Saucony’s PWRRUN cushioning. The midsole has higher sidewalls, so you sit into the shoe as opposed to on top of it, making it melt away on your foot and providing effortless transitions. Whether you are walking for mental health or trying to run a faster half marathon, the Saucony Ride 16 is a great everyday workhorse that can help you achieve your goals.

product.description:
Fly through the trails with the Saucony Peregrine 12.

This tried and true trail shoe has everything that you love from previous versions of the Peregrine but in a lighter, more comfortable and more protective package.

In our Peregrine 12 review, testers noted that “It still feels like the Peregrine that I have known and loved for the past several years, but it’s noticeably lighter, more nimble and grippier.”

Saucony added a new bendable rock plate that gives you protection and a smooth ride on rocky trails. It also allows the shoe to drain when you are running through streams, rivers or puddles. They redesigned the PWRTRAC outsole to give you better traction and allow you to dig in and take off with speed.

Feel comfortable during long or short trail runs with Saucony’s soft, springy PWRRUN cushioning. They even added more comfort with a new sockliner made with PWRRUN+ cushioning.

The upper has been stripped down to give you a more comfortable feel. But there is now a tighter weave that keeps dirt and debris out, while still being breathable. Plus, they retooled the laces, using fabric eyelets for a tighter, more locked-down fit. Strategic overlays on the upper to protect against sticks and stones and a toe guard keeps you from stubbing your toe on roots.

Take on the trails with confidence in the Saucony Peregrine 12.

product.description:
The Saucony Kinvara 13 is lighter than ever for a fast, plateless run.

The Kinvara legacy continues. Known for being lightweight and fast, this shoe is great for speedwork but still has enough underfoot for everyday training and racing. This is a nimble and flexible shoe, partially because it does not have a rigid carbon plate.

Saucony beveled the midsole and streamlined the midfoot for a super smooth and super-fast ride. The light and responsive PWRRUN cushioning adds spring to your run and lets you pick up the pace. Plus, there is durable XT-900 rubber in strategic high-wear areas for traction.

Saucony changed the upper, streamlining it to give you a barely-there feel. The enhanced fit and breathability can be credited to the engineered mono mesh upper that’s more comfortable and accommodates more foot shapes.

Flexible and fast, the Saucony Kinvara 13 will be your new go-to shoe.

Read more: Saucony Kinvara 13 Review.

Bad weather won’t stop you from tackling the trails in the Saucony Peregrine 12 GTX.

Explore any trails in any weather with the Saucony Peregrine 12 GTX.

Do it all in the Saucony Freedom 5.

Whether you are going for a run or taking a HIIT class, the Saucony Freedom 5 is your go-to shoe. Saucony took this shoe up a notch by adding lightweight, super responsive PWRRUN PB foam to this shoe. This foam is known for its excellent cushion and amazing energy return which is why it is also used in the speedy Endorphin Pro 2 and Endorphin Speed 2.

Low to the ground, the Freedom 5 gives you support, agility and speed—great for zipping around corners in a 5K or doing burpees in the gym. The durable outsole can easily handle both forward and lateral movement, while the flex grooves in the forefoot give you the flexibility to take off.

An engineered mesh upper adds style and breathability to your workout and the material is more structured in the heel area to give support. The rich suede accents and intricate mesh patterns give the Freedom a dash of pizzazz, making you want to reach for it time and time again.

Go for a run or hit the gym in the versatile Saucony Freedom 5. Learn more in our Saucony Freedom 5 Review.

product.description:
Fly through the trails with the Saucony Peregrine 12.

This tried and true trail shoe has everything that you love from previous versions of the Peregrine but in a lighter, more comfortable and more protective package.

In our Peregrine 12 review, testers noted that “It still feels like the Peregrine that I have known and loved for the past several years, but it’s noticeably lighter, more nimble and grippier.”

Saucony added a new bendable rock plate that gives you protection and a smooth ride on rocky trails. It also allows the shoe to drain when you are running through streams, rivers or puddles. They redesigned the PWRTRAC outsole to give you better traction and allow you to dig in and take off with speed.

Feel comfortable during long or short trail runs with Saucony’s soft, springy PWRRUN cushioning. They even added more comfort with a new sockliner made with PWRRUN+ cushioning.

The upper has been stripped down to give you a more comfortable feel. But there is now a tighter weave that keeps dirt and debris out, while still being breathable. Plus, they retooled the laces, using fabric eyelets for a tighter, more locked-down fit. Strategic overlays on the upper to protect against sticks and stones and a toe guard keeps you from stubbing your toe on roots.

Take on the trails with confidence in the Saucony Peregrine 12.

product.description:
Chase those personal records in the Saucony Tempus.

The Saucony Tempus is a stability shoe that’s supercharged with a full-length bed of Saucony’s PWRRUN PB foam, providing lightweight cushioning and amazing energy return.

The PWRRUN PB foam is set inside a PWRRUN Frame that supports your foot as you land, stabilizes it through the midfoot and provides for a snappy takeoff. Your foot sits securely in the shoe for a plush and supportive fit thanks to deep contouring. The midsole geometry gives you a supportive base and a super smooth ride. All these features combine to give you support and stability during your run, which is particularly helpful if you overpronate or have flexible arches.

A lightweight, breathable mesh upper complements the Tempus perfectly. The rounded heel counter hugs your heel and keeps you secure. Plus, a lightweight midfoot saddle and adaptive lacing allow you to dial in your perfect fit.

The Saucony Tempus will give you confidence and comfort whether you’re going for a long run or want to pick up the pace.

product.description:
Feel-good cushioning and propulsive speed make every run feel better in the Saucony Endorphin Shift 3.

When you first lace up the Endorphin Shift 3, you’ll love how the FORMFIT design hugs every part of your foot for a personalized fit and feel. The upper is made with lightweight and breathable mesh that feels like nothing’s there. It is paired with a streamlined heel clip that supports the back of your foot, so you’ll feel nimble and light on your feet.

The Endorphin Shift 3 is stacked with a taller bed of Saucony’s PWRRUN cushioning and a PWRRUN+ sockliner for extra comfort over long miles or long weekends on your feet. To elevate your stride and propel you forward effortlessly, Saucony used their SPEEDROLL Technology and a new torsional heel groove to give you a smooth and snappy transition from heel to forefoot.

Finished off with an XT-900 rubber outsole for grip and durability, this shoe can keep up with you whether you’re training for a marathon or doing speed work.

With high cushioning and a midsole geometry that works hard so you don’t have to, watch your best runs come to life with the Saucony Endorphin Shift 3.

Read more in our Saucony Endorphin Shift 3 review.

The Saucony Kinvara Pro is primed to be your carbon-plated running shoe for 99% of your runs. Not just race day.

With cushioning for days and the comfort of your favorite daily trainer, the Kinvara Pro’s ride is as fun and addictive as bouncing on a trampoline.

Unlike its race-day cousin, the Endorphin Pro, the Kinvara Pro is made to hold up to your runs day after day—and thanks to its gentle rolling sensation and ¾-length carbon plate that propels you forward effortlessly, building your running base never felt so easy.

  • Midsole: dual cushioning system that starts with responsive and energy-efficient PWRRUN PB cushioning closest to the foot and a high stack of durable and comfortable PWRRUN cushioning underneath. Sandwiched in between these durable foams is a ¾-length carbon plate that helps to gently roll you forward.

product.description:
The Saucony Ride 17 has the cushioning you crave for everyday movement without sacrificing high energy return for your runs and workouts.

This lightweight trainer blends comfort and performance seamlessly. Great for long runs or just walking around town, a generous stack of springy foam underfoot gives you a smooth ride that’s easier on your body. In fact, our reviewers noted how smooth the shoe transitions from walking to run and back again in our Saucony Ride 17 review.

Details:

  • Upper: An engineered mesh design gives you more breathability across the toes, an improved midfoot wrap and locked-down comfort in the heel—so your feet will stay comfortable and cool no matter how long you’re on the move.
  • Midsole: Upgraded with Saucony’s advanced PWRRUN+ cushioning, the new midsole design reduces weight and improves energy return for an exciting, yet forgiving ride.
  • Outsole: Durable underfoot in high-wear areas, the outsole was crafted to improve ground contact and keep up with your daily mileage.

product.description:
The Saucony Guide 14 is one of the best kids running shoes—perfect for running their first 5K or just wearing to gym class.

The youth Saucony Guide 14 gives you all of the stability you need thanks to a medial side post that is ideal for kids with flexible arches or who overpronate. A compression-molded EVA foam provides cushion while they are running around and the FORMFIT performance contoured footbed hugs their feet.

The mesh upper gives structure and stretch with no-sew material applications so they can skip, run and jump with ease. Saucony helped out the parents by putting in an antimicrobial lining to keep the shoes smelling fresh after your kids run in them. Plus, they have a reinforced toe cap that will help with durability when your kids drag their feet or kick rocks.

Tri-flex rubberized lugs on the outsole will help with grip on slippery school floors and the non-marking rubber outsole is great for both durability and allows your kid to wear them to gym class.

Give your kid comfort, cushion and stability in the lightweight Saucony Guide 14.

product.description:
Get ready for speed when you lace up the Saucony Endorphin Pro 3.

This fast shoe is designed with a carbon-fiber plate and an even thicker stack of PWRRUN PB foam to give you more pop underfoot as you run at breakneck speeds. Saucony added 4 mm of their PWRRUN PB cushioning to increase the stack height of the shoe (just under the 40 mm Worth Athletics’ limit for competition), to provide more cushion and comfort while you run by the competition. Saucony also changed the geometry of the shoe to fit the additional stack height.

Saucony uses its SPEEDROLL technology combined with an S-curve carbon-fiber plate to propel you forward effortlessly, making it one of the best carbon-plated shoes. Even with this increase in cushion and new geometry, the Endorphin Pro 3 is lighter than the previous version. The XT-900 outsole grips the road better, allowing you to race around corners with ease.

A lightweight upper is breathable and comfortable thanks to Saucony’s FORMFIT design that hugs every part of your foot for a personalized fit and feel.

Push past your limits in the Saucony Endorphin Pro 3.

product.description:
Be lightning quick on the trail in the Saucony Endorphin Edge.

This lightweight trail shoe propels you forward with SPEEDROLL technology that lets you fly through the trails. A flexible Carbitex™ AFX carbon-fiber plate is purpose-built for trail running, giving you incredible speed and efficiency without sacrificing ground feel. Its three-quarter length is engineered to give you an adaptable heel strike for the varied terrain. Plus, it has a PWRTRAC outsole for grip and traction on the trail.

The Endorphin Edge is lightweight and fast thanks to its PWRRUN PB cushioning that helps you go far, fast. The cushioning provides amazing energy return every step of the way.

A lightweight mesh upper actively pulls moisture away from your foot and evaporates quickly to keep your feet dry and comfortable. This shoe has a bit of room in the forefoot, which works well for trail runners with a wider foot.

The Saucony Endorphin Edge will have you racing off-road to places unknown.

This shoe runs a little short. We recommend going up a half-size from your normal running shoe.

Speedwork? Long run? Racing? You can do it all in the Saucony Endorphin Speed 3.

Saucony updated this shoe to make it faster than ever. Designers changed the geometry of the shoe, making it a bit wider, to give you a smoother ride as you run. Then they added more of their ultra light PWRRUN PB foam, increasing the stack height and making it more cushioned and bouncy, so you can run faster for longer.

Saucony’s SPEEDROLL technology propels you forward step after step, while a new S-curve winged nylon plate returns your energy throughout your run so your legs feel fresh. It supports your foot throughout your stride, so you can push your pace.

A new upper gives you a better fit throughout your entire foot, while staying lightweight and breathable. In our Saucony Endorphin Speed 3 review, one tester noted, “The upper is simply perfect. My feet feel locked down with plenty of breathability and just that touch of extra padding that’s nice for longer miles. There’s enough room for my wider feet to stretch out as needed.” Plus, there is a XT-900 rubber outsole to let you grip the road as you run.

Fast and lightweight, yet durable enough for everyday training, the Saucony Endorphin Speed 3 will help you run to your next personal best.

product.description:
The Saucony Ride 15 TR delivers a comfort-first sensation that will take your trail runs to new heights.

Saucony re-engineered their signature PWRRUN formula to give you a lighter and softer foam underfoot for your most comfortable ride yet. The additional cushioning allows you to sit deeper into the footbed, hugging your foot and offering a plush and supportive feel every step of the way. Plus, Saucony added an extra layer of comfort with a PWRRUN+ cushioned sockliner.

The low-profile PWRTRAC outsole gives you trail-worthy grip and a road-friendly ride, making this a great road-to-trail shoe. The lightweight yet durable upper allows you to run on both the roads and trails. It is protective enough for those rugged trail runs yet breathable enough to take on the roads. A supportive webbing helps lock you in for the perfect fit.

The Saucony Ride 15 TR can do it all—roads, trails and everything in between, you can run whenever the wind takes you.

Whether you are racing in Chicago or just want to represent the Windy City, you can do it in style with Saucony Chicago 2022 Endorphin Speed 3. This special edition shoe has all of the same great features as the Endorphin Speed 3, along with an upper inspired by the Chicago flag and all of the city’s unique parts.

Saucony updated this shoe to make it faster than ever. Designers changed the geometry of the shoe, making it a bit wider, to give you a smoother ride as you run. Then they added more of their ultra-light PWRRUN PB foam, increasing the stack height and making it more cushioned and bouncy, so you can run faster for longer.

Saucony’s SPEEDROLL technology propels you forward step after step, while a new S-curve winged nylon plate returns your energy throughout your run so your legs feel fresh. It supports your foot throughout your stride, so you can push your pace.

A new upper gives you a better fit throughout your entire foot while staying lightweight and breathable. In our Saucony Endorphin Speed 3 review, one tester noted, “The upper is simply perfect. My feet feel locked down with plenty of breathability and just that touch of extra padding that’s nice for longer miles. There’s enough room for my wider feet to stretch out as needed.” Plus, there is an XT-900 rubber outsole to let you grip the road as you run.

Fast and lightweight, yet durable enough for everyday training, the Saucony Chicago 2022 Endorphin Speed 3 will help you run through the Second City quicker to get a shiny new PR.

The Saucony Triumph 20 provides maximum comfort and softness that lasts.

Saucony added a new PWRRUN+ foam cushioning that is softer, lighter and more resilient than ever before. Designers added extra cushioning underfoot for more comfort, which increased the stack height and heel-to-toe drop. A newly updated midsole geometry gives you a soft and smooth rocker feel that transitions you seamlessly throughout your run.

A new upper and lacing design dials in the fit and feel. There is a better lockdown at the eyelets to secure your heel. The blown rubber outsole is durable to handle all your training miles. The Saucony Triumph 20 is one of the best cushioned running shoes for your runs.

product.description:
Winter won’t slow down your runs when you’re wearing the Saucony Endorphin Speed 3 Runshield.

This special edition shoe has all of the same great features as the Endorphin Speed 3, with a water-resistant upper inspired by “miles to go before I sleep,” the closing sentiment of Robert Frost’s “Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening.”

Saucony updated this shoe to make it faster than ever. Designers changed the geometry of the shoe, making it a bit wider, to give you a smoother ride as you run. Then they added more of their ultralight PWRRUN PB foam, increasing the stack height and making it more cushioned and bouncy, so you can run faster for longer.

Saucony’s SPEEDROLL technology propels you forward step after step, while a new S-curve winged nylon plate returns your energy throughout your run so your legs feel fresh. It supports your foot throughout your stride, so you can push your pace. Plus, there is a XT-900 rubber outsole to let you grip the road as you run.

Fast and lightweight, the Saucony Endorphin Speed 3 Runsheild will keep your feet dry on the way to a new PR.

product.description:
The Saucony Xodus Ultra 2 is designed to give you maximum comfort over the long haul.

The Xodus Ultra 2 has plenty of cushion underfoot and extra room in the toe box for long miles on the trail. Its PWRRUN PB foam midsole is lightweight, responsive and springy to give you an energy boost for those later miles, while Saucony’s PWRRUN frame adds stability when you’re running over uneven terrain.

These trail shoes let you run technical trails with ease. They have a three-piece PWRTRAC outsole to give you plenty of grip in unfavorable conditions, while the rock guard and debris shield protect your foot from rocks, roots and trail debris.

A lightweight and breathable mesh upper completes the package. There is an internal midfoot cage to help secure your foot with a nice lockdown so you have the confidence to tackle uneven trails.

Get ultimate comfort for ultra-distances with the Saucony Xodus Ultra 2.

product.description:
The New Balance Fresh Foam Vongo v5 blends the best of Fresh Foam cushioning with creatively designed medial stability elements to deliver a supported ride mile after mile. A thick bed of New Balance’s Fresh Foam provides the shock absorption and cushion you need to feel comfortable on any run. Designers updated the Vongo v5 with a segmented outsole to provide dialed-in stability exactly where you need it.

The Vongo v5 uses a unique Hypoknit mesh upper for a smooth, socklike feel that is equally huggy and airy. This keeps the shoe feeling ventilated without compromising on support throughout the midfoot. A rounded toe box accommodates natural toe-splay as you run, adding to the stabilized feel of the shoe.

product.description:
Find energy in every step in the New Balance FuelCell Rebel v2.

The Rebel v2 delivers responsiveness to you thanks to New Balance’s high-rebound FuelCell midsole foam. Designers reworked the geometry of the shoe to create smooth transitions and bouncy cushioning with each step.

The outsole is engineered to take on daily mileage while providing the traction you need to generate top speeds during workouts. The heel and outer edge of the outsole are reinforced with durable blown rubber so your run feels fresh after logging big mileage.

New Balance constructed the upper from lightweight, engineered mesh to provide the structure and support you need to stay engaged on your run without adding extra weight to the shoe. Logo overlays provide lateral support, and an anatomical heel collar adds to the barely-there feeling of the upper.

Whether you’re chasing down a PR or are looking for a lightweight addition to your shoe collection, the New Balance FuelCell Rebel v2 is the shoe for you.

product.description:
The New Balance FuelCell Rebel v4 will make you feel light and fast on the road.

Crafted with a new PEBA/EVA blend FuelCell midsole foam, the energetic cushioning gives these shoes a feather-light feel and an exhilarating bounce. An extra 2.5 mm of stack height keeps you comfortable during long runs, while the propulsive ride and sleek upper makes it easy to run fast during uptempo training.

“I can easily feel how the Rebel v4 propels me forward with each step, even without a carbon plate, thanks to the soft yet bouncy foam,” said Ashley during our Rebel v4 testing.

Read more in our New Balance FuelCell Rebel v4 review.

Details:

  • Upper: The FantomFit synthetic mesh upper offers ultra-light bonded support and no-sew construction for a sleek fit and a locked-down feel.
  • Midsole: A PEBA/EVA blend of New Balance’s FuelCell foam and an extra 2.5 mm of stack height delivers protection on the road and a propulsive feel to help drive you forward.
  • Outsole: Strategically place rubber outsole for grip and durability that can hold up to your daily miles.
product.kitContent:
Accordion1What’s New

New Balance totally revamped the FuelCell Rebel v4 by upgrading the midsole to a blend of PEBA/EVA foam with a taller and wider base that's both lightweight and maintains that propulsive feel. Designers also returned to a FantomFit upper that keeps the fit breathable and lightweight.

Who It’s Best For

The New Balance FuelCell Rebel v4 is an ultra-lightweight neutral running shoe that’s perfect for runners looking to do a little bit of everything.

“The Rebel v4 is an excellent tempo shoe, easy run shoe and long run shoe,” says Ashley in our https://www.fleetfeet.com/blog... Balance FuelCell Rebel v4 review. “It’s a really fantastic choice for half- and full marathon training. Plus, it’s a really great choice if you don’t want to splurge on carbon-plated shoes.”

Why You’ll Love It

Springy and light as a feather, you’ll love how fast and energetic running in the Rebel v4 feels.00

Equipped with a Vibram® Outsole for traction and durability on uneven terrain, and a tall stack of Fresh Foam X cushioning to smooth out your ride, there’s no challenge these trail running shoes aren’t up for.

product.description:
The New Balance Fresh Foam X 860v14 takes your reliable stability trainer and makes it even better.

New underfoot technology in the latest 860 delivers a supremely cushioned yet highly stable ride. Built on a wider platform with elevated sidewalls, the midsole creates a guidance frame that eases you through your stride. Then, New Balance flipped the script by using a softer, more responsive Fresh Foam X compound on top where your foot makes contact, combined with a denser foam below for support and durability.

The result is a stable, soft and responsive underfoot experience that absorbs impact and energizes your every step.

Details:

  • Upper: The engineered mesh upper provides all-day comfort with a secure, breathable fit. New Balance also partnered with Repreve to incorporate recycled bottle content, making the 860v14 equal parts performance and sustainability.
  • Midsole: The top layer of the midsole uses New Balance’s cushy and energetic Fresh Foam X material. Underneath sits New Balance’s brand-new EVA Film Stability technology which includes a wider landing platform throughout, elevated sidewalls around the foot that encourage forward motion and a flared heel that eases you through your stride.
  • Outsole: The integrated outsole design promotes forefoot stiffness for confident toe-offs.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What’s NewNew Balance totally reimagined the Fresh Foam X 860 for its 14th iteration. The midsole comes upgraded with an evolved Fresh Foam X material and an extra 2-4 mm of stack height compared to the previous version. However, the biggest change comes from their brand-new EVA Film Stability technology that frames a wider, more dense midsole material underneath to give you a stable and reliable platform to run on. According to New Balance, the 860v14 also has greater displacement (cushioning) and increased energy return compared to the v13.Who It’s Best ForFor those who have come to rely on the 860 for mild-to-moderate overpronation, the latest version lives up to its reputation as a reliable stability trainer for daily runs and workouts that doesn't compromise on step-in comfort. Why You’ll Love ItYou’ll love the upgraded midsole of the 860 v14 that gently guides your foot through its stride and gives you a pillowy soft ride.00

product.description:
Energize your daily runs with the New Balance Fresh Foam X Balos.

This exciting new uptempo trainer blends speed and comfort with a PEBA-blended Fresh Foam X midsole that’s super bouncy and responsive. Combined with a rocker shape that rolls you forward for a smooth ride, the Balos shines when you need to pick up the pace while maximizing comfort.

In our New Balance Fresh Foam X Balos review, wear-tester Kate says, “The shape of the shoe feels like it propels me forward, and the foam has a fun, bouncy quality to it. I’ve really enjoyed all of my runs in this shoe so far.”

Details:

  • Upper: The engineered mesh upper offers a breathable fit and a snug lockdown during faster-paced efforts.
  • Midsole: A PEBA-blended Fresh Foam X midsole is lightweight and peppy while a 6 mm drop and rocker shape propels you forward.
  • Outsole: The EVA outsole gives the Balos a soft and smooth ride compared to shoes that use a rubber outsole.
product.kitContent:
Video1https://ffecomassets.s3.amazonaws.com/Balos-Thumbnail_YT_thumb.pngGlfIetD5N_scontainedAccordion1Who It’s Best For

For cushion lovers looking for a peppier version of the New Balance 1080, the Balos is a great option. Our reviewers found it was very stable underfoot despite the tall stack height and even liked wearing it for midday walks and casual wear.

“I would recommend the Balos to so many people,” Kate says. “It can be a really nice all-purpose trainer for runners who like bouncy cushioning and a rocker shape without a carbon plate. It’s also good for tempo-paced runs since it’s lightweight and capable of picking up the pace.”

Why You’ll Love ItLightweight and energetic without sacrificing on cushion, you’ll love the Balos’ long-run comfort and everyday versatility. 00

Run your fastest times yet in the New Balance FuelCell SuperComp Elite v4 NYC.

This carbon-plated racing shoe will help you break PRs and blow past the competition. It is super lightweight, responsive and ready to propel you to the finish line.   • Midsole: A new FuelCell PEBA-based cushioning gives you plenty of cushion and bounce, while a thin carbon plate shaves weight while maintaining the stiffness needed to propel you towards the finish line.

product.description:
The New Balance Fresh Foam X 1080 v14 is your go-to daily trainer for soft, cushioned runs.

This high-cushioned road shoe is your key to next-level comfort thanks to its Fresh Foam X midsole that delivers an ultra-plush underfoot feel without sacrificing responsiveness.

In our New Balance Fresh Foam X 1080 v14 review, tester Max said, “The 1080 v14 is my go-to trainer for long runs and recovery days because it’s just so soft and gives the “max-cushion” feel throughout the ride while providing some decent bounce back and energy return with the Fresh Foam X midsole compound.”

Details:

  • Upper: The breathable upper with a gusseted tongue hugs your foot in all the right places, ensuring a perfect fit no matter your foot shape.
  • Midsole: The Fresh Foam X midsole made with approximately 3% bio-based content delivers a cushioned experience for a smooth ride on the road.
  • Outsole: The NDurance rubber outsole is durable enough to keep up with your mileage.

product.description:
The New Balance FuelCell Rebel v5 delivers lightweight speed, energetic cushioning and a race-inspired design for runners who want every mile to feel fast.

The Rebel v5 doesn’t just look fast. It feels fast. This dynamic trainer features a blend of PEBA and EVA foams that creates a responsive, propulsive underfoot experience that's perfect for when you want to pick up the pace. Incredibly lightweight, the Rebel v5 transitions effortlessly from long, steady runs to spontaneous speed sessions, giving you the versatility to follow wherever your run takes you.

Details:

  • Upper: The engineered mesh upper provides lightweight support and excellent breathability, while FantomFit technology offers ultra-light bonded support without added weight. Plus, a redesigned heel and tongue enhance comfort during fast-paced efforts.
  • Midsole: FuelCell technology combines PEBA and EVA foams to deliver a propulsive feel that drives you forward with every step. This version features even more foam underfoot than its predecessor, creating a responsive and energetic ride that's built for speed.
  • Outsole: A redesigned outsole places more rubber at the forefoot for improved durability and traction where you need it most during toe-offs and quick transitions.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewNew Balance upgraded the Rebel v5 with even more foam underfoot while maintaining the lightweight feel that makes this shoe special. The redesigned outsole adds strategic rubber placement at the forefoot for better durability, while updates to the heel and tongue improve comfort during faster efforts. The result is a shoe that feels faster and more responsive while staying true to the Rebel's lightweight, energetic character.Who It's Best ForThe New Balance FuelCell Rebel v5 is perfect for runners who want a lightweight trainer that can handle everything from daily miles to speed work. Whether you're looking to add some energy to your regular training runs or need a shoe that can seamlessly transition from steady efforts to final kicks towards the finish line, this versatile trainer delivers the responsive feel that makes running feel effortless and fun.Why You'll Love ItYour training runs just got a major upgrade with the Rebel v5. You'll love how this shoe makes every step feel energetic and propulsive, turning ordinary miles into something that feels fast and exciting. 00
product.productIntroText: The FuelCell Rebel v5 is light, quick and ready to go faster—a versatile trainer that works just as well for tempo runs as it does for everyday miles.

product.description:
The New Balance 1080 v15 reimagines your everyday miles.

Bringing all-new Infinion foam technology to the shoe runners count on most, this latest version delivers consistent cushioning and energy return that lasts from your first step to your final mile.

New Balance added almost 2 mm of foam to the stack height from the previous version. But even with more cushioning underfoot, the new foam is light enough that designers shaved a full ounce from the overall weight of the shoe. Now lighter and more cushioned, the latest 1080 delivers dependable, everyday performance.

The 1080 v15 takes the comfort you already know and pairs it with innovation that keeps performing, run after run after run.

Details:

  • Upper: A one-piece circular knit creates a breathable, seamless feel around your foot. Stretch laces let you adjust the fit exactly how you like it, while the cushioned tongue and heel tab bring extra comfort (thanks to weight savings from the lighter midsole). Reflective hits keep you seen during early morning or late evening runs.
  • Midsole: New Balance's latest Infinion supercritical foam is engineered to maintain the same feel throughout your entire run. Testing shows it outperforms Fresh Foam X in cushioning, responsiveness and energy return, all while coming in lighter than before. The 6 mm drop keeps transitions feeling natural.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewInfinion foam represents a complete reimagining of the 1080's cushioning platform. This supercritical technology maintains consistent performance mile after mile, addressing one of the biggest challenges in running shoes—keeping that fresh feeling throughout your run. The circular knit upper and enhanced padding create a more refined experience from top to bottom.Who It's Best ForThe New Balance 1080 v15 welcomes runners who rely on their shoes to show up as consistently as they do. Perfect for anyone building mileage, training through a program or simply wanting a dependable shoe for daily runs or all-day wear.Why You'll Love ItYou’ll love the consistent ride of the 1080 v15 that keeps you comfortable from your first mile to your last. 00

product.description:
The newly designed carbon fiber plate in the SuperComp Elite v6 wasn't built for short bursts of speed. It was engineered specifically for the marathon, tuned to deliver increased forefoot propulsion precisely when your legs need it most.

ATPU Infinion foam sits at the heart of the midsole, delivering explosive energy return through a full-length Energy Arc that keeps the ride lively and responsive from the first mile to the final push. A newly designed carbon fiber plate provides increased forefoot propulsion with improved stiffness for more efficient toe-offs exactly when your legs are asking for help, and a refined rocker profile and midsole shaping work together to make fast paces feel accessible for every type of runner on their biggest day.

Details:

  • Upper: A single-layer translucent mesh keeps the weight as low as possible while FANTOMFIT external lockdown overlays secure the midfoot and heel with precision. A new last gives you an improved forefoot fit so your foot stays comfortable and locked in through every mile of the race.
  • Midsole: ATPU Infinion foam delivers serious energy return and an explosive, fast sensation underfoot. A full-length Energy Arc and newly designed carbon fiber plate work in concert with the rocker profile and midsole geometry to channel your effort forward efficiently — the kind of propulsive assist that shows up most when you need it most.
  • Outsole: An ultra-lightweight 1 mm outsole material provides tacky grip and reliable traction while keeping overall weight to an absolute minimum.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe SuperComp Elite v6 introduces ATPU Infinion foam and a full-length Energy Arc for improved energy return, a newly designed carbon fiber plate for increased forefoot propulsion and stiffness, a new last for better forefoot fit and a 1 mm ultra-lightweight outsole for maximum grip at minimum weight.Who It's Best ForDedicated marathon runners ready to race their best — whether that means a first-time finish or a long-chased PR. The SuperComp Elite v6 is built for the runner who has done the work and wants a shoe that shows up just as prepared on race day.Why You'll Love ItThe training is behind you. The plate is loaded, the foam is ready and the finish line is waiting. The SuperComp Elite v6 gives you every advantage a shoe can offer — the rest is all you.00
product.productIntroText: A marathon race day supershoe with ATPU Infinion foam, a newly designed carbon fiber plate and FANTOMFIT lockdown built for runners who have earned their PR and are ready to run it.

product.description:
Most carbon-plated shoes are built for the start line. The New Balance SuperComp Rebel was built for the miles that get you there.

A uniquely bottom-loaded carbon-infused plate is designed specifically for everyday running propulsion — not the rigid, aggressive feel of a race shoe, but a fast, energetic boost that makes your daily miles feel sharper and more purposeful. New Infinion foam delivers a 25% increase in energy return and the kind of lively, race-day sensation underfoot that makes reaching for this shoe easy. Combined with a 50% increase in bending stiffness from the plate geometry, the SuperComp Rebel is engineered to improve running economy on the runs that you do every single day.

Details:

  • Upper: FANTOMFIT technology provides a lightweight, structured fit that locks down the midfoot and heel securely through training miles without adding unnecessary weight or bulk. Thoughtfully engineered for the kind of everyday mileage that calls for both security and comfort mile after mile.
  • Midsole: New Infinion foam delivers serious energy return and an exciting, race-ready sensation underfoot for daily training. A bottom-loaded carbon-infused plate adds propulsive bending stiffness and forward momentum specifically tuned for everyday running.
  • Outsole: Trusted traction and a durable outsole design built to handle the long miles of a full training block.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe SuperComp Rebel v1 introduces an entirely new platform to the New Balance lineup — Infinion foam for 25% increased energy return, a uniquely bottom-loaded carbon-infused plate for 50% increased bending stiffness and a FANTOMFIT upper construction for a secure, lightweight training fit. Who It's Best ForRunners who want a fast, propulsive daily trainer that brings real performance technology to their regular rotation without waiting for race day to justify it. Ideal for runners training at higher volumes who want every run to feel like it counts.Why You'll Love ItPRs aren't just set on race day. The SuperComp Rebel v1 brings the energy return and propulsive plate feel of a race shoe to the daily training miles that do the real work.00
product.productIntroText: A lightweight, carbon-infused daily trainer with Infinion foam, a FANTOMFIT upper construction and a bottom-loaded plate built for runners who want a race day feel on every run.

product.description:
Maximize your energy for longer with the New Balance FuelCell SuperComp Trainer v2.

The SuperComp Trainer v2 brings that race-day energy to a high-mileage training shoe. It has Energy Arc technology that places a sport-specific carbon fiber plate between two layers of super lightweight FuelCell cushioning, leaving a hollow channel through the middle of the shoe. The plate is flattened into the channel with each foot strike and returns energy as it reshapes to create a rebound-effect and keep you running forward.

The FuelCell midsole foam is lightweight, bouncy and propulsive. It has been reformulated to make it even lighter so you can easily pick up the pace. A re-engineered upper adds structure for support and a breathable flat knit material for a locked-in fit, which our reviewers appreciated in our New Balance FuelCell SuperComp Trainer v2 review.

Go farther, faster and longer with the New Balance FuelCell SuperComp Trainer v2.

If you’re looking for a versatile trail shoe with long-term comfort, take the New Balance Fresh Foam More Trail v2 out for your next trail run or hike.

Maximize your energy for longer with the New Balance FuelCell SuperComp Trainer v2.

The SuperComp Trainer v2 brings that race-day energy to a high-mileage training shoe. It has Energy Arc technology that places a sport-specific carbon fiber plate between two layers of super lightweight FuelCell cushioning, leaving a hollow channel through the middle of the shoe. The plate is flattened into the channel with each foot strike and returns energy as it reshapes to create a rebound-effect and keep you running forward.

The FuelCell midsole foam is lightweight, bouncy and propulsive. It has been reformulated to make it even lighter so you can easily pick up the pace. A re-engineered upper adds structure for support and a breathable flat knit material for a locked-in fit, which our reviewers appreciated in our New Balance FuelCell SuperComp Trainer v2 review.

It has New Balance’s Energy Arc technology, which is an arched carbon fiber plate that is sandwiched in between two layers of their FuelCell cushioning. The geometry of the carbon fiber plate has strategic midsole voids to increase stored energy, which delivers a higher amount of total energy returned.

The FuelCell cushioning gives you soft landings and propels you forward during your run. One tester said "the thick slab of FuelCell foam is so springy and bouncy it makes each stride feel effortless. I love how soft yet responsive the cushioning is, too. It can be tough to blend those two elements into one shoe but New Balance does it perfectly here," in our New Balance FuelCell SuperComp Trainer review. A breathable, flat-knit upper provides a locked-in fit and feel. The gusseted tongue and “N” wrap-around logo secure your midfoot so you can push the pace.

Feel energized throughout your run with the New Balance FuelCell SuperComp Trainer.

product.description:
Bring that race-day feeling of energy return and speed to your everyday runs in the New Balance FuelCell SuperComp Trainer.

This high-mileage training shoe was designed to look, feel and perform differently than your traditional training shoe. It has New Balance’s Energy Arc technology, which is an arched carbon fiber plate that is sandwiched in between two layers of their FuelCell cushioning. The geometry of the carbon fiber plate has strategic midsole voids to increase stored energy, which delivers a higher amount of total energy returned.

The FuelCell cushioning gives you soft landings and propels you forward during your run. One tester said "the thick slab of FuelCell foam is so springy and bouncy it makes each stride feel effortless. I love how soft yet responsive the cushioning is, too. It can be tough to blend those two elements into one shoe but New Balance does it perfectly here," in our New Balance FuelCell SuperComp Trainer review. A breathable, flat-knit upper provides a locked-in fit and feel. The gusseted tongue and “N” wrap-around logo secure your midfoot so you can push the pace.

Feel energized throughout your run with the New Balance FuelCell SuperComp Trainer.

*Please note that the stack height of the New Balance FuelCell SuperComp Trainer has over a 40 mm stack height and cannot be used in competitions governed by World Athletic Organization rules.

The New Balance Fresh Foam X Trail More v3 brings max cushion to the trail, so you can roll over roots and rocks in comfort.

The Trail More v3 has a dual-density midsole to keep you comfortable mile after mile. On top, a layer of Fresh Foam X cushioning sits directly below your foot for a plush feel, while a firmer bed foam underneath improves durability and gives you a stable ride over uneven terrain.

The cushioning is paired with a Vibram® Ecostep Recycled outsole to give you plenty of grip on the trails—it has traction in the heel for braking downhill, while traction in the forefoot propels you forward during toe-off to give you the best run possible.

A breathable, engineered knit upper is equipped with printed, abrasion-resistant detailing, offering protection against trail debris. Plus, New Balance’s Toe Protect toe cap keeps you from stubbing your foot on roots and rocks.

Spend more time on the trails with the New Balance Fresh Foam X More Trail v3.

product.description:
Soft and bouncy to put a pep in your step, the New Balance Fresh Foam X 1080 v13 will be your go-to shoe.

The New Balance 1080 v13 is plush and luxurious to make every run more comfortable and enjoyable. One runner stated "Running in the 1080 v13 feels like running on one of those huge bouncy balls that you’d get as a kid, and the experience is just as exciting as picking a new ball out," in our New Balance 1080 v13 review. The newest version has been fine-tuned to help your runs feel energetic, soft and effortless, making it one of the best running shoes out there.

So whether you are training for your first 5K or putting in high-mileage weeks, the New Balance Fresh Foam X 1080 v13 will make each run more fun.

Features

  • Upper: A completely new upper gives you a plush and luxurious feel with a stretchy mesh that has zonal structure and support to feel great on your foot. There is also a gusseted tongue to wrap around your feet and keep you secure.
  • Midsole: A lighter, softer and more energetic Fresh Foam X with Bio Eva cushioning has been elevated to help you perform your best. An updated rocker profile makes transitions smoother and toe-offs more energetic. The forefoot is more responsive and a bit more structured than previous versions to help those miles roll by.
  • Outsole: NDurance rubber outsole is durable to keep up with your mileage. New Balance made it a little thinner to reduce the overall weight of the shoe and keep you ticking off those miles.

Soft and bouncy to put a pep in your step, the New Balance TCS NYC Marathon® Fresh Foam X 1080 v13 will be your go-to shoe to run around city that never sleeps.

This limited edition version of the New Balance Fresh Foam X 1080 v13 features official TCS NYC Marathon® race branding to let you celebrate your amazing accomplishment of running 26.2 miles through five boroughs of New York City.

The New Balance 1080 v13 is plush and luxurious to make every run more comfortable and enjoyable. The newest version has been fine-tuned to help your runs feel energetic, soft and effortless, making it one of the best running shoes out there. So whether you are training for your first 5K or putting in high-mileage weeks, the New Balance Fresh Foam X 1080 v13 will make each run more fun.

Details

  • Upper: A completely new upper gives you a plush and luxurious feel with a stretchy mesh that has zonal structure and support to feel great on your foot. There is also a gusseted tongue to wrap around your feet and keep you secure.
  • Midsole: A lighter, softer and more energetic Fresh Foam X with Bio Eva cushioning has been elevated to help you perform your best. An updated rocker profile makes transitions smoother and toe-offs more energetic. The forefoot is more responsive and a bit more structured than previous versions to help those miles roll by.
  • Outsole: NDurance rubber outsole is durable to keep up with your mileage. New Balance made it a little thinner to reduce the overall weight of the shoe and keep you ticking off those miles.

Check out our collection of New York City running gear for the latest limited edition apparel, shoes and gear celebrating the Big Apple.

Set new personal bests in the adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4, a cutting-edge super shoe designed for pure speed.

At the heart of the Adios Pro 4 lies a dual-layer Lightstrike Pro foam midsole—adidas' lightest and most responsive cushioning to date. Sandwiched between these foam layers is the ENERGYRODS system, featuring carbon rods that mirror your foot's metatarsal bones. The result is a seriously fast and snappy race-day shoe.

“I love the propulsive underfoot feel of the Pro 4,” says Kate in our adidas Adizero Adio Pro 4 review.

Details:

  • Upper: The new LIGHTLOCK upper provides a secure, race-ready fit with one-way stretch and internal support bands to keep you comfortable and confident while running at top speed.
  • Midsole: Built with dual layers of adidas' revolutionary Lightstrike Pro foam and innovative ENERGYRODS technology—carbon rods that mirror your foot's metatarsals—this shoe delivers exceptional energy return and propulsion. The reimagined rocker geometry triggers forward momentum for an improved running economy.
  • Outsole: adidas' new LIGHTTRAXION outsole material significantly reduces the shoe's overall weight compared to its predecessor. Strategic placement of Continental rubber beneath the big toe adds durability where you need it most while maintaining the shoe's lightweight racing profile.

product.description:
Set new personal bests in the adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4, a cutting-edge super shoe designed for pure speed.

At the heart of the Adios Pro 4 lies a dual-layer Lightstrike Pro foam midsole—adidas' lightest and most responsive cushioning to date. Sandwiched between these foam layers is the ENERGYRODS system, featuring carbon rods that mirror your foot's metatarsal bones. The result is a seriously fast and snappy race-day shoe.

“I love the propulsive underfoot feel of the Pro 4,” says Kate in our adidas Adizero Adio Pro 4 review.

Details:

  • Upper: The new LIGHTLOCK upper provides a secure, race-ready fit with one-way stretch and internal support bands to keep you comfortable and confident while running at top speed.
  • Midsole: Built with dual layers of adidas' revolutionary Lightstrike Pro foam and innovative ENERGYRODS technology—carbon rods that mirror your foot's metatarsals—this shoe delivers exceptional energy return and propulsion. The reimagined rocker geometry triggers forward momentum for an improved running economy.
  • Outsole: adidas' new LIGHTTRAXION outsole material significantly reduces the shoe's overall weight compared to its predecessor. Strategic placement of Continental rubber beneath the big toe adds durability where you need it most while maintaining the shoe's lightweight racing profile.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewDesigners replaced the outsole with their new LIGHTTRAXION material and included a Continental rubber strip beneath the big toe which significantly reduces weight. A new LIGHTLOCK upper that uses woven mesh material with one-way stretch and internal bands gives you a better fit and lockdown. Lastly, an adjustment of the rocker shape helps trigger forward momentum and improve running economy.Who It's Best ForThe Adizero Adios Pro 4 is a high-cushioned race-day shoe for runners looking for a fast, snappy and ultra-lightweight ride. product.description:
The adidas Adizero Adios Pro 3 takes your performance to the next level on race day.

The Adizero Adios Pro 3 is one of the best carbon-plated running shoes on the market today. The midsole consists of two layers of the resilient Lightstrike Pro foam that provides cushion and propels you throughout your run. Embedded in the midsole foam are ENERGYRODS 2.0 to give you the optimal level of stiffness and energy return.

Designers ran extensive tests in their labs and made a few changes to enhance the performance of the Adizero Adios Pro 3—they widened the base for more stability when racing around turns, made the ENERGYRODS 2.0 into one piece for smoother transitions, and cut out portions of the midsole to reduce weight.

A new lightweight upper provides support where runners need it the most. Athletes will notice a nice lockdown feel and snug heel in the redesign. There is also some internal midfoot support on the upper to allow you to run your best. Plus, adidas is committed to being more environmentally friendly and uses a minimum of 50% recycled content in the upper.

The outsole gives you great traction as you run as fast as you can. Extensive testing by adidas resulted in the placement of Continental rubber where runners toe-off to give you better traction and support as you sprint across the finish line.

Crush personal bests in the adidas Adizero Adios Pro 3. Note this is a unisex shoe and as such is listed in men’s sizing. Check out our shoe conversion guide to find your size.

Read more in our adidas Adizero Adios Pro 3 review.

Continuously striving to build the fastest shoe, adidas made a few changes to the Adizero Adios Pro 3. The biggest change was made to the carbon rods. As opposed to the separated carbon rods in the forefoot and heel plate of adidas Adizero Adios Pro 2, the ENERGYRODS 2.0 now consist of a more holistic system that extends through the length of the shoe. The result is a smoother transfer of energy throughout the gait cycle. They also decreased the heel-to-toe drop and added more cushion in the forefoot for better transitions.

A slightly wider base provides stability as you fly around corners. Adidas added some cutouts to the midfoot to decrease the weight of the shoe based on extensive testing done in their labs. This testing also resulted in a new outsole design using a single layer of high-quality Continental rubber on the heel and midfoot of the shoe with a where runners land and push off for extra traction and support.

The adidas Ultraboost Light gives you epic energy for all of your runs.

A rehaul of the legendary BOOST material was so major that adidas renamed the Ultraboost 23 to the Ultraboost Light. The midsole features 30% lighter BOOST material that gives you plenty of energy return to keep your legs feeling fresh through every stride. Hundreds of small BOOST capsules work together to give you cushion and energy, which lets you run farther and longer.

The Continental™ Rubber outsole provides durable grip and traction for the road in wet and dry conditions. One runner even ran in a snowstorm and was impressed with the grip on wet, icy pavement in our adidas Ultraboost Light review. This is combined with the Linear Energy Push geometry to give you snappy toe-offs and propel you forward throughout your run.

The upper uses Primeknit+ FORGED technology that is made in part with recycled materials to provide a cushioned, sock-like fit that won’t slip during your run and looks stylish enough to wear afterward. Plus, it accommodates a variety of foot shapes, while the split heel counter keeps your foot locked down.

Get the energy, comfort and style you crave in a running shoe with the adidas Ultraboost Light.

Whether you are training for the Boston Marathon or just looking for one of the best lightweight running shoes, the adidas Adizero Boston 11 brings race-day quality to everyday training.

The adidas Adizero Boston 11 combines the ultralight Lightstrike Pro midsole material with the durable Lightstrike EVA foam to give you a responsive, lively and cushioned experience underfoot. The combination works whether you are doing your weekend long run or super quick speedwork. Built on top of a Continental rubber outsole, the Boston 11 provides both durability and traction so you can race around corners with ease.

This shoe is tuned for speed with adidas ENERGYRODS; these plastic rods built into the midsole give you a propulsive feeling and limit energy loss. It allows the shoe to feel flexible, yet has support in key areas to keep you running strong all workout long. Plus, the slight rocker shape will roll throughout your run.

The upper has been redesigned to make the shoe lighter and fit better than before—adidas changed the overlaps and used a new thinner and more breathable upper material to give you a speedier fit and feel. Designers added a heel tab to make the shoe easier to put on and take off. Now the upper is made with at least 50% recycled content, so you can feel good about wearing it.

The adidas Adizero Boston 11 will give you a light and fast feeling every time you lace them up.

The adidas Adistar is made for the long, slow run.

  • Category: Neutral Cushioned � Intended for runners who have a higher, more stable arch that does not pronate excessively(roll inwards) or may even supinate(roll outwards). Neutral Cushioned shoes offer very little or no structure or pronation support and are generally more flexible than stability shoes. Runners who require a neutral shoe tend to notice more excessive wear on the lateral(outside) side of the soles of their running shoes. Neutral shoes can vary from lightweight and minimal cushioning to maximum levels of cushioning depending on the needs and preferences of the runner. Runners with high/stable arches tend to notice pain on the outside(lateral side) of their shins and knees and may also battle plantar fasciitis if not wearing a neutral cushioned shoe.

  • Extremely thin tongue construction: Allows for ideal fit, while reducing friction on the foot

  • Lightstrike midsole: Provides lightweight responsive cushioning

Underfoot, Vibram® Megagrip with Traction Lug gives you dependable grip when trails get wet, loose or sloppy.   • Outsole: Vibram® Megagrip with Traction Lug provides durable grip and stability across wet, loose and technical terrain. An integrated toe bumper adds protection, while Altra’s GaiterTrap™ makes it easy to attach a compatible gaiter to help keep trail debris out.

product.description:
A firmer compression-molded foam midsole and aggressive rocker shape deliver an energetic rolling sensation that makes the Altra Experience Flow an exciting neutral trainer for daily runs and workouts.

In our Altra Experience Flow review, our testers praised the unexpected liveliness of the firm, yet lightweight cushioning. “Running in the Experience Flow is a lot of fun,” says Tony. “The shoes feel very light on my feet and the foam has a very responsive feel–more than I was expecting, being that it’s on the firmer side. When I wore these for the first time, I was happy the entire run.”

The Experience Flow bridges the gap to zero-drop with a low, 4 mm offset and effortless ride. Read more about what our run testers thought in our full Altra Experience Flow review.

Details:

  • Upper: The Experience Flow features a Standard FootShape™ Fit, which falls in the middle of Altra’s three different options. “Great wiggle room in the toe box and a glove-like fit in the midfoot,” says Travis in our Altra Experience Flow review.
  • Midsole: With a 4 mm drop, the Flow’s lightweight compression molded midsole gives you a responsive feel in combination with a rocker shape to gently roll you forward into your next stride.

product.kitContent:
Accordion1What’s New The biggest change made to the Experience Flow is the name. Formerly known as the AltraFWD Experience, the Flow features the same stack height and heel-to-toe drop, and uses the same compression-molded EVA midsole foam. When it comes to what to use this neutral daily trainer for, our run testers found it to be a fun ride for a variety of their workouts.

In our review, Travis said, “The Experience Flow felt comfortable for the slower paces while being light and responsive enough for the faster miles.”

For those looking to ease into Altra's foot-shaped geometry, the Experience Flow makes an excellent entry point without going full zero-drop. Runners with wide feet, or those who just appreciate some extra wiggle room, will also love the fit of the Experience Flow.

It was my knight in shining armor, my Prince Charming, my…okay, you get the idea,” Brandon says. “But seriously, the rocker shape makes this shoe so much fun to run in.”00

The Altra Lone Peak 9's zero-drop offset and responsive EGO™ foam midsole deliver the perfect balance of cushioning and ground connection to help you tackle the trails with confidence. Altra's Original FootShape™ Fit allows for natural toe splay, while the sticky MaxTrac™ outsole provides unbeatable grip across any terrain.

In our Altra Lone Peak 9 review, wear-tester Mandy said, "Both the updated midsole material as well as the updated grip on the outsole really gave me a sense of security and confidence as I was trail running."

  • Midsole: A zero-drop midsole and Altra's updated EGO™ foam is the perfect amount of cushioning to protect your feet on long runs while still giving you plenty of ground feel for a fun and responsive ride on the trail.
  • Outsole: An updated MaxTrac™ outsole with a multi-directional 4.5 mm lug pattern gives you grippy traction in wet or dry conditions so you can run confidently over technical terrain.

product.description:
Find your rhythm in the Altra Experience Flow 2.

Lace-up this lightweight daily trainer to enhance those moments when everything just clicks and the miles seem to float by. The Experience Flow 2 builds on what runners loved about the original with thoughtful updates that enhance both comfort and performance. So whether you're logging your daily miles or picking up the pace for a workout, the Experience Flow 2 delivers a smooth, natural ride that helps you enjoy every step of your run.

Details:

  • Upper: The new breathable sandwich-mesh upper keeps your feet cool and comfortable, while the gusseted tongue ensures a secure midfoot fit. Altra’s Standard FootShape™ Fit features a roomy toe box that lets your toes spread naturally—because running feels better when your feet can move the way they were designed to.
  • Midsole: The upgraded EGO P35 foam makes this version feel lighter, more responsive and more cushioned than ever before. Combined with a subtle 4 mm drop and gentle rocker shape, you'll experience that perfect rolling sensation that helps you find your flow state with every stride.
  • Outsole: Strategic rubber placement provides reliable traction where you need it most, while keeping the overall weight down.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe Experience Flow 2 features Altra’s new EGO P35 foam that delivers a softer yet more responsive ride without adding weight—in fact, it's about a quarter ounce lighter than the previous version. The heel counter has been updated and the upper redesigned for better breathability, while the lace length has been adjusted based on runner feedback.Who It's Best ForThis shoe is perfect for runners who want a versatile daily trainer that feels light and nimble. If you enjoy a natural running experience with room for your toes to spread, but still want enough cushioning for longer distances, the Experience Flow 2 hits that sweet spot. It's great for runners new to Altra who want to try the brand's FootShape design with a familiar 4 mm drop.Why You'll Love ItYou'll love how the Experience Flow 2 seems to disappear on your foot with the perfect blend of comfort and responsiveness helps you find your rhythm whether you're running easy or picking up the pace. And once you experience the freedom of a roomy toe box, you might wonder how you ever ran in anything else.00
product.productIntroText: The Experience Flow 2 brings Altra's foot-shaped fit and natural feel to a cushioned, easygoing daily trainer.

product.description:
Hit the trails with confidence in the Altra Experience Wild 2.

This trail-ready shoe is the perfect blend of lightweight performance and trail-ready toughness that'll help you embrace every moment on the path less traveled. Whether you're tackling your first trail race or logging some peaceful weekend miles away from the crowds, the Experience Wild 2 provides the grip and protection you need without weighing you down.

Details:

  • Upper: The updated breathable upper with Altra's Standard FootShape fit keeps your feet comfortable even on those longer trail days, while the increased TPU overlays provide extra protection from rocks and roots. Altra added an integrated D-ring for gaiters and an extra lacing eyelet so you can dial in your perfect fit.
  • Midsole: The lightweight compression-molded midsole strikes that sweet spot between cushioning and ground feel, helping you connect with the trail while still protecting your feet. The subtle 4 mm drop and rocker shape work together to help you maintain your natural stride over varied terrain.
  • Outsole: The trusted MaxTrac outsole delivers reliable grip across wet rocks, loose dirt and everything in between. It's designed to give you confidence on technical descents and provide traction when you're pushing the pace on rolling singletrack.

product.description:
Experience the freedom of natural movement with the Altra Paradigm 8.

Built on the revolutionary idea that your feet know how to run, the Paradigm 8 combines Altra's signature zero-drop platform with subtle support that works with your body, not against it. Whether you're discovering zero-drop for the first time or you're a longtime Altra fan, the Paradigm 8 lets your toes spread naturally while giving you the confidence to explore what feels right for your stride.

In our Altra Paradigm 8 review, run tester Max said “I’d recommend the Altra Paradigm 8 shoe to runners seeking subtle support for easy runs, long runs and recovery runs — especially for those who enjoy a zero-drop platform."

Details:

  • Upper: Redesigned engineered mesh improves breathability and comfort while maintaining the secure midfoot lockdown that keeps you confident through every mile. Altra’s Standard FootShape™ Fit gives your toes room to spread and stabilize naturally without feeling loose or sloppy.
  • Midsole: Updated EGO™ MAX foam delivers a softer, more cushioned ride that still feels connected to the ground. The zero-drop platform keeps your heel and forefoot at the same height, encouraging your natural running form to shine through.
  • Outsole: GuideRail™ technology provides subtle medial support exactly where you need it, creating durability for runners who put extra pressure on the inside of their feet while maintaining the freedom that makes Altra special.

product.description:
Hit the trails with confidence in the Altra Timp 6.

When you've got sticky grip and durable protection underfoot, no terrain feels off-limits. The redesigned Vibram Megagrip outsole delivers traction on any surface—wet or dry—while the soft rolled mesh upper (made with 85% recycled materials) combines comfort with the durability you need for long days exploring. With Altra EGO MAX foam adding light, luxurious cushioning and a little bounce, the Timp 6 gives you everything you need to unlock the fun of new terrain.

This lightweight trail shoe makes exploring off-road easy with new Altra EGO P35 midsole foam that keeps things light and efficient. Whether you're new to trail running and discovering what's out there, or you're building on experience and want something that moves naturally, the Experience Wild 3 brings together MaxTrac grip and rocker shape geometry for an effortless stride on varied terrain.

  • Midsole: Altra EGO P35 foam delivers that light, efficient ride that helps you cover ground without feeling weighed down. The rocker shape geometry works with the 4 mm drop to create smooth transitions that make navigating roots, rocks and technical sections feel more natural.
  • Outsole: MaxTrac rubber provides the grippy traction you need to move confidently on different trail surfaces. Whether you're climbing, descending or traversing, this outsole gives you the connection to the ground that helps you trust your footing.
