product.description:
Altra calls the Torin their "unicorn" shoe — and after you run in the Torin 9, you'll understand why.

A zero-drop platform, a generously roomy toebox and the perfect amount of cushioning all come together in a way that makes the Torin 9 truly unique. New P35X™ dual-density midsole foam delivers a smooth, balanced ride with real protection underfoot, while a brand-new Vibram® outsole built specifically for pavement adds dependable grip whether you're heading out for an easy jog or a longer training run.

Details:

  • Upper: A refined upper with an updated ankle and heel construction feels softer and more secure than previous versions. Altra's Standard FootShape™ fit — the middle option between the roomier Original and narrower Slim — gives your toes room to spread naturally, working in tandem with the zero-drop platform to promote balance and a more natural stride.
  • Midsole: P35X™ dual-density foam delivers a firm-yet-responsive ride while the zero-drop platformencourages a natural foot strike and that classic grounded Altra feel.
  • Outsole: A new Vibram® rubber outsole specifically engineered for road and concrete surfaces delivers reliable grip and durable traction — a meaningful upgrade for runners who log serious daily mileage on pavement.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe Torin 9 is nearly half an ounce lighter with all-new P35X™ foam for a smoother, more responsive feel. A 2 mm reduction in stack height makes it more nimble, while an updated upper and new Vibram® outsole add polish without losing the classic Torin personality.Who It's Best ForRunners who want a natural, connected-to-the-ground ride with enough cushioning to feel protected on daily miles.Why You'll Love ItA ride that keeps you in tune with your own stride. The Torin 9 gives you the confidence to run naturally, mile after mile, without ever feeling like you're fighting your shoes.​00
product.productIntroText: A zero-drop daily trainer with Altra's P35X™ dual-density foam, Vibram® outsole and FootShape™ fit built for runners who want a natural, connected-to-the-ground ride.
product.title: Men's | Altra Torin 9

product.description:
The Escalante has always been the choice for runners who want to feel the road without sacrificing comfort, and the Altra Escalante 5 makes that case more convincingly than ever.

A new versatile engineered knit upper brings added stretch to the fit, moving naturally with your foot through every phase of your stride, while a chenille lined tongue delivers a softness that's immediately noticeable the moment you slip the shoe on. The Altra EGO midsole keeps the ride responsive and grounded staying true to the zero-drop geometry Altra is built on.

Altra also revisited the collar design with this version, dialing in a fit around the heel and ankle that stays secure and distraction-free across long efforts. An updated outsole with additional rubber coverage rounds things out, giving the Escalante 5 more confident traction on a wider range of surfaces than its predecessor without adding bulk to the minimalist, low-profile platform runners come to this shoe for.

Details:

  • Upper: Versatile engineered knit with added stretch and chenille lined tongue for an ultra-soft feel; revised collar design for secure, continuous comfort
  • Midsole: Altra EGO foam delivering a responsive, grounded ride on a zero-drop platform
  • Outsole: Updated rubber coverage for improved traction across road and mixed surfaces
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe Escalante 5 refines the formula on three fronts. The engineered knit upper has been redesigned for more stretch and versatility, paired with a chenille lined tongue that's noticeably softer than previous versions. The collar has been reworked for a best-in-class fit that keeps the shoe locked in without creating pressure points. And the outsole now features additional rubber coverage, expanding traction capability beyond what earlier versions offered.Who It's Best ForRunners who prefer a low-stack, zero-drop ride and want a shoe that transitions easily from training runs to everyday wear. It's also a strong fit for those coming from minimalist backgrounds who want a little more underfoot without giving up ground feel.Why You'll Love ItThe Escalante 5 gives you a responsive, connected ride in a shoe that's comfortable enough to wear all day. It's the kind of shoe that makes you forget you're wearing one.00
product.productIntroText: Five versions in, Altra's sleekest road shoe is still finding ways to get better.
product.title: Men's | Altra Escalante 5

product.description:
Runners who loved the Paradigm but wanted something new to step into will feel right at home in the Altra Torin ST. Built on the same Altra EGO MAX midsole that delivers a responsive, energetic ride, the Torin ST adds GuideRail support to give you gentle guidance that works with your natural gait rather than forcing it into a fixed path. The result is a shoe that cushions without overwhelming, supports without controlling, and keeps the zero-drop geometry Altra runners count on for a natural, grounded feel.

The upper is where the Torin ST steps into its own. A lofted engineered mesh construction breathes well and wraps the foot in soft, comfortable coverage, while a molded foam tongue adds a layer of plushness that makes the shoe easy to wear mile after mile. A redesigned collar shape completes the package, delivering a secure lockdown around the heel and ankle so the shoe moves with you, not against you.

Details:

  • Upper: Lofted engineered mesh with molded foam tongue package and a redesigned collar for secure, distraction-free fit
  • Midsole: Altra EGO MAX foam with GuideRail support for responsive cushioning and gentle structural guidance
  • Outsole: Road-ready rubber compound with Altra's FootShape toe box geometry and zero-drop platform
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe Torin ST is a new addition to the Altra lineup, drawing on the heritage of the Paradigm. It brings the trusted EGO MAX and GuideRail pairing into a freshened-up package, with an elevated upper construction featuring lofted mesh, a molded foam tongue and a redesigned collar shape that improves overall fit security compared to its predecessor.Who It's Best ForRunners transitioning from the Paradigm or anyone seeking a zero-drop, medium-cushioned road shoe with built-in support. It's also a strong fit for walkers and runners who want supportive guidance without a high-stack, maximalist feel.Why You'll Love ItThe Torin ST gives you the support and cushioning you need to feel confident on the road without compromising the natural, grounded ride Altra is known for. It's the rare supportive shoe that actually feels like it belongs on your foot.00
product.productIntroText: Zero-drop cushioning with the support structure to match — the Torin ST fills a gap Altra fans have been waiting for.
product.title: Men's | Altra Torin ST

product.description:
The men's Motiv FLX is built for the miles that make up your everyday routine: run club, training runs, easy days and anything in between. It's built on the signature Altra Fit, so your toes have room to move and your midfoot stays locked in. Plus, a low 4 mm drop keeps your stride feeling natural, not forced.

Details:

  • Upper: The engineered knit upper flexes with your foot for a natural, adaptive fit, while suede microfiber overlays add structure. Reflective accents boost visibility for early morning or evening miles, rounding out an upper that balances performance with everyday style.
  • Midsole: At the heart of the Motiv FLX is the all-new SmoothStride™ midsole, an EVA foam tuned to deliver cushioning underfoot without sacrificing responsiveness. Paired with an elevated sock liner for a plush step-in feel, it's designed to keep you comfortable from your first step to your last mile.
  • Outsole: A rubber outsole provides reliable grip on the road while standing up to the wear and tear of regular training. It's built to support the mid-cushioned, lightweight feel of the shoe without adding unnecessary bulk.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe Motiv FLX gets a refresh with its all-new SmoothStride™ midsole and elevated sock liner for a cushioned, responsive ride. The stretch knit upper now features suede microfiber overlays and reflective details, adding a dose of style along with added flexibility. An updated rubber outsole keeps things grounded, built to hold up to the miles.Who It's Best ForThe Motiv FLX is a great fit for runners who split their time between structured training and casual miles. If you want one shoe that can flex between purposeful workouts and easy days without feeling like a compromise, this is it. Why You'll Love ItIt's the kind of shoe that disappears on your foot. Nothing to think about, nothing rubbing wrong, just mile after mile of feeling good. Step in and you'll notice the plush comfort right away, and a few miles in, you'll appreciate how it moves with you instead of against you. 00
product.productIntroText: A neutral road shoe that feels just as good on race prep workouts as it does on your laid-back recovery runs.

product.description:
Built for technical terrain, the men's Olympus 275 HiLo pairs fierce grip with plush, all-day cushioning so you can move confidently over rugged trails. It carries forward everything runners love about the Olympus 275 while stepping up traction and comfort where it matters most.

Details:

  • Upper: Like the beloved Olympus 275, this shoe features a MATRYX® one-piece woven upper built for durability and performance, complete with a sleeve to keep debris out. Altra's signature FootShape™ fit gives you their roomiest toe box yet, so your toes can move freely, with extra space through the midfoot.
  • Midsole: An updated Altra EGO™ MAX midsole foam is 15% lighter and 10% softer than the previous version, giving you a plush ride underfoot with every stride.
  • Outsole: A Vibram® Megagrip outsole with TractionLug™ delivers adaptive traction and stability on wet or dry ground. This high-performance stick rubber is engineered for unparalleled grip and rugged longevity.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe Olympus 275 HiLo debuts an updated Altra EGO™ MAX midsole foam that's 15% lighter and 10% softer than the previous version. It's the same trusted platform trail runners love, now refined for an even plusher ride.Who It's Best ForThis shoe is built for runners tackling technical, rugged trails where grip and stability matter most. If you want a shoe that can handle wet or dry terrain without compromising on cushioning or a natural foot position, the Olympus 275 HiLo is worth a look. Why You'll Love ItBetween the adaptive grip of the Vibram® Megagrip outsole and the soft, lightweight cushioning underfoot, this shoe makes technical terrain feel approachable. The roomy FootShape™ fit lets your foot move the way it wants to move, while the durable MATRYX® upper and sleeve keep debris out. It's a shoe that holds up to tough trails without asking you to sacrifice comfort. 00
product.productIntroText: A max cushioned trail shoe with zero drop for tackling technical terrain in total comfort.

product.description:
When the trail gets serious with roots, rocks, mud and steep descents, the Altra Olympus 7 keeps you protected without slowing you down.

New Altra EGO™ MAX foam is lighter and softer than before, give you a plush, protective ride that reduces impact on the feet and knees through the kind of sustained efforts where fatigue starts looking for every excuse to ease up. A zero-drop platform and Altra's Original FootShape™ fit keep your toes spread naturally and your foot aligned the way it was meant to be, giving you better balance and proprioception on roots, rocks, mud and technical descents where foot feel matters most. An updated collar construction feels great from the first step-in and stays comfortable through long efforts outdoors.

Details:

  • Upper: An updated collar construction gives you improved comfort from the moment you step in, working with Altra's Original FootShape™ toe box to keep your foot natural, comfortable and well-supported across long trail efforts and technical terrain.
  • Midsole: New Altra EGO™ MAX foam is lighter and softer than the previous version, delivering a plush, cushioned ride with genuine impact protection at a zero-drop, 33 mm stack height that keeps your heel and forefoot level for natural strides and stable footing on any terrain.
  • Outsole: Vibram® MegaGrip with TractionLug geometry delivers industry-leading traction with increased outsole coverage and improved durability, giving you confident grip on whatever the trail puts underfoot.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe Olympus 7 introduces a new Altra EGO MAX foam formulation that is lighter and softer than the previous version, delivering a more cushioned ride without adding weight. Vibram MegaGrip coverage has been expanded with updated TractionLug geometry for improved grip and outsole durability on technical terrain. The collar construction has also been redesigned for better step-in comfort and a more secure on-foot feel, refining the overall fit experience beyond what earlier versions offered.Who It's Best ForTrail runners and hikers taking on long, technical terrain who want max cushioning and serious traction in a zero-drop platform. It's also a strong fit for runners and walkers who need a protective, stable shoe for sustained efforts on roots, rocks and uneven ground.Why You'll Love ItThe Olympus 7 gives you the cushioning to go long and the grip to go anywhere the trail demands. It's the shoe that keeps your feet comfortable and your footing confident when the miles and the terrain are both working against you.00
product.productIntroText: A max-cushioned zero-drop trail shoe with new Altra EGO™ MAX foam, a Vibram® MegaGrip outsole and Altra's Original FootShape™ fit built for long-distance trail runners who want serious protection and traction on any terrain.
product.title: Men's | Altra Olympus 7

product.description:
Altra added a waterproof GORE-TEX upper to one of their top-selling road shoes, the Torin. It’s the classic Altra feel with a soft midsole, now designed to keep your feet dry on rainy days.

GORE-TEX Invisible Fit is a lightweight, waterproof upper backed by the GORE-TEX GUARANTEED TO KEEP YOU DRY™ promise. With a heel collar that molds to your foot, zero drop and plenty of room to help your toes move more freely with a secure midfoot, you’ve got the uncommon comfort you need to slay those road miles. Underfoot, you’ve got a redesigned midsole foam that’s lightweight, plush, and ready to perform. Stay dry. Stay comfortable. Stay Out There™!

product.description:
Rain in the forecast doesn’t have to change your plans in the Altra Lone Peak 9 GTX. A waterproof GORE-TEX Invisible Fit upper keeps water out without weighing your feet down, so puddles and creek crossings become part of the fun instead of a reason to turn back.

Underfoot, the Altra EGO™ midsole has a cushioned, responsive connection to the trail. MaxTrac™ traction bites into loose gravel and slick rock, and a shortened toe cap keeps toes protected without stiffening your stride.

Altra's signature FootShape™ fit tops it off with the brand's roomiest toe box, giving your toes the space to move naturally instead of feeling cramped. The result is a shoe built for long days on rough ground, one that's also earned the APMA Seal of Acceptance for supporting good foot health.

Details:

  • Upper: GORE-TEX Invisible Fit does more than keep water out. It’s tested to stand up to wind while remaining breathable as conditions shift, giving you dependable protection beyond the occasional downpour. Altra’s GaiterTrap™ hook-and-loop tab also makes it easy to attach a gaiter without straps or bungees, helping to keep dirt and pebbles out of your shoes.
  • Midsole: Altra EGO™ foam feels light underfoot while still absorbing the repeated impact of a full day on the trail. The cushioning maintains its comfortable, responsive feel over long distances rather than fading as the miles add up.
  • Outsole: MaxTrac™ rubber delivers lasting grip across mixed terrain, from packed dirt to wet rock. Between the outsole and midsole, a firm yet flexible StoneGuard™ layer shields your foot from sharp rocks and roots without taking away your connection to the ground.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe Lone Peak 9 GTX steps up its weather game with a new GORE-TEX Invisible Fit upper, built for lightweight, waterproof protection wrapped in soft rolled mesh for comfort. A shorter toe cap replaces the previous design, giving toes more room to flex and move with every stride.Who It's Best ForHikers and trail runners who won't let a wet forecast keep them off the trail, especially those tackling mixed or rocky terrain who want a roomier, more natural fit.Why You'll Love ItWet weather stops being a dealbreaker once you're in the Lone Peak 9 GTX. Dry feet, solid traction and a cushioned ride make it easy to focus on the trail instead of the conditions. Add in protection from rocks and debris, plus a fit backed by the APMA Seal of Acceptance, and you get a shoe built to keep up no matter what the trail throws at it.00
product.productIntroText: The Altra Lone Peak 9 GTX is a waterproof trail running shoe built with a GORE-TEX Invisible Fit upper to keep your feet dry through wet, unpredictable conditions.
product.title: Men's | Altra Lone Peak 9 GTX

Dial the perfect fit and adjust it as much as you need to throughout your run with the BOA® PerformFit™ Wrap Configuration system. A Vibram® Megagrip outsole delivers the grip while a cushioned midsole is designed for a little extra bounce and a plush feel. With zero drop and a roomy toe box, you get plenty of room to help your toes move more freely, with a secure midfoot, so you can make dust clouds. Jump rocks. Run forever.

product.description:
Hike in any weather with the Altra Olympus 2 Mid GTX.

The Altra Olympus 2 Mid GTX has a GORE-TEX upper that is waterproof, windproof and durable to keep your feet dry, no matter the weather. A mid-height collar gives your ankles extra support and comfort, so you can stay on the trails longer.

Altra’s premium EGO™ MAX midsole foam gives you light and luxurious performance with a little extra bounce and durability.

The Olympus is built with Altra’s Original FootShape™ Fit, which is the most voluminous of Altra’s shoes. It also has their signature wide toe box so your toes can splay naturally. Like all Altra shoes, the Olympus has a Balanced Cushioned™ platform that positions your heel and forefoot at equal distances from the ground (or zero heel-to-toe drop), which encourages better alignment and form.

The Altra Olympus Mid GTX 2 will have you hiking in comfort all day long.

product.description:
Fit Tip: Altra recommends sizing up by ½ size for more volume, or if you are in between sizes.

Conquer the trails with confidence in the Altra Timp 5.

This trail shoe gives you everything you need to successfully run and hike in the great outdoors. Comfortable and cushioned enough to spend hours (or days) on your feet, it also offers incredible grip for technical terrain. We tested it on snowy roads and technical mountain trails and had nothing but praise for the traction of this shoe in our Altra Timp 5 review. The Altra Provision 6 will give you support when you need it for a lightweight, cushioned ride.

Altra took its lightweight stability shoe and made it more cushioned, durable and bouncier than the previous version. They added their EGO midsole to this model of the Provision, which makes it lighter, too. The EGO cushioning is soft but allows for an explosive push-off.

The Altra Provision 6 has a GuideRail™ design that gives you medial support when you need it, making this a great stability shoe for runners who overpronate. Designers updated the InnovArch™, which puts a webbing underfoot and provides additional arch support to give your foot better placement.

They changed the InnerFlex™ grid-like grooves in the midsole to increase flexibility and allow your foot to move more naturally. From trails to towns, cities to summits, the women's Altra Lone Peak 6 gives you a versatile, wide-fitting trail shoe perfect for trail runs, hikes and outdoor adventures.

Don’t limit yourself to the road or trails—choose both in the Altra Outroad.

The Altra Outroad is the perfect hybrid road-to-trail shoe. Based off of the Altra Rivera, this shoe has the same Altra EGO™ midsole for a responsive, yet cushioned ride and is built on Altra’s slim fit last, which fits narrower than other Altra shoes yet still has the rounded FootShaped ™ toe box.

product.description:
Go for an adventure in any weather in the plush Altra Olympus 5 Low GTX.

Altra’s premium EGO™ MAX midsole foam gives you light and luxurious performance with a little extra bounce and durability.

The Olympus is built with Altra’s Original FootShape™ Fit, which is the most voluminous of Altra’s shoes. It also has their signature wide toe box so your toes can splay naturally. Like all Altra shoes, the Olympus has a Balanced Cushioned™ platform that positions your heel and forefoot at equal distances from the ground (also called a 0 mm heel-to-toe drop), which encourages better alignment and form.

Altra redesigned the outsole to make it even easier to run on uneven ground. The Olympus 5 has the grip and traction to take on any terrain thanks to its Vibram® Megagrip™, which is a durable and sticky high-performance rubber that works great on both wet and dry surfaces.

A GORE-TEX® upper will keep your feet dry as you hike through puddles or rainstorms, and Altra refined the sidewalls to increase stability while you are on uncertain footing. The premium collar has been redesigned for added comfort and keeps your heel secure.

Go ahead and splash in the puddle and hike in the rain with the Altra Olympus 5 Low GTX.

Delivering the signature Altra fit with a sleeker look, the women's Altra Rivera is an easy-riding everyday trainer that fits your style.

A proven EGO midsole powers the Rivera. Altra’s EGO foam composition gives you soft landings on pavement, but it provides an energizing response for a lively ride.

Like all Altra running shoes, designers built the Rivera on top of Altra’s zero-drop Balanced Cushioning platform. The drop measures the difference in height between the heel and forefoot; the Rivera is the same height from heel to toe, which puts you in a more natural stance.

The new women's Altra Rivera maintains the fit and feel you expect with a sleek new look and snugger fit than other models in the lineup.

Reach for the Altra Paradigm 6 when you are looking for a plush and supportive experience out on the road or during long days on your feet.

Finally, the women’s version features Altra’s Fit4Her technology. Altra uses a separate last for their women’s shoes that take into account the differences in women’s feet which can include longer arches and narrower heels.

The Altra Timp 4 is a tough trail shoe ready to take on any adventure.

Get ready to run in the Altra Escalante 3.

The much anticipated update to this lightweight running shoe, the Altra Escalante 3 delivers with a bouncy, fun ride. The Escalante 3 has an Altra EGO™ midsole for a responsive, yet soft run. It sports Altra’s signature Balanced Cushioning where the stack height of the forefoot and heel are the same—also called zero-drop—for a smooth, natural running stride.

Altra redefined the shape of the shoe a bit, widening it in the midfoot to make it feel a bit more stable. This increases the versatility of the shoe and allows it to be used for running and the occasional gym workout. The Escalante 3 is built on Altra’s original last with its signature FootShaped toe box, making it the widest and most roomy Altra option.

The sock-like upper of the Escalante 3 conforms to your foot, giving you a ton of comfort and breathability. Altra tweaked this upper to provide the best fit possible, giving it a more padded tongue, adding the extra eyelet for heel-lock lacing technique and making it more secure in the midfoot.

The outsole has a bit more rubber on the bottom to increase the durability and make it work in the gym, too. The Altra Escalante 3 provides a smooth, bouncy ride for those long runs, but is lightweight enough to pick up the pace for your tempo runs and speedwork.

Go for an all-day adventure in the plush Altra Olympus 5.

Altra’s Compression Molded EVA midsole foam gives you light and luxurious performance with a little extra bounce and durability.

The Olympus is built with Altra’s Original FootShape™ Fit, which is the most voluminous of Altra’s shoes. It also has their signature wide toe box so your toes can splay naturally. Like all Altra shoes, the Olympus has a Balanced Cushioned™ platform that positions your heel and forefoot at equal distances from the ground (or zero heel-to-toe drop), which encourages better alignment and form.

Altra redesigned the outsole to make it even easier to run on uneven terrain. The Olympus 5 has the grip and traction to take on any terrain thanks to its Vibram® Megagrip™, which is a durable and sticky high-performance rubber that works great on both wet and dry surfaces.

A breathable engineered mesh upper is comfortable to wear all day long and Altra refined the sidewalls to increase stability while you are on uneven terrain. The premium collar has been redesigned for added comfort and keeps your heel locked in and secure.

Whether you are hiking or running an ultra-marathon, do it in comfort with the Altra Olympus 5.

product.description:
Run anywhere in the Altra Outroad 2.

This road-to-trail shoe has the versatility to go wherever you want. The MaxTrac™ outsole gives you the perfect combination of grip, traction and durability that makes it perfect for running in the snow, hiking on muddy springtime trails or speeding down slick roads after a summer rainstorm. It’s also more flexible than your typical trail running shoe to give you more agility on the roads.

The Outroad 2 has Altra’s EGO™ midsole foam for a soft and bouncy ride on any terrain. Plus, its zero heel-to-toe drop, or balanced cushioning, means that the same amount of cushioning is in the heel and forefoot to give you a natural running feeling on both roads and trails. One runner stated "“The Outroad 2 demonstrates a balance between plush and bouncy while still offering protection from the ground. I have plenty of traction on the trail, while also feeling comfortable running on roads, which is a tricky balance to achieve," in our Altra Outroad 2 review.

The re-engineered upper provides greater durability and protection, while a slim midfoot fit hugs your foot for a great lockdown. Altra’s signature wide forefoot lets your toes splay to give you better balance on uneven ground.

Run wherever the wind takes you—the Altra Outroad 2 gives you the familiar step-in feel of a road shoe with the confidence and durability of a trail shoe.

product.description:
Hike in any weather with the Altra Olympus 5 Mid GTX.

The Altra Olympus 5 Mid GTX has a GORE-TEX upper that is waterproof, windproof and durable to keep your feet dry, no matter the weather. A mid-height collar gives your ankles extra support and comfort, so you can stay on the trails longer.

Altra’s premium EGO™ MAX midsole foam gives you light and luxurious performance with a little extra bounce and durability.

The Olympus is built with Altra’s Original FootShape™ Fit, which is the most voluminous of Altra’s shoes. It also has their signature wide toe box so your toes can splay naturally. Like all Altra shoes, the Olympus has a Balanced Cushioned™ platform that positions your heel and forefoot at equal distances from the ground (or zero heel-to-toe drop), which encourages better alignment and form.

Altra redesigned the outsole to make it even easier to run on uneven terrain. The Olympus 5 Mid GTX has the grip and traction to take on anything thanks to Vibram® Megagrip™, which is a durable and sticky high-performance rubber that works great on both wet and dry surfaces.

The Altra Olympus 5 Mid GTX will have you hiking in comfort all day long.

product.description:
Race through the wilderness in the Altra Mont Blanc BOA®.

Altra took its trail racing shoe, the Mont Blanc, and added a BOA® fit system to give it a precise, micro-adjustable fit. This shoe is made to sustain speed over ultra marathons. The EGO™ MAX midsole foam is plush, light and flexible to give you soft cushioning mile after mile. Altra’s Balanced Cushioning™places the same amount of cushioning in the forefoot and heel (or zero heel-to-toe drop) to promote a natural footstrike.

Inspired by the highest mountain in the Alps, the outsole features Vibram® LiteBase which includes micro and macro lugs for traction on any terrain without adding extra weight. While this shoe is built for racing 100-mile races, it feels just as comfortable going for a quick run on a weeknight.

The ultra-lightweight and hyper-breathable upper is designed with protection and material strategically placed only where you need it. The Mont Blanc has Altra’s signature FootShaped™ toe box that allows your toes to relax and splay naturally for miles on uneven ground.

This is the first ever Altra shoe that features the BOA® fit system for an improved fit. The BOA®fit system allows you to secure your shoes by tightening and loosening the two dials, which provides for better agility and more speed. This fit system also locks in the heel and stabilizes the midsole; it is designed to reduce landing impact through technical terrain, steep descents and hard-packed trails.

Go farther and faster with the Altra Mont Blanc.

product.description:
Chase your new personal record in the Altra Vanish Carbon.

The carbon plate in the Vanish gives your foot the propulsion it needs to reach maximum speed so you can run faster than ever before. It’s shaped with a three-prong fork to let your feet to splay naturally and improves flexibility in the forefoot without sacrificing the pop that a carbon plate adds to your stride.

The EGO PRO midsole material is Altra’s lightest and most responsive foam. This makes the shoe soft and cushioned, while still giving you an amazing energy return that powers you to the finish line faster. The Vanish Carbon also has an active stance rocker that rolls you through your stride quicker.

This shoe stays true to Altra’s signature features and philosophy. It has balance cushioning with a zero heel-to-toe drop that allows for optimal alignment, cultivates better form and encourages a low-impact landing. To give your big toe the ability to remain in a straight position for maximum power and stability, a FootShaped™ toe box accentuates the natural shape of your foot and lets your toes splay.

The upper consists of a highly breathable, lightweight engineered mesh. So you’re ready for race day, it still has Altra’s wide toe box, but fits a bit slimmer for a locked-in feel throughout the midfoot compared to other Altras.

The Altra Vanish Carbon will have you speeding by your competition.

Get ready to run in the Altra Escalante 3.

The much anticipated update to this lightweight running shoe, the Altra Escalante 3 delivers with a bouncy, fun ride. The Escalante 3 has an Altra EGO™ midsole for a responsive, yet soft run. It sports Altra’s signature Balanced Cushioning where the stack height of the forefoot and heel are the same—also called zero-drop—for a smooth, natural running stride.

Altra redefined the shape of the shoe a bit, widening it in the midfoot to make it feel a bit more stable. This increases the versatility of the shoe and allows it to be used for running and the occasional gym workout. The Escalante 3 is built on Altra’s original last with its signature FootShaped toe box, making it the widest and most roomy Altra option.

The sock-like upper of the Escalante 3 conforms to your foot, giving you a ton of comfort and breathability. Altra tweaked this upper to provide the best fit possible, giving it a more padded tongue, adding the extra eyelet for heel-lock lacing technique and making it more secure in the midfoot.

The outsole has a bit more rubber on the bottom to increase the durability and make it work in the gym, too. The Altra Escalante 3 provides a smooth, bouncy ride for those long runs, but is lightweight enough to pick up the pace for your tempo runs and speedwork.

Soft and supple, the Altra Via Olympus 2 will keep you comfortable whether you are running, walking or standing on your feet all day.

product.description:
Get the perfect balance of cushion and support to reach your running goals with the Altra Provision 7.

The Altra EGO™ midsole offers cushion and bounce every step of the way. It contains Altra’s InnerFlex™ midsole grooves, which are designed to promote flexibility and movement. The Provision 7 also has Altra’s standard fit—the roomy FootShape toe box that allows your toes to splay naturally. Altra also used its Balanced Cushioning that has the same amount of cushioning in the forefoot and heel to run more naturally, and gender-specific tweaks to address the biological differences in men’s and women’s feet.

Feel supported and stable as you run, the Provision 7 has Altra’s GuideRail™ technology that provides medial and lateral support, but it is only there when you need it. This is perfect for people who have flexible ankles or overpronate and want a little extra stability.

An updated molded heel collar will keep your heels locked in, while the engineered vamp mesh is breathable and provides a great fit. Plus, the FootPod™ outsole technology is durable and encourages natural movement underfoot.

Whether you are new to running or run everyday, the Altra Provision 7 will give you a spring and support in every step.

product.description:
The legendary Altra Lone Peak 7 continues its tradition of trail prowess to make it one of the best running shoes on the market.

Altra updated the MaxTrac™ outsole compound to make it more durable and perform better in wet conditions. The multi-directional 5 mm lug pattern is ideal for running on smooth or technical terrain.

To give you confidence running on uneven ground, the Lone Peak 7 features a secure heel cup and Altra’s signature FootShaped™ toe box, which is wider to allow your toes to react and splay for a more stable ride.

The Altra EGO™ midsole provides a soft and springy underfoot feel, while the StoneGuard™ protects feet from rocks and sticks, while still being flexible enough for you to run.

Like all Altra shoes, the Lone Peak 7 has the same amount of cushion in the forefoot and heel, or zero heel-to-toe drop, to allow you to run as naturally as possible on the trails.

Altra streamlined the construction of the mesh upper and evolved the design, making it look and feel lighter. The Lone Peak 7 has Altra’s original FootShape™ fit, which is the most voluminous fit Altra makes, perfect for those with a higher volume foot. Plus, it comes in wide for those who need some extra room.

Whether you are just beginning to trail run or preparing for an ultramarathon, the Altra Lone Peak 7 is one of the best trail running shoes out there.

Trail

Trail Running, Hiking

0Accordion1What’s New

Fans of the Lone Peak can rest assured that the Lone Peak 7 will feel similar to past models with just a few upgrades. The first is the new MaxTrac outsole compound that is made to be more durable and perform better in wet conditions. There are also extra lugs on the lateral heel and medial toe for better grip during landings and toe-offs. Designers then added a heel cup for a bit more stability when running trails.

Altra updated the upper of the Lone Peak 7 as well. Designers removed the drainage holes over the toe and replaced most of the stitching with overlays to give it a more streamlined look and feel. They also changed the lacing pattern, which removed the extra holes in the midfoot and allows you to attach a gaiter to the lace itself and the GaiterTrap on the heel. There is also padding over the first lace pattern on the tongue for extra protection.

Who It’s Best ForThe Altra Lone Peak 7 is great for any trail runner or hiker. It is comfortable enough for beginners but can handle hundreds of miles on the trails for those ultramarathoners. It is great for people who like some room in the toe box for their feet to wiggle.Why You’ll Love ItYou will love the roomy toe box, cushioned ride and amazing grip of the Altra Lone Peak 7. 00

The Altra Lone Peak Hiker 2 is ready for rugged adventures.

The Lone Peak Hiker 2 has everything you need to get out there and explore the trails. Lightweight, comfortable and stylish, it provides ankle support, steady traction and room for your toes to wiggle.

This hiking shoe has all of the characteristics that Altra is known for—it has the same amount of cushioning in the heel and forefoot (otherwise known as zero-drop or Balanced Cushioning), and a FootShaped™ toe box that gives your toes room to splay.

Altra’s EGO™ midsole provides for a responsive, yet soft ride, while the DuraTread™ outsole provides traction on dry dirt and rocky terrain.

Go out and experience nature with the Altra Lone Peak Hiker 2.

product.description:
Hit the trails in the rain, mud and snow in the Altra Lone Peak ALL-WTHR Mid 2.

With a water-resistant bootie construction and TPU kickplate, your feet will stay dry and comfortable in any weather. The Lone Peak ALL-WTHR Mid 2 has Altra’s original FootShape™ fit, which is the most voluminous fit Altra makes, perfect for those with a higher volume foot.

Altra updated the MaxTrac™ outsole compound to make it more durable and perform better in wet conditions. The multi-directional 5 mm lug pattern is ideal for running on well-groomed trails and technical terrain.

To give you confidence hiking on uneven ground, the Lone Peak ALL-WTHR Mid 2 comes up above the ankles to give you more support, and it has Altra’s signature FootShaped™ toe box, which is wider to allow your toes to react and splay for a more stable ride.

The Altra EGO™ midsole provides a soft and springy underfoot feel, while the StoneGuard™ protects your feet from rocks and sticks, while still being flexible enough to feel the ground.

Like all Altra shoes, the Lone Peak ALL-WTHR Mid 2 has the same amount of cushion in the forefoot and heel, or zero heel-to-toe drop, to allow you to run as naturally as possible on the trails.

The Altra Lone Peak ALL-WTHR Mid 2 lets you go on adventures in any weather, whether it is your neighborhood trail or days out on technical terrain.

From up-tempo runs to putting in long miles, the sleek Altra Rivera 3 can handle it all.

Altra used their bouncy and responsive Altra EGO™ midsole and increased the stack height of the shoe by adding more cushioning to keep you comfortable during your run. They also retooled the Innerflex grooves to give you smoother transitions from heel to toe.

The Rivera 3 has all of Altra’s signature characteristics—there is a wider toe box to let your toes splay and a zero heel-to-toe drop to promote natural, balanced running. The Rivera 3 uses Altra’s slim FootShape™ Fit that gives it a sleeker appearance and tighter fit than other Altra shoes.

Designers updated the molded heel collar to better hold your Achilles and provide a better lockdown and fit, while the stretchy upper is breathable and comfortable.

Get your daily mileage in with the Altra Rivera 3.

product.description:
Fast trail runs are coming your way with the lightweight Altra Superior 6.

Feel connected to the ground in this low-profile trail running shoe. The compression-molded EVA foam will keep you nimble and quick as you navigate off-road. The improved MaxTrac™ outsole gives you the perfect combination of grip, traction and durability to summit mountains and barrel downhill.

To give you a better experience on the trails, Altra re-engineered the upper with ripstop and vamp mesh materials that help reduce the weight and improve the shoe’s breathability. Plus, the burrito-style tongue wraps around your foot to keep trail debris out and provide a lockdown fit.

The Superior 6 features all of Altra’s signature characteristics. There is the same amount of foam in the heel and forefoot for balanced cushioning or a zero heel-to-toe drop. The toe box is also wider than standard shoes to give your toes room to splay for more comfort and better balance.

The Altra Superior 6 is lightweight and agile whether you are toeing the start line of a trail race or going for a walk in the woods with your dog.

product.description:
Be ready for every run with the men's Altra Torin 7.

Every step will be plush and comfortable thanks to Altra’s EGO™ MAX midsole. Designers added 2 mm more of this soft and bouncy cushioning to provide even more enjoyment underfoot. Fleet Feet runners loved the new cushioning, with one commenting in our Altra Torin 7 review "it’s soft and flexible with enough responsiveness to keep my feet engaged throughout the run. Flexible is a key word here because having shoes that move with me as I run makes a huge difference!"

One of the best neutral running shoes, the Torin 7 gives a smooth and reliable ride for runners and walkers of all abilities. It has Altra’s signature balanced cushioning or zero heel-to-toe drop, which means that there’s the same amount of cushion in the heel and forefoot for a more natural ride.

The new engineered mesh upper gives you comfort and breathability with an evolved molded heel collar for a locked-in fit. A redesigned tongue and wider lacing give you a plush feel and better fit for a variety of foot types.

The Torin 7 has Altra’s signature wide forefoot that gives your toes room to wiggle and has Altra’s Standard Fit that is in between its roomier Original Fit and sleeker Slim Fit.

The Altra Torin 7 lets you rack up the miles in comfort. Watch Caroline in our Altra Torin 7 video review below to learn more.

The Altra Paradigm 7 gives you maximum cushion and support for every mile.

Altra reformulated its EGO™ MAX midsole material to make it softer and lighter than ever before. The Paradigm has Altra’s signature Balanced Cushioning that has the same stack height in the heel and forefoot (or 0 mm heel to toe drop) to give you a natural stride.

Altra’s GuideRails™ provide stability and support only when you need it, like when your legs are toast during the late stages of a run. The upper also has a lacing system that provides support and structure for your feet.

A plush collar and tongue provide premium comfort and a fantastic fit. The engineered mesh upper gives you plenty of breathability, while the wider toe box allows your toes to wiggle and gives you more stability.

Whether you are walking for your health or running to relieve stress, the Altra Paradigm 7 provides the stability and cushion you crave.

product.description:
Get excited for the perfect balance of cushion, support and performance in the Altra Provision 8.

This stability shoe won’t weigh you down and has enough comfort to train for miles and miles. With just the right amount of guidance, this shoe is ideal for those with flexible arches or who overpronate to help them run as naturally as possible.

Details

  • Upper: An engineered mesh upper provides comfort and breathability, while a refined molded heel collar provides for a comfortable, secure fit. This has Altra’s Standard Footshape™ Fit that is wider in the toe box to give your toes plenty of room to move.
  • Midsole: Altra’s Ego™ midsole cushion provides plenty of comfort, while being lightweight. This shoe’s balanced cushioning (or a 0mm heel to toe drop) has the same amount of cushioning in the heel and forefoot to let you run naturally.

The Mizuno Wave Rider 30's iconic Wave Plate runs the full length of the shoe, dispersing impact energy more evenly and helping you glide forward with a smooth, efficient stride that feels natural at any pace.

Nitrogen-infused ENERZY NXT foam sits on top of the plate, delivering plush cushioning and impressive energy return that makes every transition feel effortless. Providing soft landings, dependable support and an energetic toe-off, this stability shoe combines Nitrogen-Infused MIZUNO ENERZY NXT cushioning with a redesigned MIZUNO WAVE® plate for a balanced, responsive ride.

Built for daily training and race prep alike, the Mizuno Wave Inspire 22 delivers the perfect mix of cushioning and stability for runners who overpronate. The updated Wave plate helps prevent arch collapse and enables a steady, efficient weight transfer to keep you moving comfortably mile after mile.

Details:

  • Upper: This shoe features a mesh upper that supports your foot without sacrificing breathability.
  • Midsole: The midsole combines Nitrogen-Infused MIZUNO ENERZY NXT cushioning for comfort and energy return with a supportive MIZUNO WAVE plate that provides stability and arch support.
  • Outsole: The outsole is made from durable x10 carbon rubber to provide reliable traction and weight transfers.

product.description:
The Mizuno Sky Prime puts softness and stability on equal footing. A high-stack platform combines Mizuno’s MIZUNO ENERZY NXT+ foam with a wide ground contact area, giving you plenty of cushioning underfoot while keeping your ride balanced and controlled.

A Foam Wave construction uses multiple midsole materials to soften your landings and keep your transitions smooth through your stride. Up top, the engineered mesh and knit tongue wrap your foot in breathable, flexible comfort, making the Sky Prime a strong option for daily training, recovery miles and longer efforts when your legs could use some extra protection.

Details:

  • Upper: The engineered mesh upper gives your foot breathable, adaptable comfort, while a gusseted knit tongue stretches around your foot for a soft, secure fit.
  • Midsole: Mizuno’s MIZUNO ENERZY NXT+ top layer uses a PEBA/EVA blend for soft cushioning, impact protection and energy return. A Foam Wave construction and supportive bottom layer help keep your transitions smooth and your ride stable.
  • Outsole: Mizuno’s X10 carbon rubber adds durability in high-wear areas to help the outsole hold up through your daily training.
product.kitContent: Accordion1What's NewThe Sky Prime introduces Mizuno’s MIZUNO ENERZY NXT+ foam in the top midsole for a softer, more cushioned feel with responsive energy return. Its high stack and wide platform add protection and stability, while the engineered mesh upper and knit tongue give your foot a softer, more adaptive fit.Who It's Best ForRunners who want a highly cushioned shoe with a stable, smooth feel for everyday training and longer miles. It’s especially well suited for recovery days and high-mileage weeks when comfort and impact protection matter most.Why You'll Love ItYou get plenty of soft cushioning without feeling disconnected from the ground beneath you. The wide platform and smooth transitions make it easy to settle into your pace and keep going.00

Mizuno designers wrapped the reshaped Wave Plate in a bed of Mizuno Enerzy midsole foam. Enerzy foam offers next-level cushioning and energy return, while the Wave Plate delivers a stabilized feel with each step. Plus, the Wave Plate is now constructed with sustainable materials.

The support continues through the outsole with the classic Flex Groove design that promotes flexibility in the forefoot for a more secure toe off. X10 rubber on the outsole offers the durability you need to run in your Wave Rider 25 over long miles of daily training and prevents uneven wearing.

The Wave Rider 25 WAVEKNIT features Mizuno's sock-like knit upper for a comfortable, secure fit.

product.description:
The Mizuno Wave Horizon 5 is a fresh update to a classic stability shoe.

Featuring a dual layer midsole, the Wave Horizon 5 provides the blend of cushion and stability you need for daily miles. MIZUNO ENERZY foam is softer and more responsive than the previous U4ic foam, and it works with the engineered geometry of Mizuno’s stabilizing Foam Support Wave to create a lightweight and supported ride.

A redesigned heel collar offers enhanced comfort and works with the woven mesh upper to hug the contours of your foot and keep it secure while you run. Fleet Feet reviewers loved the updated upper saying, “Everything about the upper creates a nice secure feel all around your foot.”

The lightweight, carbon rubber X10 outsole provides the added durability that makes this stability shoe great. A relatively flat outsole means more stabilized landings, while a flexible tread design works to help your gait flow naturally.

Give yourself the support you need to perform your best mile after mile in the Mizuno Wave Horizon 5.

product.description:
Run your best in the Mizuno Wave Rider 26.

The newest version of the Mizuno Wave Rider lives up to its reputation as one of the best running shoes. This reliable workhorse offers more cushion and energy return than ever before. Mizuno added 2 mm of Mizuno’s ENERZY foam for a more propulsive and plush ride. The castor bean, bio-based wave plate in the midsole gives you balance, propulsion and efficiency during your run. Plus, the new wave materials emit 25% less CO2 emissions than normal PEBAX.

A connected forefoot outsole design provides for a snappier, more propulsive toe-off, while the X10 heel rubber increases durability. A jacquard mesh upper with a gusseted tongue hugs the foot comfortably and securely making it one of the best shoes for both walking and running long distances.

Lightweight, propulsive and cushioned, the Mizuno Wave Rider 26 is a great all-around daily trainer.

Read more in our Mizuno Wave Rider 26 review.

The waveknit upper can be found on Mizuno’s Wave NEO Ultra and Wave NEO Wind. Who It's Best ForThe Mizuno Wave Rider 26 is a great daily trainer for just about anyone. Whether you're out for an easy jog around the block or pushing through those long tempo runs, the Wave Horizon 7 brings a combo of comfort and excitement to your run. The Mizuno Wave Rider 28 brings dynamic smoothness to your everyday runs.

Soft cushioning and high energy return come from Mizuno’s game-changing ENERZY NXT midsole and legendary Wave Plate in the heel, which are stable and forgiving on easy runs while still being versatile for faster transitions when you pick up the pace.

Finished off with a breathable Jacquard Air Mesh upper for a seamless fit, the Wave Rider 28 is ready to be your ultimate daily trainer.

Details:

  • Upper: A soft Jacquard mesh upper gives you a forgiving and breathable fit. This flexible and smooth upper construction, with strategically placed PU print guides, stretches and supports your foot with every stride.
  • Midsole: Lighter, softer and more resilient than ever, the bio-based ENERZY NXT midsole ensures a smooth and energized ride from your first step to your last. In the heel, a Pebax Rnew® Wave Plate provides a cushioned, stable ride that minimizes environmental impact while maximizing your performance.
  • Outsole: The X10 outsole is a carbon rubber that makes the Wave Rider durable enough to be your workhorse running shoe.

This lightweight daily trainer makes your runs feel smooth and efficient with enhanced stability that adapts to your pace. When a shoe does this many things well, you notice it the moment you start moving. The Mizuno Neo Vista 3's nitrogen-infused cushioning uses a dual-layer setup — TPU foam on top for a soft, responsive feel and EVA foam below for stable, long-lasting support — delivering a ride that's as comfortable on easy recovery miles as it is when you push the pace.

A full-length MIZUNO WAVE® plate disperses impact energy across a broader platform for a stable, springy sensation underfoot, and Smooth Speed Assist geometry with an aggressive forefoot rockerguides your foot through a natural, efficient gait cycle that rolls you forward with every stride.

Run with a spring in your step in the supportive Mizuno Wave Inspire 18.

The Inspire 18 gives you a cushioned, responsive and stable ride. This shoe uses Mizuno’s signature wave plate technology in a double wave pattern to provide support and stability during your run, which is ideal for individuals who excessively pronate or have flexible arches. Plus, this TPU wave plate is made from corn, a renewable biomass source.

Mizuno’s ENERZY foam in the heel provides both cushion and energy return for your runs. The midsole is made with U4IC, which is a unique proprietary compound that provides high comfort and performance, while also being lightweight. The result is a soft, smooth ride that puts a pep in your step.

The biggest changes made to the Wave Inspire 18 are in the upper, which is now seamless, lighter and contains recycled materials. Our reviewers loved the simple comfort of the updated upper in our Mizuno Wave Inspire 18 review.

The Mizuno Wave Inspire 18 continues its tradition of being a reliable, lightweight stability running shoe that’s perfect for everyday runs.

product.description:
Think you can’t go faster? Think again—the all-new men's Mizuno Wave Rebellion is here to propel you to a new PR.

Mizuno powered the Rebellion with a unique glass-fiber-reinforced plate and lightweight midsole foam for a new type of ride from a Mizuno running shoe. Like other running shoes with carbon-fiber plates, the Rebellion’s plate makes the shoe stiffer and snappier than its non-plated counterparts, which saves more energy with each step you take.

Designers then layered on a midsole foam called Mizuno Enerzy Lite. The top-tier, featherweight foam composition gives you comfortable cushioning for long workouts on pavement, but its lightweight feel won’t hold you back from breaking your own records.

Fleet Feet runners love the bouncy response of the Enerzy Lite foam. Paired with the stiffness of the reinforced plate, Mizuno primed the Rebellion for speed.

Beneath the shoe, engineers created a one-of-a-kind outsole to improve durability and give you excellent traction on the road. Designers studded the outsole with grippy lugs that serve two purposes:

  • Give you the confident footing you need when you hit top speed
  • Maintain the Rebellion’s lightweight ride by minimizing the amount of rubber needed

On top, you’ll find a breezy engineered mesh upper and a well-structured heel cup. The one-piece mesh upper breathes easily and fits securely, while the heel counter locks your foot into place so you don’t have to think about anything but your effort.

With premium technology and a lightweight construction, the all-new men's Mizuno Wave Rebellion will give you an edge on big training days, race day or any day in between.

product.description:
With a smooth and stable ride, the Mizuno Wave Horizon 6 will make running feel more like floating.

This stability shoe provides comfort during all of your miles by combining Mizuno’s new Enerzy Core foam with the dual density midsole that makes the signature Mizuno Wave. The new Enerzy Core cushion is softer and gives you more energy return than ever before. This combination creates a soft and highly stable shoe that establishes a floating feeling with a kick of energy return.

The Wave Horizon 6 provides dynamic stability that is great for people who have flexible arches or overpronate and need extra support. The rubber outsole wraps around the medial (or inside) portion of the shoe to give extra durability and support, while the shoe’s wide platform creates inherent stability.

The stretch woven upper is extremely comfortable and accommodates a multitude of foot shapes. The weave is tighter on the medial side of the shoe with overlays to provide additional support and security. Testers loved the feel of the upper, saying "It’s a little bit stretchy while still maintaining a secure shape" in our Mizuno Wave Horizon 6 review. Plus, there is a thin, gusseted tongue to provide a perfect fit.

The outsole rubber is durable to handle miles upon miles of running. There are moderately deep flex grooves in the forefoot to provide for a smooth ride.

Maximum stability meets maximum cushion in the Mizuno Wave Horizon 6.

product.description:
Think you can’t go faster? Think again—the all-new women's Mizuno Wave Rebellion is here to propel you to a new PR.

Mizuno powered the Rebellion with a unique glass-fiber-reinforced plate and lightweight midsole foam for a new type of ride from a Mizuno running shoe. Like other running shoes with carbon-fiber plates, the Rebellion’s plate makes the shoe stiffer and snappier than its non-plated counterparts, which saves more energy with each step you take.

Designers then layered on a midsole foam called Mizuno Enerzy Lite. The top-tier, featherweight foam composition gives you comfortable cushioning for long workouts on pavement, but its lightweight feel won’t hold you back from breaking your own records.

Fleet Feet runners love the bouncy response of the Enerzy Lite foam. Paired with the stiffness of the reinforced plate, Mizuno primed the Rebellion for speed.

Beneath the shoe, engineers created a one-of-a-kind outsole to improve durability and give you excellent traction on the road. Designers studded the outsole with grippy lugs that serve two purposes:

  • Give you the confident footing you need when you hit top speed
  • Maintain the Rebellion’s lightweight ride by minimizing the amount of rubber needed

On top, you’ll find a breezy engineered mesh upper and a well-structured heel cup. The one-piece mesh upper breathes easily and fits securely, while the heel counter locks your foot into place so you don’t have to think about anything but your effort.

With premium technology and a lightweight construction, the all-new women's Mizuno Wave Rebellion will give you an edge on big training days, race day or any day in between.

product.description:
Propel yourself through your run wearing the eco-friendly Mizuno Wave NEO Wind.

Inspired by nature, the Mizuno Wave NEO Wind pushes the boundaries of sustainability in a shoe—including that the undyed knit upper eliminates the use of water in the dyeing process, while the shoe’s sockliner and Enerzy foam use an algae-based BLOOM material that reduces CO2 emissions.

The Wave NEO Wind will propel you forward thanks to Mizuno’s Enerzy Lite foam. The bio-based foam that uses castor bean oil is 22% lighter and 35% bouncier than traditional U4ic foam.

You will feel like there are springs attached to your feet thanks to Mizuno’s Pebax Wave Plate that uses a 3D honeycomb pattern for a snappy toe off and raised medial and lateral side walls for support. The G3 outsole is made with lightweight, high traction rubber for extra grip and confidence throughout your run.

Push your limits and feel good about your environmental impact in Mizuno Wave NEO Wind.

Read more in our Mizuno Wave NEO Wind review.

product.description:
Run with a purpose in the Mizuno projectZERO Wave Rider 27.

Mizuno’s ProjectZERO is aimed at reducing the number of women diagnosed with breast cancer from 1 in 8 to zero. To do this, a portion of each sale of the Mizuno projectZERO Wave Rider 27 will go to the Breast Cancer Research Foundation with the hope that no one has to miss a life experience due to breast cancer.

The Mizuno Wave Rider 27 brings a new level of responsiveness and the smoothest ride possible thanks to its bio-based wave plate and Mizuno ENERZY foam.

The breathable jacquard mesh upper gives you both stretch and comfort along with a gusseted tongue that secures your midfoot for a distraction-free run. Plus, the upper is made of 90% recycled materials.

Enjoy the comfort and durability of the Mizuno projectZERO Wave Rider 27 and help make a difference in the fight against breast cancer.

Represent America with every run in the Wave Rider USA Running Shoe.

The Mizuno Wave Rider is a consistent and reliable daily trainer, making it one of the best running shoes whether you’re running a marathon or your first 5K.

The Wave Rider 27 brings a new level of responsiveness to each step and the smoothest ride possible thanks to its bio-based wave plate and Mizuno ENERZY foam. The MIZUNO WAVE® plate disperses energy when your foot hits the pavement to make landings softer while the ENERZY foam gives you plenty of cushion and bounce.

The upper is made with smooth air mesh material and a gusseted that has plenty of stretch for extra comfort, while a redesigned heel counter gives you a closer fit and great lockdown. Plus, the X10 outsole is a carbon rubber that makes the Wave Rider durable enough to be your workhorse running shoe.

Enjoy the comfort and durability of the Mizuno Wave Rider USA, all while showing off your patriotic side.

product.description:
Float away in the men's Mizuno Wave Sky 7.

Mizuno upped its game with the Wave Sky 7 by adding 2 millimeters of Enerzy foam to the midsole. This super soft and bouncy foam gives you 17% more cushioning on landings and 15% more energy return during toe-offs to keep you running quickly and comfortably no matter the distance.

Designers then used a Wave construction that layers a softer foam on top of a more rigid foam, so it feels soft when you land but stable when you push off. The outsole is also 2 millimeters wider on the bottom for better stability whether you’re a heel or midfoot striker.

When you first step into the Wave Sky, the smooth, stretch-woven upper and gusseted tongue wraps your foot like a glove for an adaptive fit that’s soft yet supportive. Plus, to keep your feet cool during hard efforts, wider breathability holes on top of the toes and midfoot prevent stuffiness.

Lastly, a durable X10 carbon rubber outsole holds up to long miles and gives you the traction to run fast and take corners with speed.

The Mizuno Wave Sky 7 is the ultimate running shoe for maximum cushioning and unparalleled comfort.

product.description:
The men's Mizuno Wave Prophecy 13 gives you comfort and support to go the distance.

Mizuno’s unique full-length INFINITY WAVE midsole has the cushioning to make your long runs smooth and easy without feeling too spongy. A MIZUNO WAVE® plate adds stability to each step, and the eco-friendly mesh upper keeps your feet cool and comfortable.

Details:

  • Upper: Layered Monofilament Mesh Upper is incredibly breathable and has a great midfoot lockdown.
  • Midsole: This shoe features Mizuno Infinity Wave technology throughout the entire length of the shoe, which is highly renowned for both its underfoot feel and design. This technology has two parallel plates that sit together with soft cushioning pillars in between to provide incredible cushioning and improved durability by absorbing and dispersing the impact of running at each foot strike.
  • Outsole: Mizuno’s X10 Outsole material with WGRIP is an extremely durable carbon rubber that allows for longer wear in high-impact areas and gives more traction at the heel strike in both wet and dry conditions.

  • Outsole: X10 outsole rubber gives you plenty of durability for the long run.

product.description:
When you are looking to push the pedal and turn up the speed, the Mizuno Rebellion Flash 2 can help you with your mission.

This shoe supports your ideal gait thanks to Mizuno’s Smooth Speed Assist geometry and glass fiber-reinforced wave plate that gives you plenty of propulsion and energy return to hit top speeds. Perfect for training to set your next personal record, you will feel lightning-quick in the Wave Rebellion Flash 2.

Details:

  • Upper: A lightweight and breathable upper helps you get the speed you need. There is a soft and lightweight heel counter that keeps your heel in place without any added weight. A triple shoelace loop prevents the tongue from shifting, while an internal strap prevents left-right foot sway and supports efficient running.

  • Midsole: The midsole consists of a layer of Mizuno Enerzy Lite+ that is softer and lighter weight to support running at speed. There is a glass fiber-infused nylon wave plate that gives you plenty of propulsion and supports the unique geometry for smooth running from heel to toe. Underneath the Wave Plate is a layer of Mizuno Enerzy foam that gives you high energy return.
  • Outsole: A rubber outsole provides durability and a softer landing feel.

product.description:
Any surface, any distance—there are few things the Mizuno Wave Daichi 8 can’t do.

Versatile is the best way to describe this road-to-trail shoe. Mizuno Enerzy Foam cushioning keeps your runs on the pavement smooth and easy, while a rock plate in the forefoot and a Vibram Megagrip outsole give you the protection and traction you need when you hit the trails.

Details:

  • Upper: A seamless and soft woven upper with a gusseted tongue locks down your foot for a comfortable and secure fit. Plus, a shoelace pocket lets you tuck away excess laces.
  • Midsole: A Mizuno Enerzy Foam midsole gives you soft landings with high energy return. The midsole also uses a Wave construction that layers two foams with different densities for plush landings, smooth transitions and a stable feeling. There is also a rock plate in the forefoot for extra protection offroad.
  • Outsole: The Wave Daichi 8’s Vibram Megagrip outsole with 4 mm lugs gives you versatile traction when you hit the trails while still keeping your road runs smooth.

product.description:
Float through your runs in the Mizuno Wave Skyrise 5 Roxy.

In collaboration with Roxy, Mizuno built the Skyrise with two different types of foam cushioning—one for a soft feel and one for high energy return. The result is a ride that feels comfortable on long runs and spirited when you pick up the pace.

With a stretch woven upper material that keeps your foot in the right position, the Mizuno Wave Skyrise 5 Roxy helps you cruise through your daily runs or walks.

Details

  • Cushioning: Mizuno Enerzy Core and Mizuno Enerzy foams deliver soft cushioning and high energy return.
  • Mizuno Wave: The signature Wave technology improves stability without losing that floating feeling.
  • Upper: Stretch woven material fits softly over your foot while keeping you in the right position.
